text: I have been playing the game for close to 6 years now. and between the massive story which i enjoyed a lot and the exploration. the game now feels very stagnated. the story keeps going on and on about random stuff and expect the players to be able to understand every bit of lore of it. and let's not talk about the pitiful reward and dull events the game has been giving out recently. and they even took out event weapons with bad weapon skins . in short, the game is slowly losing its charm.

Six years in and I am still obsessed! You will have seasons of burnout, but if you ever wanted to play this game, now's the time. The stories are getting better, the gameplay is so much fun and relaxing. Although I must say I'm upset that certain mechanics are locked behind certain premium characters and it is frustrating for F2P players who can't always get these characters. It's tricky to clear endgame content when you don't have the right characters.

I would give genshin impact five stars however there is some issue in Asia server because of which the game keeps on lagging and reconnecting thus I have to do the quests over and over again, it's not just me who is facing this issue, others have also stated the same. Also, genshin impact was supposed to be a story based game, that was the reason i downloaded it in the first place, but the new update of the gaming world is just not it. I personally did not find it appealing at all.

Best game I've ever played 🎮. I've played many games, but this is the one I never get bored of and never uninstall. In the past, I always uninstalled games once I got bored. Some events can be boring .😅 The music is very good, and the characters are great. But I'd love to see more male characters. Some female characters could use better clothing and more fun designs. Newly released characters often have poor playstyles 🫤 This is the only game I have on my phone, tablet, laptop, and PC.

genuinely a good game if you're willing to put in the effort. since it's a gacha, it's obviously not going to respect your time if you plan to get strong. if you have the option though, I'd recommend playing on the computer, though that may be personal preference. to be honest, since I last played it did start feeling a little annoying going through the story, though that might've been the result of burnout rather than poor writing.

Avoiding the Fandom, the game is actually pretty good. the graphics looks great, the characters may have fanservice but there's characters with many great designs and lore. It also has a very straightforward gameplay, no complicated stuff which is fine by me. Though the game forces us to "listen" through the worthless dialouge and with no skip button. The game is also very grindy and have many new 5 star characters dependent on other 5 stars. Overall, good gacha game but has many flaws

Og a potato PC player since 2.3 but shifted to mobile d/t convenience but this game still works on a decade old machine! Likewise with my mid phone. Aside from device optimization, GI has plenty of things to get lost into as a newbie, and a game that screams comfort to older players. The gacha may be a hit or a miss but if you're funmaxxing, then the experience is worth trying 🐑 Great exploration and lore that can only go up from this point forward

This game is MASSIVE and is ever growing. The lore and gameplay are incredible, super captivating! This is a game that you could spend a lot of money on, but you by no means have to. I've been playing for almost a year now and am still not caught up (granted, I have a full time job and a part time, so I can't no-life this game nearly as much as I want). Between story quests, archon quests, world quests, character quest lines, and so much more, you'll never run out of things to do. 10000/10

I love this game so much but I will admit it takes up alot of space and has trouble with lagging and loading but that's only if you play it on your phone so I recommend playing on a gaming console. The art style and animation is beautiful and looks like it took alot of time and effort to make. The stories and quests are really fun. And I find it fun to try and work hard to get characters , it's very rewarding. Also make sure you get a lyre to play because it sounds so pretty.

I LOVE this game, it has lots of stuff even sometimes I feel suffocated by it, but the domains of enemies especially when it's timed is tiring. Even when my character's levels are way higher than the enemies, I somehow can't seem to kill most of the enemies in the time limit... it's an amazing game but sometimes it forces me into a quest like: Palace of the Vision Serpent, I can't leave it and go back to Co-Op, it's super annoying and I can't even play with friends, only talk..

My friend came back and can't play anymore because everything is too hard. I can't play old favorite characters because they're too weak now. Powercreep will kill this game when new players get to more recent regions and quit out of frustration, and old players will give up because of unsatisfying boss gimmicks. It feels like the devs don't play their own game. I can't imagine the majority of them fighting a boss and thought to themselves, "this is so fun! let's share it with the players!".

A lot to do in a massive open world, variety of characters and elemental powers with multiple weapons including mages. Its a long term game. Downside its insanely difficult to get artifacts to equip characters with the stats you are looking for plus in a single run to farm them it has two different types of artifacts instead of one which makes it even harder. You'll spend lot of Resin (energy) to get barely or exactly what you want just to build a single character. Developers should improve this

Gatcha aside, this game is amazing. Open world with plenty of fun things to do and discover. The storyline is fantastic with exciting and emotional parts, some side quests can be boring but you can skip dialogue. been playing for about a month now and never HAD to spend any money, but did anyway just because I love it. Definitely recommend

Overall a good game while still a typical p2w gacha.. Gameplay is solid, been playing for a while, yet as a f2p I can't have a complete team. Side story and even small quests that gave you nothing still can't be skipped. And recently they added a game in a game that should be a separate game, baiting you to either play it or just let it eat up your device's space for no reason, not to mention that 'extra game' also paywalled.

This game loses its charm quickly. It becomes a slog through the dialogue and story with its lack of a skip function, and becomes a grind for stat boosts at a random chance. It was initially fun to play but now I feel that the combat is just so boring and repetitive, it leaves no room for experiments, only higher damage numbers. This game does not care for your time and only wants your money with its stingy gacha rates and little gratitude towards its playerbase.

I love this game the story and fun are never ending, there is always stuff to do and new things to see. The only problem is that eats 5 hours in a day no problem if your not careful, but I won't really sad that's bad thing more it just being a great game. Tones of lore, lots of quests and characters, and puzzles all over totally worth trying!!!

The games good, yes but for some reason it's lacking a lot of vital features. The domains are a pain to do over and over again for good artificts—it significantly impacts gameplay and makes the game play feel like a chore and not fun like it used to in the start. There should be a feature to skip the domain gameplay after you've played it five or so times (like the cooking mechanic). And the standard banner needs a serious update and rework.

(edited) I've been playing this game since January 16th, 2022. I have no real complaints.. The style is nice but lately there has been TOO MUCH fan service to the point where I'm not even surprised about it anymore, it's honestly ridiculous. But the characters are all interesting in their own ways and there's sooo much more that's gonna be added to the game so it's not rlly boring!! I have an OLD phone (Samsung Galaxy s10e) and it still runs smoothly, sometimes it'll glitch but not too badly!

Genshin has been really one of my fav games ever since i started playing it for like lots of hours. the beginning was so good, the stories are well arranged, the graphics are amazing, and the characters are beautiful, plus super cool. But unfortunately, Idk why genshin that. it should be improving the end-game, too, like what it did in the beginning. Also, the game depends on fanservice too much. I can't imagine there are only two men archons. pls fix the lore...it deserves better than that.

Very fun, complex, game that always has something interesting to do. The art is beautiful, and I love the individuality of each character. The storylines are enjoyable, and most of the battles aren't too hard. The only downside is how much storage the game takes up, but that's to be expected. My phone does heat up a lot though.

Story is AMAZING. archon quests are fun but side quests tend to get long and annoying. Would appreciate a skip button for that. Farming for artifact exp materials is literally impossible without events (that too a small amount) which is a huge drawback. Domains are also only available on specific days, which is unrealistic expecting players to have sufficient time to log in everyday for the materials. Exploration is also slow. Farming primos is hell, and building characters is almost impossible.

As someone who has gotten decently far into the game (AR55) and played around the Inazuma release, I have plenty of experience from this game itself. That being said, all this game is doing currently is going south. The company refuses to listen to valid, useful criticism. End-game content is boring, and rewards simply aren't enough to suffice the gacha system. Resin cap is too small, so farming for characters is tremendously time-consuming, and frankly, their updates fall flat more than less.

Originally gave genshin a 5* review back on the 12/12/2020, back when I was so immersed and in love with the game. Now, it's a 3* max. The game I once enjoyed and looked forward to playing is now only played for the sake of nostalgia (+ the money I spent). Sorry Hoyo, the moment you decided debuting Mavuika and Citlali limited banners together while adding the 30 free pulls to the rerun phase, I lost interest. There are more issues (bland char animation, no skip button,etc.) than I can type now.

it is a good game and all...but i am not far in the story and am adventure rank 13. no problems up to this point. but now the game always kicks me out for some reason. i already teied to free up space, i tried to adjust the settings, to fix the files, everything. but it just freezes up at one point, then goes to black and i'm back at my home screen. I have nothing against this game, quite the opposite, i love it, but i don't understand what i am supposed to do when it just kicks me out.

It won't let me access the game anymore. Literally! I'm only in the part where they show you "HOYOVERSE", and I get kicked out of the game. I got to access it yesterday, but I can't access it now anymore. I tried uninstalling and installing it again, didn't work. If the servers are under maintenance, they would send me a notice at the game before kicking me out, which wasn't the case. I don't think it's because of my phone either. PLEASE! FIX THIS!

I genuinely enjoy the game but there are some glaring technical issues that deeply bother me when it comes to the app version of this game. Lack of controler support The iOS version benefiting from this while leaving android in the dust is rather annoying. Random crashing Both me and my friend have experienced periods when the game would crash on the title screen for no reason whatsoever and the only fix was waiting a few days.

The character designs and voice acting was ideal! The music was unique and excellently composed, and the exploration to the combat was one of the biggest highlights for me. However, I have always disliked their childish enemy designs, I always felt the music was more mature than the enemies themselves as well as the world design. The game is maturing into a millennial orientated game after Natland and I just can't pay the price for the content out now. Being a player since year one, sad change.

I've played this game for a long time and really tried giving it a chance, but its really just getting absurd. this company does NOT AT ALL listen to its fans. it ignores completely the issues their facing. even if they try to fix it, they'll still do it horribly and more to their advantage. not no mention that it is an absolute struggle to play if you dont spend money. it really does not support f2p. the storytelling is horrible, REALLY boring. its got good lore, just not good storytelling.

I've started playing this game last year May 2024. While the gameplay was nice especially quests and open world adventure. But sometimes it's just kinda bored since it is open world adventure and gotta wandering around for hours just to look for quests. And also, the update and installation of this game takes very long to get in. Please make this game a bit more fun and more quests make me less bored and also shorten the duration of update. It's just take too long, hopefully fix that that's all

5.0 Update: GI offers an incredible open-world, and the recent story has been strong as well. The dailies system has been improved to reward engagement with quests, while also making it easier to use resin and get rewarded. The game's biggest flaws continue to be a painfully slow character building process, and story pacing that prevents fast readers (or those bored with events) to get through content quickly. With a dialogue skip, and some more QoL, I think GI can continue to be a great title.

I love the mechanics of the game. The stories and the nostalgia it gives me everytime when I'm playing it. But the only thing that upset me is the rewards. When a new update comes by, it lacks of giving away wish fates or primogems. It's always 2 or 3 pulls everytime the game updates. It's not enough for the character we're pulling for. It's hard to grind. It's also hard to save primos. I'm wishing that you change the giving rewards for it. Thank you!

The lore, puzzles and the characters are top-notch amongst other gachas. However, playing this game for hours everyday to unlock all the rewards in every patch is still not enough to pull the charac you want, esp if you lose to 50/50, even if you have welkin, you need to buy more huhu. After 100% exploration and completing all events. Genshin is becoming so tiring, feels like a chore, resin is very limited, and the things you get in return is very scarce.

SOLID GACHA ARPG GAME. Back then in 2020 when the game first released, I was hesitate to try the game since it's dubbed as another Gacha game on the market. Fast forward 5 years later, the game still going strong I finally decided to try. I am absolutely surprised, because Gacha is only part of the game, but the entirely of the game can be played even if you not partaking in the Gacha system itself. I am amazed by how many details and mechanic this game has to offer. It's fun and engaging!

Ridiculous game with impossibly restrictive game mechanics whereby you are unable to level up appropriately. Materials to do so are next to impossible to get if at all possible. All this from a game that requires a 50Gb+ install. Also has a huge monetization backdrop. Tried it for longer than i should have, my bad. Uninstalling and recommend that all stay well clear. :(

Free to play and/or new players are treated poorly. The only reason why I have lots of characters is because I've been playing basically since the release. If you want to start right now, I have to say: don't bother. You can't afford new characters without spending real life money, not to mention 5* weapons or constellations. I just keep playing for the story and nostalgia. Hoyoverse, GIVE US MORE PRIMOGEMS, PLEASE!

I've been playing this game for 2 years now. the game is good itself although the updates are so heavy and sometimes unnecessary. I find the millestra wonderland so unnecessary and as I read the comments there are many players with this opinion. the least you can do is add these side quests as optionall updates. I'm looking forward for this issue to be fixed in the next update so I could even delete some unnecessary packs.

One of the best games because it offers a huge open world, beautiful graphics, memorable characters, and a story that keeps players interested for hours. The game is free to play(not fully), yet it provides a high-quality experience that rivals many paid games. Exploring the different regions, solving puzzles, and discovering hidden secrets always gives players something new to do.

When I started playing the game (5.0 player) it was very fun progressing through the story and I really enjoyed the charac designs, gameplay and other stuff but as time passed by, I noticed that most of the characs being released are only females— yeah, their designs are nice but we need more male characs. In addition to that, less and boring events are not helpful to grind enough primogems needed for pulling. Next ver we'll have 3 new characters but only 60+ pulls. How greedy.

Made a small mistake of redeeming all my Luna sigils and asked customer service if there's any way to reverse this since I like to keep the sigils in my inventory. Customer service said they can't. Just very disappointing and frustrated especially considering I've been playing since the very beginning and have spent a lot of money both in-game and on merch, but they can't do something very inconsequential?

The game has pretty scenery, storylines, graphics, fun exploration, etc. However, the game has had huge success in years, but Genshin gives it's players so little of rewards it's not even funny. And don't even get me started on events giving small rewards, artifact domains, character potential locked on another character (mostly Nodkrai and upcoming Shnezhnaya). Abyss and Stygian requires players to pull for Lunar and upcoming Stellar characters. F2p players can't are left behind.

I enjoy this game so much, I love the characters, lore, gameplay, ui, it's just that I think the rewards are unfair and 60 pulls for a patch is definitely not enough, we're talking about a multi millionaire company btw. Plus this game is not new player friendly at all, it's hard to catch up with the Meta, characters taking too long to rerun, and don't even get me started on the artifact domains.

I enjoy this game so much, I love the characters, lore, gameplay, ui,it's just that I think the rewards are unfair and 60 pulls for a patch is definitely not enough, we're talking about a multi millionaire company btw. Plus this game is not new player friendly at all, it's hard to catch up with the Meta, characters taking too long to rerun, and don't even get me started on the artifact domains. (1)

The game just got worse. As someone who spent 4+ years in the game, I haven't seen any good improvements. Small changes here, and there, but nothing to make the game better. Combat is still boring, no matter what new character that comes out. Dialogue is still unskippable, even if it's a lore-based game, it should be optional because it's not a BOOK. Rewards incline people to spend more, I mean lets be honest, 60 pulls in one patch is enough for hopes and dreams. Just improve, stop being greedy.

Needs a proper skip button. Atleast make the choices skippable. It's only one thought divided into two choices anyway. Combat and characters are good. Powercreep is an issue I can mostly ignore but taking forever to build characters is not. Open world and coop experience are great. Lore feels like a mandatory lecture. I wish I can just skip it entirely.

I am really disappointed with what Genshin Impact has become. DOTTORE is one of the major characters in the game, and players waited for years to see him properly appear and develop in the game. After all that waiting, his death felt rushed, unfair,unnecessary, and a waste of one of the most interesting characters in the story. He had so much potential and lore. Killing him off weakens the story and lowers the value of the game. Unless Dottore comes back, I have no reason to return to the game

I love playing this game but PLEASE HOYO update the compasses in other regions because what is the point of compasses if they can't pick up ANYTHING after a while. No chests, no puzzles, no challenges, NOTHING. It's so annoying to keep switching apps to use an interactive map (I'm on mobile btw so you can imagine how tiring constantly doing this is) just to make sure I can 100% exploration a certain region. In fact, exploring regions other than Nod-Krai isn't even fun anymore because of this.

The game is good. The monetization is insane. I want to keep playing but I don't want to be suckered into spending hundreds of dollars for the best characters. This game preys on your fomo and it's honestly scary. The story is typical mid anime and that's okay. Gameplay is a 8/10. It's BoTW with anime paint. But underneath all of that is a money sink.

Love the lore. Love the exploration. I've been playing for years now and I barely miss a daily login. As that player, I am very disappointed at how this game came to be 6yrs later. New players, returning players, F2P players can't even enjoy the content anymore. Character potential are locked behind other characters. The game has so much characters now that in-game rewards can't even keep up. Most concerning of all is how the company treats its players. Hope this insight helps.

The rewards players receive are way too low for the gacha system it implies and the constant release of new characters. The new characters powercreep the older ones, and the endgame is almost imposible to be completed with older characters. Also, the rewards system is outdated. In comparison to other gacha games, the game fails to reward people correspondingly. The rewards are extremely low and given as in disgust. Playing this game feels like a full-time job that barely pays half of the bills.

I gave a decent rating for mainly the story and gameplay mechanics, it's great, but it doesn't suffice the lack of rewards we've been getting in comparison to 4.0 and below, I feel like the rewards are becoming more scarce as each update goes by and not only that, but the QoLs are not what we asked for, we want to be able to skip certain parts of the story, easier to get gud artifacts and a artifact preset mechanic so we don't have to go looking for it everytime.

The game has become incredibly stingy. I miss when it used to reward us with so many prizes for characters and weapons, but now everything has changed. I can barely get what I want. I hope the game rethinks itself because everything is wrong.I can't believe a beautiful game with so many achievements would ruin itself.

I like the gameplay it's simple and easy. The world is immersive as well, so many things to do. What I don't like is the amount of time you need to spend for a single quest, it's tedious, so many dialogues. Edit: I haven't finished the new archon quest after hours, omg, I just can't anymore.

one of the reasons i held onto this game for so long was the exploration and open world aspect, which i think are pretty good. other than that, the game gives way too little rewards while pumping out new chars. very often, most female chars. have very similar designs and wear revealing clothing even in regions that are really cold... the story has gotten a lot worse and theres so many other things id like to say but theres a word limit. anyways genshin has soo much potential but they ruined it

I've been playing this game for more than 3 years maybe This is the first time I've been so disappointed!! Firstly, the rewards from events and other things are lacking while players are presented with many new banners and rerun banners, Both of Sandrone's character designs are disappointing!!, her skirt should be long, and why is her robot different?? even though I've been excited and waiting for a long time,I hope you guys can fix this and hopefully it will be better

i'm going to be compleatly honest, i've been playing this game for like 3 years, some aspects i find really enjoyable but the character designes are disappointing for the newer characters, the game is also getting rather repetitive and feels more like a chore than a game, especially if you're an f2p/low spender. and let's not even talk about how ut runs on phone (mine at least) because it doesn't and i even got plus storage for it.

When I first started playing Genshin, I loved the game very much. It was fun, interactive, had so much potential and still has lore-wise, but lately, we either get too many 4 star characters, it's focused more on greed and making the players pay more and more for characters, and there are probably more issues even I don't know about. I still love and play the game for the characters and the lore because it's a good game.

I love the game so much, I really do, but we can't continue like this. A lot of players, including me, don't have the time for such long quests, we don't have enough wishes to pull for the characters that keep coming out. The meta changes all the time, there are too many lore important quest that aren't fixed in the game. Exploration is too complicated like places in Sumeru, and we need more maps during the patches. It's hard, we love the game so much but we might just stop.

this game is absolutely terrible. Well, maybe not terrible in general, but in terms of their reward system. I've been playing for 4 years already, and the rewards this game has always provided players with has never been good. They will give you 20 primogems, expect you to be thankful for it, and continue playing the game. Its so exhausting. Not just that, the characters as well. You'd have to obtain a lot of other characters to even make the character you want work properly.

I have been playing this game for a while now, don't get me wrong, I loved the lore, archon quests, sceneries of each region. But its getting to a point where you have to clearly struggle to keep up with the meta for end game, even after pulling one character, you need to pull another to unlock some of its potential which is tiring due to the limited amount of rewards HoYoverse gives out each patch.

‎I’ve been playing Genshin Impact for a long time, but I feel little bit disappointed with how unfair the rewards and systems are. The gifts were too small compared to the huge success of the game, and it feels like the developers don’t value the players enough. The gacha system is very expensive, and the resin limit makes progress slow and frustrating. I enjoy the game’s world and characters, especially the story of the game was peak, but the lack of fair rewards and meaningful endgame content.

I've been playing this game for five years and honestly, it's just not worth playing anymore. you don't even get up to 100 wishes per patch so you could get a chance to wish for characters. Storyline is clunky, messed up, and confusing, the meta makes it IMPOSSIBLE to do endgame content without needing the NEWEST, JUST RELEASED THIS SECOND characters, and they're getting lazy with the designs. It's just not worth it. They're rushing through the storyline to focus on new ways to run your money.

literally my top favorite game. The story is amazing, The combat is pretty smooth, and the exploration is absolutely enjoyable, being my favorite part of the game. I highly recommend it if you are a exploration enthusiast. The problem is that they have started to make some characters too dependent on certain other characters in combat , but not a very extreme issue for me. The powercreep also isn't that bad.

While the game was considered fun at first, logging in eventually became repetitive, making the experience less exciting as time goes on. In addition, the recent characters, story as well as rewards have been disappointing to many players, including me, and we are still hoping for a change in the game updates. Genshin Impact has the potential to be better only if the developers would listen to the voices of players.

I'm sorry, I really can't keep playing this game anymore. There's a bucket list of issues here but it will not fit the 500 character limit for reviews. But what I'd like to point out are these: The game has no Skip scene button. Pull rates are low, Spiral Abyss (End-game content) now takes so much time to reset, end-game contents are basically only for those who have spent a ton of money. And worst of all, Insane power creep and character specific mechanics. Playing isn't rewarding anymore.

The game itself is really fun and gives you an immersive experience, I also like how they gave much thought and effort into the archon quests and lore. Although, over the years Genshin has been more and more catered to endgame players and whales—which is pretty concerning. Most of the events requires you to have at least a c6 5-star or a premium team which is sad since a lot of people don't really want to spend all of their money on a game.

it was okay at first, now its just incredibly difficult to progress. every single time there's a new champ if you dont get it you can't clear the hard content in the game. like chill out with the constant need to have people spend money to get anywhere in this game. casually spending is fine, but when I really want a champ. Don't force the if you dont get this champ, you can't clear this content type updates.

I am very disappointed. I'm a lore player and I like the game very much, unfortunately, hoyo seemed to prioritize profit more than anything. I understand that this is a business, but what I can't swallow is that they have the capability to do something but won't do it. This is a billion dollar company with no apreciation for its player. The rewards are getting lower and the character design is became lazier. I do hope this will change.

I've been playing since 2.2 and its almost 5 years now. The game has indeed upgraded and I have seen the improvement in characters to storylines. But some addition in the game like the milistira idk the name is necessary? Also I really don't like how you set up the echos of the characters, like srsly. Put atleast on effort for it the echos like we can put our characters there atleast, it really irritating when I play for it, the echoes are pretty but is it worth to get it? Please hear me out.

Slowly getting worse and worse from exploration and story to the character designs and lack of diversity. I've played since liyue was released and I have just lost the desire to play this game. they don't listen to the fan base, even doing the complete opposite on several occasions and hardly even giving bare minimum. there was so much potential but it feels like they're prioritizing profit (which is weird since listening would most likely bring in more money) over the player base.

I've been playing Genshin Impact since 2.4, and I'm utterly astounded by the lack of rewards for players. As a completionist player, I find it offensive and disappointing that the game continually comes up short in terms of rewards and new content. The early part of the game was excellent, but I don't recommend it to new players anymore.

I've known this game for years. I loved the theme, the vibe, the stories, and the characters. but just like the others, I don't think the rewards that are given to us is enough. I don't think 60 pulls is enough to get a character in the patch, no? It just seems like we players are getting less and less reward compared to the other games. It's genuinely turning to a pay to win game and it just feels like a grinding game and not something you enjoy.

It isn't the same as it was anymore... For Free to play players the rewards aren't really good anymore, can't get a single 5 star Character for a whole patch because of the little rewards we get. and that's just the character, there are also their weapons. the mini games aren't as fun as they used to be too, and they're now just giving weapon skins ( it's not even that good, it is just a slight color adjustment from a previous weapon) as rewards not actual weapons.

I love the interesting plots and detail-oriented approach of the worldbuilding. I recommend this game for players who are all into great lore, characters, exploration, etc. However, as the years went by, it's getting hard to enjoy obtaining characters due to the lacking amount of rewards we get in recent patches, even grinding for it doesn't feel much worth it. Admittedly, as a low spender, it's getting tiring to play this game just to get my favorite characters.

As someone who's played this game literally the first minute the servers launched, and almost everyday for sub-6 years, the game has almost never eased up on being stingy compared to any other modern gacha game. I can glaze on the story, lore, characters for all you want, but in the end, you can't keep your customers satisfied with just those. The business model for this game is the epitome of taking advantage of people's FOMO. They will try to expend as minimum as possible to urge you to spend

the gameplay is pretty cool, and I like most of the characters and stories. however, the customer service sucks, and the game takes up a huge amount of space. also, they don't give nearly enough in-game currency. and besides that, the mini game "A walk home" in the 6.6 event is extremely ableist for us players who only have one hand due to disabilities.

I have played this game for years and spent a lot of time building my account. After returning from a few months away, I found that an unknown device had accessed my account and many of my weapons and artifacts were missing. I contacted support, but I was told that lost items cannot be restored. Losing years of progress because of unauthorized access is extremely disappointing. Great game, but account security and recovery support need major improvement.

I'll say this: when you're just starting out, the game feels a whole lot different than if you're at rank 50-60. There are many beautiful regions and activities to explore that are enjoyable, lore is deep. But at high ranks the game becomes simply terrible and greedy and ceases to be a game and turns into work. I'm at rank 59 and I have very bad impressions.

The game IS fun the thing is with how they're treating the players it's getting annoying. They would rather let this game rot and be hated than actually try to improve this game. the game is really good, and it's been my comfort game since 2022 because of the lore, the character designs, and the side stories, but I'm just really disappointed how they treat the players, especially the players who don't want to spend money to play. the reward is very low every patch, and it's hard to get limited characters because of it. please, do better.

Playing since the launch and I am so so disappointed as a f2p player. It's hard to keep up with all the new characters with the resources that are given for free to players. I've been playing this game since its release. With each new version, it's becoming increasingly difficult to enjoy the game in its current state. This is my favorite game. I like that it's an open world game, I like the combat, and the different characters. I play on mobile and it runs just fine. The developers are lazy. Story and dialogue are badly written, graphics arent great, they constantly cut corners and it shows. This game is amazing and all, it has been my comfort ever since but with all the issues regarding the upcoming patch and new characters, it's literally impossible to enjoy. I thought we were better than this??? It's not like all the players have money in their pockets to buy genesis crystals and convert it into primoges—there are free to play players. I've played this game on and off for years, because I fell in love with the storyline and characters and the designs, however it gets more and more increasingly difficult to actually pull for characters you want or like. It has insufficient rewards, doesn't treat the players well, and it needs a skip button for quests. I've been playing for 5 years now and I've exhausted every single way there is to obtain primogems. I've played this game on and off for years. I love the storyline and characters, however it is incredibly difficult to actually pull for characters you want or like. Disappointed. As much as I love this game, it's hard to keep enjoying it when the quality barely changes. The game is great, been playing since release, but the lately it got me disappointed. ive been playing this game foe years and ngl, even though it's free, it's getting harder and harder for f2p players. It's extremely disappointing how the game seems to give us very few pulls and rewards. I'm finding it pretty disappointing that we're getting: Zero map expansions, Annoying character incentives that makes accessibility for newer players to approach endgame much more difficult than it should (Lunar), No more weapons being handed out on events (replaced with skins), Not enough character skins (there's 100+ characters, and only a handful of skins), AND *60* pulls in THIS TOTAL PATCH for 2 NEW CHARACTERS. I'm a 1.6 player, pls hoyo, you're better than this.

First few years this game was awesome, everything you were doing was exciting, new, fresh, lots of content, events, you were allowed to do whatever u wanted. I really love this game but now, with most players I think about quitting. i've been playing since release,& i must say, i get disappointed again & again. after 6 years, this game doesn't have a skip button. every other gacha game does. the rewards are so bad compared to other games. and the time spent to get the rewards is IMMENSE. it's extremely hard to be a free to play player in this game. building a full team needs lots of characters and time spent. it's horrible. also, there's no darkskin characters,and there's also lots of female characters who are sexualised.

The rewards are beginning to get a little TOO LOW. What do you mean there are 2 new characters with 2 new weapons, and we're only supposed to choose one with approximately 60 pulls? I started playing in 4.3 and instantly fell in love with literally everything in the game, from the characters and the story to the open world and the events, and I still enjoy it. It's sad because I love it enough to ignore any other flaws, but it's simply too large

It's a great game overall, good graphics, nice gameplay and a really inmersive story, with beautiful characters tailored so everyone finds a favorite. But the game's big flaw is in mechanics. I swear, when it comes to farming, most things are not so hard to get, but artifacts, which are indispensable for actually using a character you like, are so boring and tedious to aquire, you'll probably end up dropping the game after you have to farm for them. You should think over that Hoyoverse.

I played this game a while ago,and I loved it so much. The lore,the game play,the characters,the maps (except for semuru,i didn't like it too much,but i honestly liked all the other locations). However, there's only one critical issue. Storage. Like 40gb!? That's a lot. It's not a PC. I can no longer play the game and that pains me. Even the cloud requires an excellent connection in order to play it. My wifi is decent but apparently that's not enough. Please find a solution. I love this game.

Gameplay, controls, and the story are pretty enjoyable and easy to understand. Reminds me of other people's playthroughs in open world games like LoZ: BotW. Kinda wish I could customize the Main Character more... just to add a bit of personality like clothes, hair, etc. Still, it's pretty fun! Definetely recommend to those who enjoy open world RPGs with big storylines.

I started off truly enjoying this game. The open world immersion, character design, and in-game music are still top-notch. However... the high-pitched screeching of your "companion" Paimon becomes truly unbearable. Unskippable, meaningless dialogue is a major downside. Wuthering Waves (another open-world game) made me realize how simplistic the game's combat system is and how tediously slow it is to traverse the open world. It's become evident to me that I will not be returning to this game.

I played this game a lot, and I like this game a lot. When I hit Adventure Level 30, the difficulty spiked. Enemies started doing pretty massive damage, which on its own? No big deal. "Git gud." No pay-to-win ceiling or anything like that. But the janky controls and poor camera tracking made a really enjoyable game (probably the best mobile game I have ever played) so frustrating. Running the open world is still solid, but boss fights are almost unplayable. I might try PC, but I can't do mobile.

This game is very beautiful and addicting. Almost all small details are thought out there. But ... there is one very fat "but". - raising the level, and getting new quests, takes a very long time 🗿 I mean, of course, there must be some difficulty in achieving the goal in the game, but here it is so difficult to get to the new level that you literally live in this game. I deleted the game because it takes a long time and does not allow progress further.

Absolutely beautiful story line and graphics even though i now have two accounts due to my first being lost and just recently recovered. My only issues really is getting constant request to join my world instead of being able to turn it off (if there's a way to then in sorry), not much diversity in skin tones of characters, and mostly how annoying it is to get the base to make the weapons. Regardless keep up the amazing work i hope everyone has an amazing day/night!

I like this game. Definitely has so much potential. The graphic, the gameplay, the story mode, all greats. It can easily get 5-star rating. Unfortunately I'm not happy with the coop mode. Please allow others to help with the main quest too. Many improvement needed. I know its a new game. I dont expect much this early but please do something about the coop mode. This game have great a potential as MMORPG, dont waste its. Overall, it is best playing solo but not coop mode.

It's a beautiful game with an interesting and fun combat system, engaging characters, and who doesn't love open world exploration. However, the pull rates are atrocious. Mihoyo is possibly the stingiest with currency. Still can't get the character I want. On mobile, the camera constantly readjusts and zooms in which is annoying. It's also incredibly hard to play on mobile. On PC, it's impossible to remap the control keys and strafe is not where it should be. Good game, a little clunky to play.

The game, when you're playing it, is tons of fun. But characters can require hundreds of dollars to obtain. The game would be significantly more enjoyable (and I might drop some money on it) if I could wind up with some of the characters that seem most interesting for, maybe a quarter of that, at most. I recommend playing it and dumping it if you start feeling pressured to spend money.

This is best played on computer as it will take a lot of storage. A phone with 64gb storage will not do. Gameplay and story wise is very good. I have enjoyed playing through the story and exploring the lush environments and regions. There is a lot to explore and you'll be delving into world lore and hidden secrets. My bad point would be that rewards from events is not good compared to other gacha games (especially if you are coming over from Star Rail). Overall is good.

Nice game but not to play on mobile. It is not optimized. It takes too much space. I love the lore and the quests, but I'm not a big fan of the events. The co-op events are rare and too boring. There are some solo events very creative and fun, but sometimes it just seems they put some random fighting dg to fill the calendar. If you're more ending game, there are few ways to get gems making it hard to even try different banners if you are f2p.

Genshin is a love-hate relationship. The graphics, mechanics, and general story lines are lovely, as are the special events. However, the reward structure in terms of in-game currency makes it the most expensive gotcha-game on the market. I've played amazing games I don't live up to all again impact can offer but they were far better at rewarding its player base, especially those who pay for in game currency. I play this mainly on PS5 and will be taking a long break to explore other games.

So it's a really fun game, love the art and story line and style. The only thing that sucks is you can't really seem to beat bosses and quests without using half of the food you make and even then, you die most of the time. The quests are too hard to beat, so you try to ascend them, but some ascending bosses are too hard to kill because you're not strong enough. I've been at a plateau for the past 3 months trying to finish these quests and ascension but I can't because IM TOO WEAK! Ughhhh!

It's a great game. It reminds me of Legend Of Zelda Breath Of The Wild so much. The game mechanics are similar and this is one of my favorite games on phone yet. But there's an issue. Leveling up is so hard and takes a lot of time. And when you complete tasks it gives you so little amount of exp. That's why I have 4 stars.

No controller support for a dual stick game is a nightmare. The game came out on pc and ps4 with obvious controller support, but why not phones? Makes no sense. The game looks like a blast and have enjoyed playing what I've played, but the dual stick system is bad for touch controls. Hopefully it's added soon. Game has real promise and would love to support. Easily a 5* game if added.

I play on PC because this game refuses to load on my phone. The game overall is amazing, with one of the best elemental systems I've ever seen. It can be laggy on PC and takes up a huge amount of space. It is very large for a mobile game, and despite having uninstalled and reinstalled, changed phones, used WiFi ect it never goes past the loading screen. It is my favorite game but I don't see how playing on mobile is even viable considering the sheer size of the game.

I've been playing this game for over 8 months and i am ar 56 at which you could consider im in the end game. So far everything has been good. The story is intriguing and exciting and there is a lot to do with i think over 300 hours of gameplay. My only problem is: The wishing system/gacha system. Its hard to gather primogems to wish for example it may take up to an hour to finish a quest and be rewarded with only 40-60 primogems which is not even half a wish. This game needs some improvements.

Beautiful game visually. Although it fails to keep players hooked and becomes an absolute nightmare to new players, it's not well paced at all, and it's easy to become bored or burnt out. Nowadays, the updates have become huge. There is no way to find any more space on my pc for this and to think there are regions still coming in the future. Please find a way to lower the number of GB. It's insane.

The game itself is good, but bringing it to phones is a bit of a stretch. I set every option to the lowest and FPS to 60 and I still had an experience closer to 15 FPS. On an S10+ (although I do have the Exynos variant). Also drains the battery way too fast for some reason. Unplayable on mobile, great on consoles and PCs. Edit: anniversary is quite disappointing and not enough. Yoimiya's infusion is also not kept when stitching characters.

This is my second mobile review. The game is great, and for all of it's content, it deserves a five-star review, if not more. Unfortunately, a lot of that content is impossible to access to new players, (time event MAIN story parts, major mechanics and gameplay styles, and whole locations (a good third of the entire game)), and old players get to the "arrifact hell", a TIME-GATED, cruel, and utterly boring RNG-based grind that is worse and longer than by most MMO and looter-shooter standards.

Really really nice storyline and characters, overall gacha is not bad either, and the free characters are enough for you to finish the main storyline and events. Sadly some events are only accessible to players at a higher level and sometimes in a region that you haven't unlocked yet. The music, character designs, world, and lore all blend extremely well together. Easily one of my favourite games right now. There are some things I may like but I dont think they matter enough to be mentioned.

I highly recommend this game on PC, and maybe some newer mobile devices. I have a Pixel 3 though and there's lots hitching (fps drops), like barely playable if I am in combat. I get a temperature warning after about 20-30 minutes of play as well. I mainly use the mobile version of this game to do something real quick while I'm out, such as commissions, check expeditions, get daily rewards, etc.

It's a keeper for sure! Whatever it's doing so far hits the high-bar for all of them. Very detailed. The world feels alive and like the characters are part of it (important!). Awesome quality from music to puzzles (the combat too! I like lotsa characters and swapping them to solve combat puzzles - but not always having to - is great) and lore and SO MUCH MORE! If storage space becomes an issue, get a MicroSD. For couples, the co-op is decent and it seems they're adding another thing for it soon!

Amazing for whales or super casuals. For people that want to really get into a game, but aren't rich, stay away from this game. It's base gameplay is really fun, but it's designed around a 'mobile gacha' monetization system. You won't notice it too much at lower levels, (standard practice to lure you in), but once you're in too deep, they will time lock you from progressing. Putting things out of your reach and tempting you to refresh all the time. Also, the gacha itself is a bit P2W.

THIS GAME IS AMAZING, this game is so much fun I play it whenever I can!!! Edit: Still love this game but there are a few problems, it takes too much storage to be used on most devices. On chomebook (the only device I can currently use for this game) you cannot use the keyboard, only the touch screen. And as of now it crashes every time I attempt to start it. :(

Genshin is a great game mechanically. The art is great, the music is great, the gameplay is great. But the game itself is crippled by its stamina system which prevents players from progressing in the game at their own pace and effectively time gates players from being able to enjoy getting and building their characters because of their archaic resin system.

This game is one of the best games I have ever played. The story, the characters, the gameplay, all mixed up perfectly. I only have 1 complain: the storage. The "Delete Old Files" is certainly helpful, but it still takes up a large amount of space. So much so that once Fontaine relases, I might have to stop playing because of how much storage that will take. If you can figure out how to compress the Data Files and make them smaller, I think a lot more people can be able to experience it.

Player since day 1. Was fun to start, logged in daily. Now I barely log in at all. The motivation to explore is nearly gone. There's no challenge modes aside from the abyss. It's just too repetitive. The writing, mainly voiced cutscenes and character animations, can be jarring at times and ruins the immersion. Like most games, feedback you give is useless. There still is no controller support for Android. It's been years now. Compared to Star Rail, this feels like you get less for more.

In terms of mobile games, it's blazing a trail. In terms of PC games, it doesn't seem to know what it's doing. Going hybrid made this game famous but also keeps it from working at full potential. There's some difficulty spikes in random quests, and it is by far the stingiest gacha game I have EVER played. Anniversary event gives less rewards than the chinese new year event. I knew this game was greedy from day 1, but the fact that the rewards are actually less is insane.

I legitemetely don't understand how people give a 1 star review to such an amazing game which is totally FREE. Yes, there are transactions to help you get better equipment, which you can still get without having to pay anything. The map is already huge, with more to come in the next updates, which give many things to discover and solve. The story quests are incredible: the lore, the cutscenes, the cinematics with their respective epicness. Overall a greatly accomplised game with a bright future.

So ... The game is amazing but a bit glitchy . First of , the server sometimes breaks and I lost the chance to get items cause u get kicked out of the ruins and stuff . Second , the button to catch or pick up things is slow so I can't catch any butterflies , frogs or lizards . Third of all and the worse crime committed , the voiceovers are totally different from the text . I play the male twin but the characters kept calling me a "she" and calling my sister "the prince" and a "he" .

So fun and really entertaining. Love the auto options. So the only 2 negatives. I think the gyro aiming needs more ground coverage when in use. Enemies run and you are having to scrole and then you just end up fighting the gyro.. Also, i think this would be so much better if it were online. Doesnt have to get too crazy. Just a couple players to fill the story and missions. Great game otherwise. Would preffer to change weapons of the characters.

Phenomenal game, gacha system is unintrusive, and not required to enjoy the game, the pacing is good, combat system feels refreshing once you get the hang of how the elements interact with each other and mid combat swapping. I spend most of my time playing the ps4 version and started on my phone too so I can co-op with my kids. The only complaints I have so far after my first week is the lack of controller support for the mobile version, and the inability to customize the key mapping on ps4.

I wasn't sure what I would be getting into when downloading this game. I've been in search for a good rpg and have played many mobile games. A lot of them have false advertising and turn out to be a disappointment. That being said, this one so far is my absolute favorite. I can get sucked in for hours and for a mobile game, feel as though I have a console experience. I am really impressed with the open world feeling for a mobile game. And the graphics are something to mention too! Try it.

I would love to give this game 5 stars. It's fun, the art and graphics are excellent, the characters are likeable, the combat is fun and mostly satisfying. But I can't give a game that once you've played for a month or so, the game only allows you to play for about 15-30mins. The $10 battlepass is a joke, for completing it you literally have a 95%(according to in game wish details) chance to get a useless 3star item. They also only buff/fix paid units, so make sure you whale. Rip Amber

This game is super fun!!! Lots of quests and challenges and so many places to explore! Although I find this game fun I can only play it on my ps4 because it takes up too much storage, not to mention it is very hard to get characters, I want such as klee. I wasted so much money trying to get a character I want and still don't have it, so maybe you can add a shop where different characters can be bought for a limited time. This a really fun game thought!!!😊😊😊

Truely a remarkable game! I never thought i would get hooked by it's voice dialogue, humour, storyline and it's beautiful graphics with an animated theme. The field of view captured a whimsical feel and the way how light refractions was applied was beautifully done. At the start it looked dreamy and i thought that was is how the visuals looked (Only to find out that my settings at default were very low). I have a Xiaomi Mi Mix 2 so i raised it to max and i stopped...I just enjoyed the view.

Amazing mobile game! Lots of similarities with Breath of the Wild which is very impressive for a mobile game, hard to believe its free. Would easily be worth 10$ if it was a paid game. Graphics, combat, enemies, sound/music, and controls are all great! Not sure how good the story is yet but hands down one of the best mobile games right now. Only negative about it is some of the voice acting is cheezy and your sidekick fairy chick is pretty annoying. Definitely worth a try!

I played this game since opening and i really loved it. When Dragon Spine was opened at 1.2, it was simply amazing. But as time goes, it became chore. New areas were usually more the same, and i was doing the same thing in a bit different background. And only thing i could do was just grinding for nothing. Maybe cutting few seconds in spiral abyss was the only meaning of infinite grinding. Now I just got tired.

Genshin is a great and addicting game, but it'd be so much better if you could transfer game data on different servers or play with anyone around the world instead of your designated server. I've been playing for a few years now and it's quite enjoyable, that request would things 100% better! That's just one and the only little flaw it has. But other than that, everything is great! Community is very helpful with helping eachother out and the events are fun, would 100% recommend!

Still the best game I've played so far. So much adventures and playing it makes me really forget about the time. There's some features I wish the developers would consider making tho. I wish there were some monsters which can be tamed and be pets and will accompany and help the character thru fights. Also, monsters which can be mounted would be nice given that sometimes the map is too big to be explored by foot. That's it. I hopenthe developers would consider this. Than you.

I used to rate this game 5 stars, but lately it has been quite laggy. The loading screen will load in correctly up until the Geo symbol, where it would sometimes glitch from half to full. There are a few times where the game's OST would play in the background, but it would still display the laggy loading screen. Even after I tried uninstalling and reinstalling, it still had the same problem. I hope this issue is fixed soon!

Despite tons of hate towards this game. This game is actually good. The graphics push the limits of other mobile games.The small details in the game are amazing. like actually showing the gear that you're carrying. and many more like climbing anything. cooking foods that you scavenged from the forest. And gliding from high places etc. It has cross platform multiplayer. If you hate the game because of what other people in the inter net says. you know the saying "don't knock it till you try it".

I must say, normally, I would try to avoid games like this due to the "gacha" aspects. Genshin Impact has had my interest for years, though, and after watching many reviews, I decided to take the plunge. It is really good. Also, it does not push things (ex. Ads when you start up the program and almost constantly during gameplay) on you like other "gotcha" games, and there are many guides on how to play this game completely f2p (free to play). I have to say I'm very impressed.

I have been playing this game almost since it first released. Always has new events and content. It is multiplayer, but I mainly play single player because the coop is a bit lacking in my opinion. I just hope one day that part is a bit better. However it has great lore, fantastic storyline. All kinds of unigue animals. Boats you can sail, fishing, homes you can decorate, wings to glide.

The game itself is fine. But the one who is running it are the problem. there's no appreciation in the playerbase after a year of playing despite the fact that they earn more than any other gatcha games. There's no end game content up until now. There's really nothing to do after the resin is spent. No pvp, now war, coop sucks. There's really nothing to do other than upgrading your character.

Absolutely fantastic! I fell in love with this game and ended up playing pretty much every day. I have two play it on PC and the phone, genshin impact I say that the PC version is easier to maneuver. The story, art and music is great. I love the characters and even the NPC's detail. I finish playing this game for hours without interruption, because there is too much to do in this game. I do hope burning regen faster. Overall, I give this game 4.5 / 5!

It was fun for a while, but like with all gacha based games, it gets dull quickly - thanks to paywalls and tedious, grindy mechanics. It's a shame as it could easily rival other similar titles. It even has a cooperative mode, albeit unavailable for the story campaign, for whatever reason, which further harms the overall experience. It has everything else going for it, but they chose to limit its enjoyability for a quick buck.

The BEST RPG game I've ever played in my life!! I haven't been a gamer but this game changed me completely. It has astounding graphics, beautiful music, and exciting gameplay and stories. I love each and every character. And I love every little detail the developers put into this game. One thing that I may complain about is how difficult it is to play as an archer on mobile. Other than that, it's been an AWESOME experience for me!

I honestly think the game is still fun. Combat in particular is fast and simple, but still strategic and involves synergy (unless you have a character that is immensely OP). Story is amazing and has unforgettable characters, and it just keeps getting better as you progress. However, your enjoyment depends on the device and how powerful it is. If you feel there's not enough space or hardware power on your phone to support it, you're probably better off playing this on PC.

I've been playing this game for maybe 1y and I enjoy it, though it's extremely not perfect, this is the kind of game where you have to grind it (which can get exhausting) and the RNG of everything can be very unfair, but, the lore is amazing and the world is big and beautiful to explore, yes, it's not just the anime waifus, this game is actually good. I do have some issues with the phone version, I'm playing on Pixel 5 and I have a lot of connectivity issues and it constantly reconnects. 7.8/10

Edited : Amazing Storyline, Yeah, it's like an anime fairytale or animation. Graphics are really peaceful and map is broad enough. Moreover, items and foods or recipes designs are also cute. But this would be better if there was auto-fishing. Btw, background music and characters are the most perfect. When I started to download this game, I didn't think it would be that cool. I fully recommend this.💗🐰

Its amazing! The graphics, gaming,(etc) are great. I've seen a comment saying that you can't walk slow but you actually can, however I've only been playing on a mobile so I'm not sure about it on PC and others with keyboards. Overall great storyline but I would love it if we could get more primogems on the daily tasks thanks !! :D

Its an amazing game! The graphics are spectacular, the characters are interesting and the story line is really really good!! My only problem with this game is the lack of skin color. Even the "dark" characters aren't dark at all! They only look dark next to the other characters who are almost pure white. Other than that it is definitely a great game

It's overall a pretty good game but there are two things. One, it takes alot of space just to run the game in general I know its so the graphics are better and such I just feel it's abit excessive. And second, The ADS. the way they advertise the game in general is so just obnoxious and even abit annoying. The game doesn't have ads in-game I'm just talking about the advertising of the game on other platforms. Overall great game.

I love this game and use it as an opportunity to play with friends PS4 to pc to mobile alike. I find that aspect extremely pleasing. However, playing co-op isn't that rewarding unless you're stacked with resin because that's the most you can benefit in someone else's map. You also can't activate statues or go to the adventurers guild while in a co- op. Would make for a 5+ star game if the there were less limitations to co-op. Otherwise, it's still an amazing and fun to play game.

I do not play this for the gacha, despite it being a gacha game. I also do not play heavily on the phone, maining on PC. However, I've found Genshin Impact to be one of the few sweet surprises of 2020. With clean gameplay, puzzles, riddles, cooking, and enjoyable lore/books to find and theorize about, and tons of places to explore in only the first two regions given to us thus far, and a roadmap of content updates planned every six weeks, this is nothing short of extraordinary.

It took over 3 hours and upwards of 50 attempts to "download resources" in the app and actually install the game. That aside, this is clearly an awesome game after just a few hours of play. Fully voice acted, smooth combat, huge item and character variety, nuanced crafting and cooking... and from what I understand, there is no hard paywall whatsoever. This really is a triple A title for free. I haven't found the optional system to gamble on loot and pay for this game yet, but I will do it.

Nice to explore, decent graphics, and co-op is ok. Early game and after playing for a while sucks. You have to grind it you want to get far in the game. This makes the game repetitive in order to get primos (which are expensive to get) or to progress through the game. I don't like how the game itself takes up so much space which is an issue for many people. I also don't like how the game sometimes lags and sometimes heats my phone up.

Great Game. Great Mechanic, Theirs a gacha as well. the game just launch so maybe its normal that it has a bug. the only bug i can only see for now is on library where you need to collect the book. if you click the "sit" and the "item". while in its sitting animation. you will never get out on that chair unless you logout then login. also the cutscene are cery laggy, or usually freeze for short period of time. thats all.

I really tried to like this game. The gameplay itself is fine, but in a combat-heavy game like this, since the combat depends on the character, characters = content. Imagine playing Devil May Cry but we only get less than half of the weapons. So, more than half of the game's content is locked behind a undefined pay wall (because of the abysmally low gacha rates). I cannot recommend the game at all.

Early review Was gonna wait a while longer to review but the game prompted me so here i am. Beautiful game. The graphics are gorgeous and with the exception of an odd hiccup or two, runs phenomenally. However the world design and aetstyle feel very close to breath of the wild. The iron deposits ive come across look identical to the o nes in breath of the wild. I dont think this is necessarily a bad thing though, because the game still dots the world with its own touch often enough.

Absolutely breathtaking. Visuals, gameplay, music, story, all 5 stars there. The problem: resin and absurdly low gacha rates. I can't do much more than half an hour of meaningful co OP with friends due to the severely limited amount of resin per day, and I've done about 80 draws without a single five star character. I will change my review to 5 stars once either or both are fixed, because I otherwise adore this game.

I played the game on the computer before and let me tell you, it was beautiful. From the graphics to the gamplay, I loved it. Now the issue, I have a low compatible device which means I can download the game and have it on low settings and it works fine, but the issue is that game is too big. 24 gbs for a game. C'mon, y'all can make a game as stunning as this, but can't make a light version for low compt. devices. Y'all are better than that. So strive to be better.

Everything Is great accept the glitches. One glitch was that when I completed my commissions the game acted like I didn't even do it! It didn't gave the small rewards. I didnt get a story key. At least katherine gave the rewards but I should've gotten the rewards whenever you do a commission. I just wanted some extra primogems :( and I just wanted to do the hangout quest but I couldn't even do it.

An immersive, large ingame world. And the best part? Its open world. You're not locked to a line of locations, instead you can climb mountains, go fishing, fight enemies, and have a great time. Artifacts may only be the main problem, as there is always the difficulty of acquiring desired artifacts. Otherwise, this game is great in all sorts of ways, and it will set you back nothing to begin playing.

I've been playing this cane since almost one year and I must say the storyline GOOD. Everything is good understandable and everytime a character appears you get so hyped. I love the character designs and the style of combat. The side quests and world quests are all individual and overall much fun to play. However, sometimes the quests are just too hard and you have to search up an YouTube tutorial. At first it seems like a f2p game but it ends up free to pay. Otherwise you won't get characters.

Amazing. Great game play and movement. Would like the cut scenes to be a bit smoother on mobile since it stutters a bit. Other than that, truly an awesome game! Edit: Moved to PC, still an amazing game with story. Sure it is a gacha game with little guarantee for great characters but hey, you can still earn amazing items and characters too. Kind of wished they communicated more to the players.

I've played this game since release, and i loved it. Exploration of a beautiful world, amazing characters, interesting lore. But after you're done exploring and finished the quests... There's nothing. Late game is a never ending grinding hell, and that's it. There's nothing left to do. They keep releasing characters (worth hundreds of €, or months of grinding and saving) full of problems that they wont even address, the story doesn't make any sense anymore. The devs dont care and it shows.

I've been playing since launch, and have faithfully played until I hit the burnout wall for a couple months before Archipelago update. I've spent..way more than I like to think on this game, and I'm not terribly proud of that. Ultimately, this is a decent/good game. Great art, amazing visuals, fun. But the greediness from the gacha rates, the resin system, the artifact rng: its sucking the life out of the player base. Add in the lack of endgame content and the lack of rewards and its a disaster.

I've enjoyed this game for the past few years. The graphics and everything else is cool but as of lately it really does feel like a chore each day same things and having to do more and more exploration in each new region. Maybe you could make it easier to get 100% exploration in the next regions to be added without having to use YouTube or to go through map forth and back. Maybe you could make some gadgets that make it easier to find nearby hidden mechanisms like you did with chests.

The game has great graphics and story, but is frustrating to play without a controller (which is not currently supported on Android for some reason) while fighting or exploring the world. I would rate this app much higher if it did. It plays much, much better on PS4 with a controller or PC with mouse and keyboard.

ive played every single day for about 2 years. it stopped being fun after about a month or two and became all about the grind. and theres so much grinding and its always the same and its just so boring. the only good thing is the exploration and characters. you cant skip cutscenes or quests, and you HAVE to play them to unlock basically anything. overall, its very repetitive, boring, grindy and just wants your money. save your time and money. please. for your own sanity.

Version 4.4 has really shown how bad player retention rewards are in this game. It would be great if massive changes are to be made, so that even for filler patches, it would still be sustainable. Right now it's not worth playing if the rewards are so low. Chenyu Vale has really been a great experience, on the other hand, adds more to a character's companion lore.

This game so immersive and the characters are so charming. I've had a hard time finding a game that I like that doesn't play ads every few seconds, or even make me pay money right out of the gate. This game still has it, but I've played a week's worth and I haven't had any deals on in game upgrades shoved in my face. I also enjoy open world games so this was a perfect fit. There's a whole lot more little things I like about it, but I'll let you play for yourself!

So been playing this when it first came out. just never gone around to put a review(oops). This is probably my favorite game to play on my spare time. The story is amazing and love the character developments throughout the story. Given the controls will be a get to used to compared to pc but still top notch gameplay. I would highly recommend playing it. Doesn't force you to pay unless you can't help it xD. love that it's open world and you can create a base to decorate. Also love the n

I'm a huge fan of animes, especially fantasy ones. I love the style, the atmosphere and the open world exploration, you feel like you have seen everything, but the map is so big that you can't help but keep running around even when your main objective is sidelined by something else and enemies to fight with. Best part is that the game is not pay to win. I recommend the game to anyone who wants to kill some time. By some time I mean hours, good job guys.

Gameplay, graphics, events, carachters and features are almost great but the main negative point is that the archon quests which are about the main story, are not designed completely and the game is open-ended. Also, it is not known that how long it would take to be completed. This matter disappointed me regarding to the amount of time that I spent to find out what happened to the lost sibling and where is the next station after Fountain.

Have been playing since launch. Overall very well-made and enjoyable. Always things to do, although the endgame content itself is still somewhat minimal. The events are somewhat hit or miss although most are worth your time and actually add to the story/flesh out the game world more. Being a gacha game, it can seem very predatory but if you put in the work, you can do very well without spending any money. Needs more multiplayer options and character diversity, badly. A 4.5* experience overall.

Very good graphics for a mobile game but still not on par with the PC version. Interesting lore/story which is the main reason that I play this game (yeah there are some mid quests but overall still great)For characters, you will need to save up some primogems to be able to get the character you want, there's also a pity system, which is okay. The artifact system (RNG) is kinda bad as it requires a lot of grinding and there is no guarantee that you will get a good one.

It's a perfect game. You can pay to get further along faster if you want, but it's a single player experience, no leader boards or bp ranks to pressure you into dumping cash into it. The drops are very generous. Not super grindy because of the exploration aspect to the game. I would like the big bosses to spawn more often maybe like twice a week or even an event where you get more respawns, etc. But overall it's well made, not super grindy and has plenty to keep you interested. 5/5

Okay so the game is awesome super fun. What's wrong about it is that the gacha system is kinda rigged with the whole 50/50 thing. I've been working my butt of for a month and didn't even get the character. Also if you're on phone and your phone is not very good you may have, no grass, bugged dvalin and you can't see when you do damage or when you freeze water. There are many more. Bugs that make the game unplayable. It also very laggy. It stops and my phone heats up super hot like a heater.

I rarely review anything, but given the fact that this game has brought me so much joy i decided to do so. The game is well polished, and its beautiful. Buuuut, sadly it seems to have an incomplete story(update coming nov 10) and the current late game is slow, repetitive and sadly stale. The gacha system is very unfair sometimes and getting the characters you want might prove to be a challenge. However i recommend people to play it and see if its for them. /End

Ok Iove the game just had to uninstall it due to the amount of space it took up. Does it have to take up so much space I think it was all ready over 20gb by the time I uninstalled it. And I just can't seem to get the hang of fighting, also keep getting jumped by stronger enemies when exploring (and dieing to them) but overall the game is really good

With the jaw dropping graphics and good gameplay for a phone game, I could see myself playing more ofter. However, there's one thing that hold's me back playing more and it's the lack of controller support for android. Since v1.3, GI would add controller support for mobile platform. Only to found out iOS only got it first and I thought android would come later for a while. 2 or 3 years later, android has stll no controller support. Add it and I might gave this game 5 stars.

I love Genshin impact. I've played for years and the story is so captivating. I love the game play style. The reason it's 4 stars instead of 5 is because of ALL THE DIALOG!! I personally don't mind it (too much), but a ton of players have problems with it. At the beginning of the game, it was short bits of dialog, and now it literally takes me hours to get through it all. All I ask is for it to be a little shorter or for a skip button for us. I still love the game though. <3

Been playing abt a year. I love this game sm and I'm very attached to a lot of things about it, especially the characters. But I have to say things can get a bit boring when you've done all the main quests and at some point it just becomes repetitive, even with the events, but that's expected for a game that's still in continuous development. Regardless, one of my favourite games that I've spent way too much time on, but had fun anyway.

I really do love this game so very much and I love how I have progressed and it gives you an option of exploring more of the map before you get past the story's. My problem is my 4 level 44 characters cant finish the ascension temple at all. Ive been trying for 2 weeks, wasting hours getting ingredients to make food to stay alive. But my attempts are every other day for 2 weeks on ps4 and it wont let me pass it. The timer on the electric cube guy just runs out. I just want to keep playing

Overall a good game. I just hate how I can't play with the same Account on Pc or PlayStation or even log out from PlayStation so I can play with another Account. Thought this game is you can play with your Account everywhere but it seems like it's a no 🤷🏼‍♀️ another thing is that you can't play with a controller on the phone.. really annoying because the controls on the phone are very annoying, always click the wrong things, for example instead of sprinting my char is hitting..
