For others looking for a game to sink their time in - there is nothing left to do in the game once you've completed all the story content (which won't take any more than a month at most - even at a casual level). Although you can play with your friends, there is nothing meaningful in doing so as you'll quickly get bored wandering around doing nothing.

The game is really good and fun to play but it almost feels like the game is punishing you for being free to play in later stages. I know it's a way to deter you from being free to play or incentivise you to buy primogems but I feel like it can be demotivating for players. If power creep starts to set in this will become even worse and the game will become only truly accessible to older players who whale or are really lucky. All in all this game is really fun and has great mechanics.

Holy. Crud. I waited for this game to come out, waited for the download then had to wait and wait and wait for the servers to open. And I was NOT disappointed! It's amazing! The storyline is fantastic, the graphics are console quality and it's just... holy cow! It has puzzles, combat and more. Very Zelda breath of the wild-ish so far but not the same in any way at the same time. I am completely hooked! And not one ad so far! Haven't even hit a payroll or had things demand I buy anything!

So far this game is amazing. A little stuttery on my Galaxy S9+, but I do have my settings on high, so I get it. Still though, cross-play on console and PC with a mobile game? And one with this kind of quality no less? Plus, it's a gacha game mixed with moba elements that sounds, plays, and even FEELS like Breath of the Wild. I am THOROUGHLY impressed so far. Haven't gotten any 5 stars yet, but I've only done a couple summons so far, so we'll see. Looking forward to the game's rapid growth.

While well made,beautiful and fun, the game takes up too much time to be a nice side time investment. Pulling a new character doesn't even hype me because of how long it takes to farm them up - exp,skill levels, weapon, relics. Demanding 2 Teams for Abyss seems rather harsh, especially with the changing elemental advantages. The gacha also doesn't feel as satisfying as the other Hoyoverse games.

EXCEPTIONAL. It's like breath of the wild, skyrim, and warframe had a baby that runs PERFECTLY on my phone and ps4. I have an account on each one I play every single day. I'm hooked. I really can't say enough good things about it. The gameplay feels rewarding at every level from combat, to funny dialogue, leveling up, and finding loot. It's just pure fun on a bun.

Anniversary hate aside, the early game is rewarding. That said, the complete opposite happens after you clear the first chapter and leaves a lot to be wanted with how rushed the story can feel especially with the civil war setting in Inazuma feeling like it was rushed for the sake of being pushed out on time and and the islands added don't feel lived in with the amount of empty space and lack of story telling from NPCs to add in richness and depth. There is definitely room for improvement with how sparse and empty the rewards are for players that have already completed the currently available story, and the shallowness that is the gacha with the abysmal rates with characters and weapons being in separate banners to maximize profits over providing the player with options to avoid the fear of missing out. It's good for a short while, but not good for prolonging the experience they have planned for the next 4 years with how quickly the gameplay loop becomes overly repetitive after the start of the game.

Been playing since 2021. the lore, the characters, the exploration, everything is amazing. I didnt want to play it at first because its gacha, but the game is much more than just a gacha game, of course i cant explain it in a review, but id definitely try out it for yourself. The only issue is how many gb it takes up, it takes up close to 30 gb on my phone. the game lags a lot, as well as my phone. Which can be so annoying. i still think it is worth it though 😅

From the intriguing story, the emotional soundtrack, the beautiful landscapes, and the diverse characters, Genshin Impact is definitely the best free game I have ever played. The amount of effort that is being put into it is phenomenal, and I enjoy it a lot. There are a few cons, such as it's rather brutal gacha rates, but the pros outweigh the cons by a TON. The game itself is an awesome rpg and it has very fun mechanics. One of the highlights for me was the soundtrack. It's amazing! It is a gacha game, but it is possible to f2p. I play mostly on pc and recommend to play that version if you are able since it is a superior experience. The mobile version still gets the job done for a good experience as long as your phone can handle it. It is a very intesive game, so phones with budget specs probably won't cut it.

It's beautiful and deep, and they've put a lot of work into the lore and battle systems. But the gacha is punishingly unrewarding, and free to play is way too slow and unfun to be worth it. I just finished the prologue, which is actually quite long, and can't wait to find out more about the story!

The time between events is filled with long grinding but when managed, the game is loads of fun. My only gripe with the system is the resin system which has been a constant since the game's inception. The game is not what it used to be. This is, by far, the best Mobil RPG I've ever played. The story and voice acting are fun and engaging. The game is good n all until u will be notified about the error 4206 or this "connection timed out" error. As of someone who played Breath of the Wild, and Honkai Impact 3rd, I will write this review. If you haven't played Breath of the Wild, this game will be great!. Stunning graphics, fluid movements, fun combat system that requires combination of elements from different characters, fully voiced dialogues (very well done as well), good character designs, and many more. This is a well made game indeed but there are several things people might not like (a bit more for those who played Breath of the Wild). First of all, this isn't a fully complete game. It is considered as a mobile game that will have contents updated in the future. The overall playtime of this game is about 30 hours (shorter if you are only doing the main story quests). You have daily quests and material dungeons that you play for about half an hour each day. Other than that, there isn't much to do after you complete the game. Second of all, despite the fact that this game is on mobile, pc, and console, it is advised to play on PC. It is really inconvenient to play on mobile (you cannot control your character well as much as you can normally do on PC or console). Not to mention that the loading time is a bit long on console compared to PC. Third of all, this is gacha infused game. You roll gacha on the characters and equips. The rate is really really bad. There is a guaranteed 5 star pull every 70 pulls. Expect to spend at least 400 dollars for something you really want (possibly more if you are unlucky). However, you are not required to do gacha. Every contents of the game are free and you can enjoy everything even with the free characters and weapons (although having more characters and weapons do make the experience easier and quicker). Lastly, this is for those who played Breath of the Wild. This game is basically like Path of Exile who got their inspiration from Diablo 2. That is the grey area for this game. A lot of things (the way how puzzles are done, climbing, swimming, motions of the characters, stamina, layouts, some of the designs and graphics) are very similar to Breath of the Wild. This game is more of Mihoyo's own interpretation of Breath of the Wild. If they were to make Breath of the Wild, this is how they would have done it. This game is basically Breath of the Wild + Honkai Impact 3rd. Although this game isn't a complete rip off, if you played the Breath of the Wild, you will most likely think that Breath of the Wild is superior compared to this game. Overall, this is a good game. Fun game. However, it is incomplete and comes with its own limitations. I would strongly recommend this game to those who didn't play Breath of the Wild and strongly advise people who played Breath of the Wild not to play this game.

It can be really laggy on mobile but the storyline, open world exploration, and abundance of unique characters makes up for that. There's something for everyone, whether you prefer rpgs, brute force combat or strategy and team building. To top it all off, there are new storylines, playable characters and mini games released almost monthly. Could not reccomend this game more.

Possibly the best mobile game out right now, is it feels like console quality game. It's pretty free to play friendly so far after playing since it released and haven't spent a time. You can purchase the items to summon new heroes with in game items and the game gives you free heroes as you play the story that get the job done for anything you need to do in game. My complaint so far is the loot boss item system and limiting co op.

character design has become increasingly more boring for team building and very lazy powercreep without increasing the number of wishes by any substantial amount is absurd qol is abhorrent compared to other gacha games like no skip button and it has started to burn me out from playing this game it used to be my favourite

Good game. Greedy company. They have made so much money and refuse to give back to the players in any significant way. I've gotten burnt out on the game for a while now, and when I see news about new characters, all I think about is how much money I'd have to spend to get them. Unless you want to spend tons of money, or save up primogems forever and skip a bunch of limited time banners, good luck trying to get 5 star characters or weapons any time soon.

As much as I love this game, it has quite a few issues - especially for Adventure rank 45+ people. There isn't enough content anymore no matter how much you tried staying away from speedrunning the game. The resin system NEEDS to be fixed. 8 minutes for a single resin is way too much. There also isn't a non-limited way of getting the currency needed for summoning characters/weapons, which makes the game very unfair. Lastly, the cost of genesis crystals is just simply too high. It's been a YEAR.

This is an Excellent game by all means. I have never once experienced any issues with it. But reading other reviews allows me to say. If you have an underpowered device, that is out of date. This game is not for your device. I recommend playing this game on console, PC or a high powered mobile device with a gamepad. This game in all honesty, should not be mobile. Despite thesw issues, in many ways I'd compare this to "Legend of Zelda: Breath of the wild." If it were an Anime and JRPG that is.

I'm a huge skeptic of gatcha games, and free to play games in general, but Genshin impresses on every front. A huge world to explore, interesting stories to tell and a fast-paced combat system that keeps you on your toes. The gatcha elements aren't too overbearing either. You earn a good amount of currency just by playing and exploring, so you won't hit a paywall any time soon. Highly recommend, even to skeptics like me.

Fantastic game, but you best be prepared for the gacha mechanics... Gameplay, storytelling, and aesthetic are all great, and there's so much content that there's something for everyone. But i do wish the monetisation model was better. Don't expect to get the 5* characters unless you're willing to throw serious money at it or grind multiple seasons to spend those hard earned primogems

Great game. Definitely not as bad as some people make it out to be. The game has a bunch of weird climbing glitches. It has major updates usually about once a month. Game play is great. If you're looking at this post on Google play and you have a PS5 or A PS4, do not install Genshin on your mobile device! It is way better on Playstation. =) Note to dev: It would be awesome if having a Playlist of different songs were possible in the Serenitea pot.

The story and music is good. But in terms of artifact farming? Waste of time. I've been playing for almost 3 years now and I barely got a good set. Games should not be this frustrating to equip your character with good stats. I hate to compare it with other gacha game but Genshin is by far the worst game regarding farming equipment for your character. Why not make it even by increasing resin cap or the time you're going to use resin is when you see a good artifact. Its like cashing out the item.

It was fun while it lasted. But apparently over time, in my opinion, the developers ignored the feedbacks and the voices of the players. I loved it really, it was a great game when they just released the game officially, lots of love, lots of interaction etc. But gradually as the game became more successful and popular, they focused more on obtaining more profits which is fine, but at the cost of disregarding the players. They were actually considering the players' feedbacks and voices before but let's just say that it has been an ample amount of time since they last actually "listened" to what players want, which would actually increase their profits even more! But except, they didn't. Overall its a fun game if you just started out. But once you devote yourself like commit to play it for a long time, welp you are definitely on your way to a massive disappointment. Happy Anniversary Genshin Impact!!!

The #1 anime gacha game on the market. Unfortunately, unless you're packing an extremely powerful device, the experience will not be as delightful. The sheer size of the game will take up a lot of space as well. This is possibly the best mobile game ever conceived, but only if you have the equipment to run it. I would reccomend playing on anything but mobile for a far better experience. This particular version gets docked a star for being way too much for the average person's phone.

I love this game, really. I love the storyline, characters, graphics, etc. But the reason why I'm giving 3 stars is: Security problems. I've seen a lot of accounts getting hacked and deleting stuff. Grinding artefacts, materials, etc wasn't easy, man! People are spending a lot of money on this game and it is terrifying to know that one day, your efforts are gone by a random hacker. PLEASE don't continue on ignoring this issue. We want our accounts to be safe. Is that too much to ask?

This game starts off great. Good leveling, nice combat, good amount of premium currency. After 40 hours though everything changes. You are limited to 4 quests and 3 bosses a day for leveling and you only get 1 chance at a legendary hero (which is 0.6%) every 4 days. To reach level 45 from 30 it takes months unless you decide to put hundreds and thousands of dollars in the game.

I used to love this game, and I still feel such adoration for certain aspects, but I don't like the direction the game has gone in. I loved the fantasy world, and the magic and lost technology, but now there's modern and even futuristic content that I can't stand. Someone has a motorcycle, another character is just videogames. Like the concept. The power creeping is annoying, but the random sci-fi is much more so. Magic is gone in the ways that matter.

An amazing game. Well written story, a wide variety of characters to play. You're able to play whomever you want and build them as you want. Though, there are some downsides, end game play feels like a chore with little to nothing to do outside of that unless you have friends who play the game with you. Aswell as with the release of Sumeru just around the bend, the lack of skin tone variety within the characters from Sumeru (beleived to he based around east Asia).

They put less time into this game than they do any of the others they have created. It's clearly used as a way to test what will work better in the future for their other games. Characters start to reuse animations from other models. they are lazy with some story elements. One of the most anticipated characters of the year is just a letdown. Some of the new events have been atrocious. It's sad to see what could be a good game get so little love by the developers.

I thought this would be just another gacha game like the rest, and it is, but it's also so much more that I soon fell in love with it. It is sumptuously beautiful, and while the gacha mechanisms are present, the game is very friendly to free-to-play players, and the developers clearly do not stint on the artistry. It's multi platform, and I have been very impressed by the mobile experience ever since my computer gave up the ghost, even though it's right at the limit of what my phone can handle.
very good game i don't have a high end phone so game doesn't have super graphics but still it's a fun play

Ah, Genshin Impact. What a fall from grace. I've been playing since 1.0, and up until relatively recently, this has been not only a great mobile game, but one of my favourite games of all time, but all good things must come to an end, and Genshin Impact's time has come. The publishers have become increasingly greedy, and as a result, the recent characters have turned into a content island in the name of power creep. The game isn't what it once was, and as such, I can no longer recommend it.

I love this game, it's so much fun exploring and fighting bosses and monsters/enemies everywhere but I have a big problem with the poor skin representation there is in here. everyone is extremely pale. don't just make npcs and enemies tan, that's very weird. make more tan playable characters and even some dark skinned ones for once. kaeya and xinyan are not enough. give us more diversity. I'm very disappointed in the lack of skin diversity and will not spend money anymore because of this.

While I am playing this game more because I cannot quit due to my monetary and time investment.. it is a well-made game. Music is great, beautifulI environments. No matter if you are playing seriously or casually, be smart with your money. Figure out what you want before going for characters. The story is good at times but it is wordy and involves minor NPC characters that do not make reappearances. Good game, but be careful with spending. It is a gatcha game at the end of the day.

It... It has a lot of problems. To summarize, it's an open-world gacha (that means semi-pay2win) RPG that wants to be an MMO yet the existing gameplay is sorely lacking. The main draws to this game are the characters, the story, and the world, and as far as those go, they're great! But after AR 25 the gameplay is just grind, grind, grind, and... There's just not a lot to do in the game itself. You also can't do quests in co-op, only bosses, so why bother playing with your friends at all?

Don't get all the complaints. It looks great, runs great and it's fun. Really, a masterpiece of a game. I do, of course, have reservations regarding end game considering Mihoyo's reputation with other games. Paywall seems likely as does limited progression if you aren't rocking 5* gear and characters. That aside is totally free and by the time that happens I will have gotten many hours of enjoyment from it.

I used to love this game, it was fresh, new, and free on mobile. As someone who can't afford Zelda, it was a game changer for me. But it's disappointing that as time went on, every decision and lack of meaningful changes has made the game both feel bad and predatory. The last straw is when they started locking exploration behind premium characters. Sure there are alternatives to exploring the lands, but if they deliberately make it harder to traverse without said characters is messed up.

Please stop deleting my review. The game is beautiful the storytelling is good, the character design, most of them are very good. HOWEVER seriously, after playing 1 year of this game, I don't recommend it to anyone else, the game lack content, the company cares more about their pride and face, money and their "good" publicity more than what the mayority of player wants, so yeah if you want a game that's good looking but lack of content, and the company doesn't core about you, go ahead.

I've been playing this game everyday for a year and a half now. I play for about 30 minutes on weekdays and a couple of hours on weekends cos there is a new limited time event every two weeks or so. I love everything about the game so far. I never experienced any of the performance issues from other reviews. I'm a dolphin range spender but I don't spend in games until i know it has good returns and that it is playable even without spending a dime. The lore goes deep and wide

This game has been great and there has been so many characters released in the last year since it's release a year ago all still remaining free to play, it has more gameplay hours than any AAA game i can think of. It's an insanely good value for anyone who enjoys action rpgs and cell shaded goodness.I don't play it as much as i used to, the events often feel unimportant or the rewards aren't too worth the amount of time spent, but i still log on every week and get some good playing in. At the higher levels, getting a new fresh character to the same speed as your current roster takes a lot of resources which are locked behind instanced content or bosses which can take a while to farm up. It's definitely a grind, but I'm sure anyone can just enjoy the simplicity of the combat or the exploration aspects which shine in this game as it's very bright and nice to look at. It's definitely the best looking mobile game and it's a very high budget project from miHoYo that continues to deliver daily/weekly content to it's players. You can play for free or spend a little bit of money if you want a chance at getting more characters to play with, but it's definitely not necessary. But after you sink 1000+ hours into a game that has kept you company for an entire world pandemic, maybe they deserve a little something for their effort. review over, time to complain about the "fan base". Came out at a great time, got too popular and now all the entitled fake fans are coming out of the woodwork to try to take the game down, as if downvoting and twitter posts mean anything, coming from idiot children. This generation of internet users just doesn't appreciate anything any more, nothing will ever be good enough for them. But all they gotta do is just shut up and everything will be fine in the long run. They'll stop caring about this in a few days when the next drama episode happens. Get over yourselves.

Great game so far. In comparison to Nino Kuni, Breathe of the wilds, and other related games it is definitely on par, and its free! I am enjoying the world and art very much, the characters and game play are fluid but i find the fps slows down a lot during fights, i do have an upgraded phone so I know it is the games issue, that would be my only complaint so far. Would also love to see other players in game, as it does feel like a huge lonely world without others. 4.8/5

Easily the game of the year! Amazing storyline, fun gameplay, and incredibly beautiful artwork at a free to play price. You'll hear a lot of criticism targeting gacha games, but the truth is you're the player and it's you who decide if you enjoy a casual or competitive pace. Edit: Played from launch and it's still at the top of my list, beating all other mobile games I've tried since

The gameplay is fun and can be played without paying. I have two specific issues. The first is the gacha pull rate is incredibly low compared to other games. You have to spend serious money for each character. I understand it's a gacha, but it's hard to even make a first purchase when you know it's like dropping a dollar in a well. Second issue is graphics on the Google Pixel tablet. My Pixel 6 is less powerful and the game runs better there than on the tablet, which runs other games great.

This is a hard game to score. Everything about playing it great, cross save to PC is amazing but it runs pretty well on mobile too. Unfortunately the monetization in this game is absolutely horrible, currency is earned very slowly if you are f2p and Gatcha rates are some of the lowest I have ever seen, it is almost impossible to get a 5* character without spending literally thousands of dollars worth of currency. At the moment 4* are very usable but we will see how long that lasts...

You really can't recreate your first time experiencing the world of Teyvat, and I had a blast. The graphics and characters and cutscenes are really incredible. My problem comes with tedious artifact farming as well as struggles getting 5-stars past C1 for better efficiency (requiring a LOT of grind time or in-game purchases), which is why I've put this game to rest. But if you're willing to look past all that and the storage requirement, then go right ahead!

Amazing game for a few days, until you run out of things to do other than grinding chests for experience. At that point you realize almost all of the gatcha currency is from freebies and one time rewards and if you rolled you won't be able to get any new characters thanks to the gatcha rates, 0.6 for 5* and 6% for 4*, that's also shared with weapons. It's a shame because the game has some amazing potential but as of now play for a few days and drop until next big update.

Idk if ya'll read this but i have to say this somehow. This is the best in terms of gameplay and visuals. But I would MUCH rather spend on arknights or honkai for 2 reasons. 1st, rates. It is much more realistic to get a character on those games by spending. When u have to pay the equivalent of a triple A game to get a character, it discourages more than anything. The currency income is too low for a 0.6 rate, pity or not. 2nd, resin. Its pretty obvious here. Too little. Needs more refills.

Overall, this is a great game. Combat is fun and creative, and the world is fun to explore. The issue is that the game isn't that friendly for F2P. You can still complete the game, but the fun is summoning characters, and the game doesn't give that many gems even when you buy them. They should give enough gems, so you can do at least 1 roll a day, and a daily login reward

Customer service for the game is painful. They'll talk in circles and eventually just say "sorry, it's been so long there's nothing we can do about it now". The game itself runs pretty horribly on mobile and takes up basically the entire internal storage. The gambling mechanics are pretty lousy with win rates being horribly low. Creature comfort updates take forever to get released. And finally the game doesn't care about player feedback.

Update after some more time playing it. Graphics, gameplay and story are still great, but the big problem is the stamina system (resin). In half an hour you'll have done everything you can do and drained your stamina, and there's nothing really to do while it regens - one point every 8 minutes and you'll need 20 at a minimum so 2.5 hours wait to run a dungeon or ley line. 7.5 hours wait to run a boss. So far I'm still enjoying roaming and seeing the sights while waiting, but that'll fade.

i love this game, the story is so interesting, the characters, gameplay, designs, exploration and everything... but the one bad thing is, the artifact system. building characters is already hard, and when the domains keep giving the set we don't want, it sucks the joy from us, the players. you need to fix it. because I've been trying to farm tenacity artifacts for furina for months now, it keeps giving me pale flame set. this is just an example. anyways, overall, the game is amazing.

It's a very enjoyable game! I like the story and the characters; the graphics are amazing and the music is calming and relaxing. But the updates take too much storage so I ended up deleting the game because I don't have a enough storage. If you could make downloading updates voluntary so that when a player finishes a part of the game, he can delete it and download some of the updates as much as his storage permits. It's better than forcing players to download updates in one go in order to play.

I want to give this game 5 stars. I have waited a long time for it and I'll continue to play it until I've burnt myself out. The reason I havent given it 5 stars is due to no controller support on the phone. The pc allows it, as does the ps4. I understand programing and coding is a tedious job and I can only imagine the work the creators have with the games release. However, controller gaming is a big part of mobile gaming. If they ever add it ill change my review.

Very expensive. This game is heavily reliant on grinding and farming. You need to invest quite a bit of time to complete story and quests which in turn, are used to unlock the characters via gatcha. Even so, this game has more salt than another gatcha game such as fate grand order, at least in fgo, characters are more easily acquired. Genshin is overall a big investment of time with little payout, if you want characters then you'd probably have to pay out of your pocket eventually.

Would enjoy it more if it was a game I bought rather than a gacha game. Low rates and few ways to get premium currency. They keep adding limited characters. If you're f2p and a completionist, this game will make you cry. The base game is fine, fun even. It is a botw clone with rpg elements. The graphics are gorgeous. It is by and all, a very well crafted game. If you don't care at all about the gacha aspect, the gameplay should be enough for you.

Another year has passed, and I just want to say that this game is really good—the gameplay, story, and most of its features. But HoYoverse? No, they're as stingy as ever. You can’t get enough Primogems, even with Welkin and the Battle Pass—it’s still not enough! They should add more items. I just don’t understand how they can treat players like this, especially those who actively promote and follow the game.

The characters and story line are great, and I like how deep the lore is getting. I really love the events and that they happen often. I really love the music too. You can freely explore Teyvat and hunt, fish, etc. It is also kind relaxing. Also you can build your own home! I also like how you can farm for a characters meterials and so on. Also the fact that we can be f2p(free 2 play) earn primos for wishing on character banners. I don't really like how much storage it's taking up tho lol. :D

No game is perfect, but Genshin Impact does set a high bar for future gacha games to compete with. It has tons of detail, the world is fun to explore, and the story and characterwork is great stuff. The only thing I take issue with in the game is the Gacha system, but I can forgive it somewhat. Characters are much more developed in the game. They're not just PNGs or stats. And I think it sort of justifies it compared to other "friendlier" gachas where what you pull for isn't exciting at all.

I recommend this game if you want to play it for the natural scenery stories but if you are interested in strong characters it is a total garbage game because the random system does not give you any characters at all. I gave this game 5 stars because everyone should read this review but 3 is too much

Genshin Impact has very good story and character designs, and has seen a recent increase in writing quality. Gameplay is fairly good as well. However, the game currently lacks a good endgame content system to fill in the gaps between events. The gacha is not very harsh in my opinion, and building characters is also not as bad as it may seem. I highly recommend the game for its story and characters alone. I suggest not grinding through the came though, keep it casual and you will have more fun.

If you look to have fun and to look at nice graphics and characters, then this game is for you. Best one for mobile open world so far. Everyone complaining about the huge prices is just too lazy to grind and to have fun. Artifact system? Yeah could use drop rate increase, but for the rest. This game needs patience and endurance. The game uses too much storage? Buy a better phone. Problem solved :)

This gacha game is unique in the sense that you don't need to pull for the "best characters"- it's a single player game, and the elements mechanic matters more than what character you use when it comes to combat. I've gotten through the first story chapter in liyue with two of the free characters they give you for free (Kaeya and Lisa) with ease. Artifacts matter more than characters, and those are farmable. I can't wait for more updates.

You'll get addicted, simple. (It's free but hehe I've use about $100 on this game, but I only have a few characters, you need to be committed. And after AR50 it becomes depressing(as in, it becomes boring but not completely) but this game tbh is the best game, you'll fall in love with the characters or maybe even relate to them in some way, there's an amazing co-op system, that if you are struggling to defeat a boss(which you definitely will) other players will help :) I recommend %100000000

Happy non-iversary! The game is a very stingy gacha game that doesn't hand out many resources for free. Summoning currency, materials, artifacts, everything is rare or expensive to buy. Many hoped the anniversary would come with QoL updates or at least rewards - it doesn't. And worst of all: the game gets barren very quickly. It's fine if you have the story, but once you're mid to late game, there's just nothing to do.

At first, it's fun but as you peogress more and more, it's boring. Plus, it takes up way too much storage on mobile. Even if my phone was brand new, nothing else downloaded, my phone struggles to work properly. Honestly would appreciate it if genshin was also added to xbox one to the newer series. At least they can handle the amount of storage genshin has. Besides, it'll get more players as many probably don't want to get a whole new console (ps4/5) to play.

"Gacha" wallet handy? While the game is one of the more accessible for f2p players, you will eventually hit a road block where you can almost guarantee you will never pass unless you pay for pulls to upgrade your characters or wait until some new event gives you free pulls. World is fun, story is interesting, the characters are varied and fun to engage with. If the gacha elements weren't so necessary to experiencing the later parts of the game, I would rate it higher.

Great play style, especially for a mobile game, beautiful art. Gacha is a bit pricy though, and not a lot of chances to roll daily, for get about getting multiples of 5* chars limited time without spending some money. Updates are also a tad slow, and there isn't much story yet. Events are well paced though but the rest of the game gets a bit boring once you hit AR45-50 and the map is completely explored. It's a mobile game but main story line is pretty limited right now.

This game is great. The sounds, the animation and the open world are truly beautiful. The combat system could use some work. The gacha in this game is beyond ridiculous. Earning primogems is extremely difficult (for me at least.) you can either farm by doing daily quests, which I think is 20, and there's only 4 daily missions. Another way is be doing side quests, if they give any primo, or playing the story. A summon ticket costs 160,i Think, primogems so you do the math.

First off, great gameplay, loads of content, lots of minigames and features. Good characters, voice acting, story, setting, world. A well done.... single player game?! coop is abit let down and I hope they make the players share loot equally no matter where they go. 4 player is fine though, just the fairness of distributing the loot. Currently it feels like a single player rpg getcha game which makes the open world feel empty. and lonely cause lack of coop features. if it improves then 11/10!

Mostly Well-Designed: I would have given this game something closer to five stars, but the fact that it isn't easy to sync your account between all of your devices really turns me off. I don't want to play two separate accounts across mobile, pc, and console. Maybe that's something that can update in the future, but I'm not technically inclined to surmise so.

Just. Fun. Stuff. It's just fun. Take your time though as I hear people who plug the game get burned out after hitting the end game so early on in the life of this game. Finally, mobile games are becoming good! Random rolling for characters still a pain in the ass but it's not as insidious as some titles where the character grind is almost not worth unlocking a new character. I've genuinely wanted to try playing every character so far.

The game is beautiful and probably the most solid MMORPG I played on a mobile device. For a free game it's done very well. This is definitely one of those games that gives you a good bit of content and new characters. I will say the developers did a good job of allowing you to get primo gems to do a do pulls here and there. However, with that being said the drop rates hurt my soul.

The game has been out for nearly 5 years now. There are a lot of QoL features that players have been asking for like artifact loadouts and a skip button that still haven't been implemented. The company knows this but they won't implement it for whatever reason. Also, the exploration feels slow, tedious, and frustrating at times especially if you don't have characters like yelan, wanderer, or kazuha. There is not really anything that would motivate me to play the game at the moment

Actually good f2p game on the phone. This is a rarity indeed. My only complaint is that it drains my battery fast and heats my phone up but that's probably more to do with my phone than the game. (An actual game on a phone? One I don't have to call an app?!) As a console player, I'm pleasantly surprised. The hype more than lives up to its expectations. I thought I'd struggle with the controls and while it's much different than a controller, it's not that bad. Very much recommended.

It's a beautiful game with really nice lore and wonderful characters. There's a lot to do with even more things coming soon. The only downside I would say is if you're playing on mobile, it will feel like you're phone is about to explode. You can still play it but I'd recommend console or pc. The download is long as hell but it's pretty worth it. The gacha aspect is really addictive and it's hard to not spend money on this game. It's not for everyone but I still highly recommend it!

Stunning. Congrats to the developer. There are only two annoying things in the game: (1) sometimes the dialogs seem endless and there's no way to skip them; (2) the gacha system is so frustrating... Other than that, the game provides a beautiful experience (I often play in the company of my son and wife, they say they love to watch me play!).

Pretty fun and high quality honestly Despite what everyone says and the hate it gets, it's actually really good. Though after playing it for.. 2 and a half years, you can get burnt out, as you don't have much endgame content. Characters are great and pretty.. most of the time. The story is long and tiring, interesting if you get into it, but it's like 18 hours long and I have stuff to do. As a returning player, quests stack and stack.. But overall a very good game, especially bc it's free

As a gacha game, it's great. As a regular game, lower your expectation upon playing this game. The games are awesome, the stylized graphics looks great, and the music composition is just *mwah* But the energy system in this game is either limit's your gameplay hour per day, or urging you to go pay to win. Or both. It's not mutually exclusive. This game is not a game that you can grind on for hours. It's a game that you can play as a side.

The game is fun to a point but extremely restrictive in what you can actually do due to how you get characters, the rates of five star units dropping at 0.3%, which is absolutely atrocious. If you had a method of actually getting an assured unit you wanted or if you were guaranteed a unit after a much sooner point than 90 wasted wishes, it could be a fun experience. As it stands the game is designed to price gouge you for everything you've got, and leave you with nothing to show for it.

The game is alright, but nothing about it is original. It blatantly takes whatever it likes from other games and adds them into the game, making a jumbled mess of gameplay elements with no real cohesion. Worst Housing system i have ever seen in a game. Additionally, they are not communicating with their community, its the games first anniversary and we are being ignored when asking for some reward for sticking with the game so long. They made a ton of money, but they are punishing the playerbase for playing the game. Character art is pretty good most of the time, but dont count on those being balanced or ever bugfixed.

What can I say. This game is as close to AAA as you can get on mobile. I'm playing one the oneplus 8pro and it runs soo smoothly. The graphics are amazing and the combat is really satisfying. The way you're able to switch between party members is super fun, and I love being able to combine the different elemental effects during combat. My only gripe is the loot. It feels bland and I find myself not caring about which weapon or artifact I equip to each party member. Other than that it's super fun

The only game of this genre that I enjoy playing for over 2 days. The story is fun to follow and read through and it's crazy how I actually looking forward for the next missions considering I never really enjoyed playing this type of game before. The only sad part is my smartphone can't handle higher graphics settings than the lowest and I can only play this game for less than 3 hours on full charge. Imagine wanting to play more on an off day but couldn't.

A console quality game on a phone...who would have thought? Great characters, great voice acting, great story, side quests that don't feel like "busy work" and a GACHA that I don't feel pressured AT ALL to buy into. This is how you get someone like me to invest $ into your game. Keep it up devs! *edit* I guess the game is too big for its own good now....😅 my phone used to handle this game EASY now it lags, even when I put the game settings to "smooth"....sadness.

I really love this game, having played on-and-off since release. The story is great (a bit slow at points), the character designs are phenomenal and the soundtrack is beautiful, too. However, there are aspects I am still waiting to change. The co-op mode feels rudimentary and unsatisfying. No event weapons/pets come back once they pass. A cutscene skip feature and better artifact grinding would help so much with the gameplay experience.

Good for a while, until you start hitting the abyss of waiting for more game content. Character pull rates are abysmal and getting enough points to pull after all the initial free points takes a while. Some characters are good while some are meh. Not a lot of content besides daily dungeons/quests once story is done. Coop has limitations on what you can do. Visually is nice and some voice acting is good. Wish this was a full price finished game, but sadly it's not.

genshi impact is a very nice high quality game, and a lot to adventure,to-do,. you can also add, draw some characters, there's a lot to know about, like chopping woods, collecting loots, cooking food, breaking, fighting , killings , temples, places, waypoints, cool things and more :D, I enjoyed alot at this game and it has a high quality and nice quality of the game, it is very a nice simulator game to play, even though it's very boring when u don't know what todo. But, there's alot to explore

Beautiful game and you can tell the devs and design team put in a lot of effort into the immersion and lore/ world building! Key to playing this game is to not have a grind mindset, it's really not about hitting the highest dmg. The company doesnt nag you to buy their in game currency like other gatcha gmes do - If you play the game consistently, do the quests & events, and explore the world, you'll eventually have enough to get the characters you want. Just enjoy the game itself.

Day 1 player here. The devs have been getting too comfortable with people playing this game even after all their dumb decisions. They will NEVER listen to feedback from players no matter how much you complain, unless of course you're a Chinese player. Then they'll suddenly listen to their complaints.

Genshin Impact - amazing gacha game with very well graphics, characters, plot and many quests. There's lots of things to do - from killing bosses to even collecting some flowers around the all giant map with a lot monsters, beautiful places and stuff. This game is just amazing-- I'm playing about 8 hours everyday and I can't stop playing. Genshin is also for free and has so many cool things, so you couldn't even believe. But this game is still being updated and I hope it will grew up much more

It's a beautiful game with a great storyline and characters. I play pretty much every day. For those people complaining about how big of a game it is and how laggy it is, unfortunately your phone just isn't good enough to handle the game, try playing on PC or console. Don't blame the game or developers, it's just a very content heavy game made for higher end phones 🤷🏽‍♀️

I've played the game for a while, but ultimately dropped it. The gameplay is fine, the characters are fun to play, and the story is interesting. Sadly, in my opinion, the game is just way too expensive in everything. I feel like I have to spend 15 bucks here daily to have the same fun I can have for free in most other gacha games. On top of that, it is stingy. Premium currency is sparse, even on events, and the gacha rates are a bad joke. You can easily dish out 100 bucks for just one char.

I've been playing for about 6 months now, and earning primogems is really difficult unless you have hundreds of dollars to spend on them (which many people don't.) the wishes being 160 primogems seems really expensive for an F2p acc. The events barely give you enough for 5 wishes, most of the time. (something about this should be changed.) It also does not run smoothly at all on my phone. Unless you have a PC or PSN, I recommend not getting it in mobile.

Played since launch, max adventure rank. This is one of the greatest multi-platform game one can ask for. It may be a gacha game, but it certainly doesn't feel like one. The combat, playstyle, story, music, and visuals are absolutely top tier! You'd be missing out by not trying it and enjoying what a masterpiece of a game this is. What's even better you can play on any platform with cross saves across all, to play wherever and on whatever with same account as you wish. 10/10

It took too much grinding to get an amount of primogems. Sometimes you have to grind like... hours just to get under 100 primogems. It can get boring very soon since most of the time all you do is get in the game, do daily, and left. But the game characters and scenery were pretty creative and beautiful! This game is worth it to try and play! (From an ar55 player)

Well, To be honest all in all a solid game. Great graphics for a mobile game, somewhat decent controls(little iffy and janky here and there). My biggest gripe with this is two things. 1. Why is there still no skip button?!? It boggles my mind. 2.(Debatable) A trade in system would be amazing like a 5 star character you own and don't use you can trade in for the current one would make me more inclined to play even longer if I could trade up to my dream team. 4/5

It is a pretty nice game and you can sink a lot of time into it especially if you like LoZ. Great voice acting and graphics and nice and fluid gameplay. BUT, since it's a gacha game you can also sink a lot of money into it and the rates are abysmal at the moment with a 0.6 chance to pull a 5 star (and essentially a 0.06 chance to pull the 5 star character you want on the promotional banner). The other negative thing is the story gatekeeping. Grinding levels to play the story is not too much fun.

Do you like exploring? Do you like having your own adventures in the wild? Do you want to play "The legend of zelda breath of the wild" but you don't have a nintendo switch or the money to buy them? Genshin impact is for you! You get a free game that let's you explore anything, anywhere. Even tho it's a gatcha game the currency in this game is easy to obtain during exploring, doing quest and more. Also it's free on every platform so far and has cross platform as well. 10/10 amazing game.

I love this game, it's fun and interesting. I've been playing for a few years now, and it's been a great experience. But recently, I've switched to a newer device and I found a few problems with the audio. Whenever I go into combat with more than one enemy, the SFX disappear until after I finish fighting the enemies. This includes skill sounds, hit sounds, claiming rewards, etc - making the experience less fun. Everything else runs smoothly, it's just the audio having problems.

The game itself has tons of potential and is very enjoyable AT FIRST. I really really enjoyed it up until the moment I finished the story, and there is absolutely nothing to do except slowly make your characters more powerful when there isn't any end game content to use that power in. The customer service is kinda trash and the developers has zero transparency, they refuse to provide any kind of roadmap or give any information to the players and they refuse to fix or even address the biggest issues in the game. If the developers added some end game content and were more transparent about the games future this would be a 5 star review.

I absolutely love this game, the character designs, the beautiful open world. Even the voice acting is amazing, it's unlike any mobile game I've ever played and you can tell there was a lot of love put into this game. So why 4 star and not 5? Controller support, my hands are pretty big so mobile controls are a bit of an issue, even on my ipad mobile controls are too clunky and unreliable. If this game had controller support it would be a perfect 5 star!

The story and overall game play is fun, but there isn't much to do late game. I know the game is still adding more archon and such, but rn, it feels really boring. Everyday, I would just come on, get daily commissions, spend resin, and be done for the day. There isn't much to do afterwards, especially for people like me, who are ar45+ the gacha system also feels really expensive.

I really like this game. It has an immercive story, good graphics, and challenging but not overwhelming gameplay. It is a bit different in that it is just your character in your world while others can only visit you and vice versa. However, that is easy to work with. Then I got to the fishing quest, and it's difficult to do despite it being such an easy task. To make this worse, you can't enter your house or enter co op mode until it's done. The quest is unimportant to the story.

Very fun but has a ton of room for improvement, especially at end game which devolves into a monotonous daily grind while waiting for more story to release. It's wise to just take breaks between patches, but if you're free to play you will feel like you need to play daily to get some of the premium currency used to pull new characters and weapons. If you are willing to spend or don't get too attached as a free to play player though you'll just show up when there's content and have good fun.

It's fine. I like the story and the characters but it's easy to get burnt out from this game. The BP and welkin make little difference. Resource scarcity makes me have to grind more, with no way of making it easier. Domains are horrible, and I can never roll into any good artefacts. The rates are just bad all around. I'd get 5 star characters I don't want and then I end up spending upwards of $150 to get a character I DO want. Please don't be dumb like me and spend money on this game.

1 So, at first I moves at an alright pace but, I eventually slows so drastically that you'll wonder if you're at the end even though you're only 1/4. Ie they make it way too grindy after that point. 2 If you want good characters that can actually get though... $$$ I spent over $400 on the gatcha (Japanese loot box). 3. It story, character design and game play on its pc counterpart (cross-save is a thing) are absolutely beautiful in execution.

Before this gets removed, I'd like to say that I've played this game since day 1. The exploration part of the game is good enough to keep you interested in the early stages. The story is unfortunately not interesting enough, and at times bad. The graphics are good, the music in the main cities are fine (others are not memorable enough, nor have character in it). The worst part about this game is the gacha system. While it does have a pity system, the opportunities you have to actually get the currency (primogems) are limited. The gacha system is what keeps most of the playerbase entertained. This is because people like the characters and want to build them, but odds are you won't get most of what you actually want without spending any money. The weapon banner is the most egregious aspect of this game's gacha system. The fact that you have to potentially spend much more on the weapon banner to get what you want guaranteed is absurd. Artifacts, which are your main equipment aside from your weapon, are a pain to deal with. It's bad enough that you have limited stamina to farm for it, but its stats and substats are completely RNG. You could go for a month and not have good artifacts with decent substats. There's much more to say, but I'm afraid it will take much more time, and I definitely don't want to waste any more of my time for this game. The anniversary was merely the final straw.

I played this game before, and recently I came back to play again. Hear me out players would appreciate it if you would make co-op option more functional. What I mean is when players are unable to co-op due to a "quest" then would it be right for you to add a button that leads to that quest and if it's unavailable add an tracker to track what needs to be done. People are getting tired of finding quests that is really impossible to browse specially with many other quests that takes time.

I both love and hate this game. The amount of duplicates you need to max out a character is awful. This ties into content and how hard or easy some content will be moving forward. As the world gets stronger, you need to be. If you're unlucky with pulls, you could be stuck for a while. The community is hit and miss. P2P players will kick you from the group if your character isn't fully maxed out despite them being leveled and geared, making stuff hard to do. The game is in a weird spot, honestly.

I normally don't play games like this, but between it being free and the ads not being absolute dumpster fires, I had to check it out. In short, the game feels a lot like The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (BoTW), and has some similar mechanics. This will probably shred your phone battery and storage with it's 11Gig size, so I recommend playing on PS4 or Windows. If you heard about the kernel-level anti-cheat running when the game is closed and are concerned, that's been fixed.

I've been a big fan of Genshin for a long time now and I absolutely adore it. I have some issues with it, especially in late game, though. Everything is time gated and late game is very grindy. It doesn't have a daily checklist like most gacha games - you get daily commissions but they're so quick you only need to be on the game for 5 minutes. After getting to AR55 the rewards become more and more pointless for the amount of work put in. Overall fun, but needs tweaking to stay afloat long term.

Game is beautiful! Very surprised that a game like this can even run on mobile. It's an action rpg with an engaging story, fun combat and game mechanics, chill exploration, etc. There are many playable characters in game with different personalities and aesthetics. You are bound to find someone you like. It's a gacha game so you have to roll for characters, but it's not bad, you can eventually get the character you like by playing. Highly recommend to give the game a chance.

Fantastic on a mechanics level. Combat can have a lot of variety and team comps are fun to play with. Huge roster of unique characters. Great little story and tons of hidden chests and challenges. People are exaggerating the cost of this game. I have plenty of 5 star characters and I've spent like 10 bucks Canadian over the course of a year of play. It is a totally free to play game. I can't speak highly enough of how absurdly good this game is and it's 100% free to play holy smokes.

I've played genshin for 5 years on console, and I really enjoy this game. but when I play on mobile (different account), it has many bugs, including ones in the spiral abyss. When I complete character trial, it doesn't give me the characters that I've earned. Today (May 20th), if I don't do the age verification, my account will be deleted, and when I type my month and year of birth, the next button doesn't show up so i cant get into my account. PLS FIX THIS PROBLEM HOYO!!!

For the first maybe 30 hours or so this game is great. You get plenty of rolls and there's a ton of content. After you hit adventure rank 30 or so you quickly realize that any progress is slowed to a halt by the game's stamina system, resin. You have 120 resin and dungeons or world bosses use 20-40 resin each. Even for a gacha game 3-5 dungeons is an awful rate. If this system was removed, or if the resin cap went up each level, the game would be a great gacha game.

If you like The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, then you will certainly like this game. It feels like they took all the best games and combined them into one title. The artwork reminds me of a cross between Xenoblade Chronicles and Breath of the Wild with similarly mixed gameplay. There are plenty of things to do and you can make in app purchases or earn in game currency to progress your characters. This game runs great on my Nubia Red Magic 8 Pro.

Fun game so far. Runs great on my note 20. I took a couple stars off because there's no controller support and when I use my galaxy beans the audio has a lot of static. Also I'd like to see some kind of guild feature. If it has one I haven't unlocked it yet. Maybe you could take down tough tough bosses together. Compete against other guilds seeing how far you can get. I could see myself getting bored eventually without guilds.

Fun until it's not. The prologue chapters and casual exploring is an enjoyable time, and the world is vibrant and interesting. Then you reach Adventure Rank 25, enemies universally become harder, and you realize your freebie units aren't up to snuff. "Resin" is Stamina but even more limited, with an 8 hour wait after two boss encounters in order to get upgrade materials you'll need Game could be better, but good design and loop is held back by freemium mechanics

The game i played so far is a free world game. You get Main Story quests as well as other Side Quests. You're also free to pick materials and ingredients up. Art style is breath catching and voice overs are available in various languages. Some parts of the game interface however are still a bit hard to use. But if i have to compare it to another game, it'd be quite similar to Monster Hunter World, as for the level of freedom we have in the game.

From a layman's standpoint: amazing game, the story is interesting and you will have a lot of fun exploring. But if you're more serious about this then I'd say it's only worth 4 stars. Rng is really tough(which is honestly kind of it's charm) as well as them being really greedy with primos somehow. You won't get a lot of characters quickly but that makes getting every character more special. Definitely worth a play.

Very nice experience for new players that have things to do. The game is almost 2 years old now and there still isn't any form of endgame activity. Pretty much everything that is added to the game is removed after max. 6 weeks. The devs are on the spiteful side and completely disconnected from the playerbase and dont really give us free stuff, ever. Meanwhile you need to promote the game for them for maybe 2 pulls (in the rare occasion where they give you free stuff). Game for short term fun.

I'm enjoying the game and story line so far. What I have a serious problem with are the controls on android, the fact that there is no way to link ps4 to Android or pc and no way to manage expeditions without launching the game. And that last one really grinds my gears when coupled with the second issue. Otherwise it's a fun gacha that appears to be coming along nicely. I'll update when I'm closer to end game as I'm only at level 21 adventure.

Played this game since a few days after release. It was fun for a free game. Pouring my time and money into the game is regretful. I expected myself to play this game for over a year, however, that isn't the case. The daily commissions(+events) are very repetitive, low rewarding, and boring. I didn't even bother claiming my welkin moon either. I would recommend this game to first time gacha players, since it has a pity system. There's better games out there that is more fun and less repetitive.

This actually a pretty great game, crossplatform too. It's a mix between ARPG & MMO in my opinion, but the Devs here have found the perfect balance between the two genres. The only thing in my mind that gives it 4⭐ instead of 5⭐ is that the 'wishes'/Primogems currency is very expensive, therefore the pulls to get new toons & weapons is expensive. Other than that it's actually an excellent 'phone' game (don't get fooled by that. It's a cross platform game that can ALSO be played on your phone)

I loved this game so much when i started playing, the story is engaging and i still find it very amazing and free, but latley the combat style is just decreasing and Va's get replaced without contact or even that they could do anything about it. It's dissapointing. A game with so much potential and all that the people care about is "Whale" numbers and being dramatic kittens. The developers only listen to one community and never to us, very sad. I still love this game tho.

Hello! This game is my favourite game rn!! Before I start though, There's one thing that you should take into consideration before getting Genshin. it's how much storage it takes up!! This can't really be changed, but I do think that it's a game you can only really have if you don't have many (any) other apps- (I use a chromebook). Otherwise, I think it's RIDICULOUS that this game it free! Definitely recommend for a great story, similar to an anime but with more control!

The game has been updating very rapidly and the dialogs are getting longer, plus their are many characters that are playable but not important to the main story which took away many characters rerun and now, some of them will have to wait for at least 1 to 2 years until getting a rerun. Please do not make genshin just a fan service game. I recommend making the side quests at least be a little relevant to the main plot. Overall, this game is ok, but it gets boring the more you continue.

I have played this game for long time and I thought its about time I drop an honest review. This game will get you hooked in no time the moment you press start. A vast open world, amazing plotline, stunning graphics. But thats it. Thats all what is good. There these domains and challenges but the amount of time you can play them is limited, if you wanna play more pay real money. Puzzles are too easy, powercreep prblms, a very unpleasant gacha system and more Its a pure waste of time

This game is fantastic so far but the gatcha is a nightmare for causal players... I spent $50 on the gems with the current deal effectively doubling the money I spent to only get about 25 rolls on the gotcha. I came out with some 4 star characters and one 5 star weapon. I can't say that makes me want to spend any more money on this. $100 on any game should get you something to make me feel like it was worth it but this game doesn't do that. Keep that in mind if you're going to play this game.

Controls on mobile are hit or miss. Unfortunately the combat gets too hectic to play well on mobile especially as Adventurer Rank increases. However your progress does transfer to PC and vice versa. And on PC this game truly shines. This is an open world RPG with gacha elements, but the gacha is supplemental to the game. The four characters that you get for free in the beginning are enough to get through all the story content.
The game really is fine it's just that there's no skip button unlike other rpg games and also resin takes so long to replenish. But overall the gameplay is good the story is also good

The game as it is right now feels weird, I do love the game but I'm starting to feel burned out along with most players in the end game, especially the ones that have been playing nonstop ever since the game was released. Beside the atrocious anniversary rewards mihoyo decided to give, there is no endgame besides abyss and for some players, abyss 12 is not even difficult anymore (whales being the most obvious example of this) and the "content" is really limited to only chest and dialogs.

Since it's my first time playing this game, I'll put my first impression here. So, here we go— 1. Yeah, we can solo this game, though it's not an offline game. It's nice to explore this open world game, the map's big, the NPCs have voice-overs and they don't actually just stand there (some of them can walk or run around). 2. AMAZING GRAPHICS! Brace yourself! Though, it actually took around 5 GB for the data download. 3. You can play with PC, Android, iOS, or even PS4 users!!! Thanks, mihoyo!!

This is game that gives you a whole console experience on your phone, free of charge. I don't even need to say anything else, the game delivers amazing graphics, a solid story, and a large open world experience all within the confines of your phone. Did I mention cross-platform servers so you can play with the boys over on PS4. One more thing, its free man.

Miles ahead of everything in mobile gaming. The gatcha rates are bad. The cash to currency rates are not good if a sale isn't going on. Energy system needs work. The gameplay loops are too few at higher adventure rank levels. I'll change my review with further progress of this title. I'm holding this game to a higher standard then any other mobile game since it's a pc and console title as well. Easily a 5 star mobile game, but overall 3 stars until we get some changes to what I addressed.

The amount of storage this game takes up is insane. I have the newest iPhone and it's still abhorrent. Plus, the developers are beyond stingey. If you're gonna make a game so damn difficult, at least be a little bit more generous. Tried for a full week (even though I didnt like it to begin with) just to see if this would be one of those games that you needed to put some time into to get invested, and I'm still disappointed. Never getting this again.

It's pretty amazing in basically every way. My only fear is that there's only one city and a pretty unchanging world. But with that being said, I haven't played though even half of the content in the game atm. So I look forward to it. Ps. I'd love to see more "immersive" ways of getting party members. Like you could find them around the world and do quests for them. Or just hire them from bars

The visual style and exploration is appealing to me, even though this is a Gacha with low rates, this doesn't seem very pay to win, its honestly the closest to having a free to play console experience. Only issues at this time are lack of controller on mobile, issues using PC version, and I'm waiting on Switch version that has Mihoyo accounts so we can cross save! Then I can play game more often!

I dont play it on mobile, but I did on ps4 and now on PC. The game is fun and I have no problems with it itself. The rewards are what's lacking. They make money out of us for each banner, yet they can't give us something in return. Each new character brings them in lots of money. And they still have plenty to release, all we ask for is for them to give us one of the standard 5 star characters/weapons for free. It wouldn't affect them much, and it won't be game breaking either. What's the hold up

Genshin is an amazing game, but I've given it a 3-star rating due to two main issues. First, the pull rates are quite unreasonable, requiring over $220 for just one five-star character. The current rate of 90 pulls for a five-star seems excessive, and lowering it to around $50 or 50 pulls could enhance the game's appeal and encourage more players to make in-game purchases. Secondly, while the story is engaging, the extensive grinding needed to progress through the levels is tedious.

Wonderful game, very fun to explore and get lost in. On PC at least. Controller support is needed for this game on Android, there's no reason it shouldn't be here as it's on both PC, iOS and of course console. People have been asking forever so it's not as if it's a niche request, whatever BS is keeping them from releasing it is unfair to the Android player base.

The game is phenomenal. But I have an issue with the very restricted Co-Op mode. I find it lackluster that you can't do much when you're with other players. Me and my sister joined for the first time in our server, but we were underwhelmed upon the realization that we can't even do any quest there, it defeats the point of joining each other's servers when you can only join to raid dungeons or tombs whatever you call it.

The game is very fun. But the gacha rates are a bit too low for the amount of gems needed, it's dumb that mobile can't use a controller, in its current state the amount of content is pretty low but they will add more regions, the dailies are mediocre and the co-op experience is pretty poor. But the game overall is very good if not a bit grindy. The gameplay is solid with the combat being fun, the gear progression having a strong focus and exploring the world and findings is collectables is fun.

I will start off by saying that I enjoy the game very much. When I first saw it, I was a bit hesitant in trying as some games that look 3D comes out being...disappointing. However, I was very happy to find that they were true with what they were showing. The game was, and is, fun and I was ecstatic to know it is cross-platform. My phone somewhat sucks so happy to play it on PC. Mihoyo, to me, has been generous to players and listen and take in consideration of what we have to say. My opinion

For starters, this is a decent openworld game for mobile; I don't think any other game in app stores even tries to be original compared to this. I do like that you're free to explore, farm, and traverse the world. What I don't like is the gacha though. Poorly executed pay2win aspect that seeks to abuse player's desires with terribly low rates and even making parts of the game too hard or simply undoable without extra members and 5★ gear which is mainly accessible through the banner draws.

One of the best action role-playing action video games in a long time. The gameplay is so great that it reminds you Breath of the Wild with an anime storyline that is still in going. Also as a gatcha game, it doesn't reallly feel like it unless you aren't contended enough already. The great amount of rewards that this game is offering is surprising as well. With a decent amount of grinding, you will get your materials in no time.

It's fun in the beginning. But the further you get the less there is to do. The rewards are so lackluster. You work hard to level up but the reward is unreasonably wrong. The weapon and character banner is even separated, which you need more primogems or fates for you to get the weapon or character you desire. It's hard to be a free to play in this game. You can't enjoy this game if you're just a free to play. What's there to enjoy? Grinding?

The first 20-30 hours are a joy, feels like a single player game exploring and interacting in a beautiful open world. When you have quests available for upgrade materials (xp books, gold and fodder) upgrading your characters is that not bad. At the higher levels getting the materials, xp and gold is time gated through their resin system so this experience turns into a mobile game, play 30 minutes and out. Oh, you can binge on a weeknight while the grandparents are watching the kid? Sorry, same 30 minutes because you're capped at 3 elite fights or 6 "dungeon" runs for that 120 resin. Most of the higher level "domain" is just a room where you fight a few round of enemies and then collect the treasure if you have enough resin. The coop experience is not complete now, it's not a feature, it's only a bolt-on. If you want variety of skills and team composition, don't look at this game. You get a base team + Noelle guaranteed, then the rest is the slot machine (gacha). Guess my brother and I are spoiled by Coop and loot play in Borderlands and the Diablo and real MMOs like FF XIV that we're just going to play Path of Exile now until Mihoyo decides what kind of game they want to turn this into. 5 stars for the initial 20 hours, subtracting 2 stars for monetization gates.

Good core game, but it has been getting worse over time. Multiple characters released recently that require multiple copies for them to be good. Just releases a 5 star unit, Dehya, that is possibly the worst in the game. There's also nothing to do after getting caught up. Exploring isn't as fun, and there isn't any long-term content to fight against.

Real great game I am loving it! Buy there is no controller support for Android??? Isn't on PS4 and PC?!? Kind of disappointed to be honest it would make the game way more playable. One last thing, the username and email is partially displayed when on launcher but Phone number fully display when linked, not really ideal when want to be same and want to stream in the same time.

Game is awesome and really addictive with the open world experience and there is always something to be found at every corner. I stopped playing for a while due to personal reasons. Came back and couldnt login to my account .. forgot my username. I tried recovering. But when i submit the form they asked for it appears someone has already submit one in a recent time. And the gmail connected to the account had been changed. I Had spent a lot of money. Have reciepts to back my claims. But no help.

I would not recommend this game to my friends, I'm sorry, but I don't think they would enjoy it cause of how hard some puzzles and bosses are. I have not been playing genshin for 1 week or so cause of the content they're feeding to "those" players, but my problem is that some enemies are hard to defeat like that giant squirrel from natlan, plunging attack is the way to defeat it quicker but new players, or returning players, won't have any characters (like gaming or varesa) to defeat it in time.

So it's good, until you have to walk 57 miles to one simple thing, because there are no check points in that area, and once you get there, there WAS a check point and you really just never bothered getting it because it takes SO LONG TO GET THERE that it's not worth the hassle. Another thing is that you have to earn co-op, I mean, the game would be a lot better if it just HAD co-op then you have to earn it, because leveling up is so slooooooow, on the other hand it was quite beautiful. 3/5

A Really good game to clear space for. Just have to wait for each person's banner to come back around. I'm waiting for Hu tao to come back around so I can try to wish for her. Better played on PC but that goes for most games. Your account can be played on PC and phone so that's awesome. It's a grind but gamers... we are used to that. The map is huge! If your not a cash spender.. they have ways for you to earn spending stuff for wishes and stuff. There's nothing I can say bad about it.

Im not really into mobile gaming due to the immense amount of shovel wear freemium games. However Genshin Impact is a big acception. Great story, gameplay is fantastic, and overall brilliant to play. The big things i asked for in RPGS for gameplay to be just as important as a story. As for spending money to progress the game, its more of making the most of the game instead of getting better at the game. It still lacks controller support and the way to link accounts is a faf, which makes it 4/5.

One of the best JRPGs I've played in recent years despite being F2P. The map is huge and the exploration is superb, offering you something to do at every turn. Some people are discouraged from trying the game due to the gacha, but you can easily get 100+ hours from the game as a F2P player using the free characters without feeling paywalled by anything. Not to mention, right now the game only has 2 out of 7 planned regions, so the game will be HUGE by the time they add eveything.

I love this game. The lore, characters, animation, designs, everything. Except for the part where you either have to spent your entire savings on the character you want or you have to save all your primogems for a year and hope you get your desired character. Other than that, I wish I had more to do than my daily quests, as those are the only quests I can do. There's plenty of content but sometimes you'll find yourself bored because you've got nothing to do except gathering materials.

Designs are beautiful, music is chef's kiss, characters have such great personality and lovable. Its very hard to not get attached to this game, for its lore and story is top tier. The games adds a new twist on open world games and draws inspirations from other games while not being too "copied". Amazing how it's a free game, of course there is the option of paying money for in game currency, however these currencies are given by simply putting in effort to grind in the game.

I've written a review before but this one is simply a suggestion. I'd like to suggest that a few features inside the Serenitea Pot are to be added. It'd be quite nice if we can make our companions sit on the chairs that we place, it's sad to see them standing when the player can sit wherever we'd like while they stand, they're our guests after all. Maybe let us pet our animals as well, it'd be cute to see animations with it too. Makes it feel more realistic and homely.

Very fun game at the start, rates are pretty abysmal though. If you're looking for a game in which you get the characters and weapons you want look elsewhere. With decent luck you can get a couple you want if you save for an ENTIRE YEAR. Do not play the game if you want good updates that aren't just focused on dialogue, not actual gameplay. If you want endgame content, this game sucks. If you want to not grind for hours on end every day just to lose your 50/50 this game sucks. Do not recommend.

So far, I'm very impressed. The game has good mechanics and the combat works with mobile touch controls much better than any other similar game I've played, after a brief adjustment period. The open world is genuinely fun to explore and the cross-platform design makes playing with others a cinch.
