The gacha rates are pretty brutal, but with no PvP (at least, currently) and the game handing you perfectly adequate units in series of early quests, the gacha isn't a necessary part of the experience.

To be honest, it is a great game in general. Played for one year and a half, have got most of the characters that I liked, the game needs patience and you would get most of the things as long as you are not "rush and ambitious" player. Play a little after work, enjoy or participate the event during weekend... Time would give you everything, man, just be patient and satisfied (abyss is not the core of the game), know what exactly you want is a key strategy to have a better game experience.

Genshin is a wasted opportunity. You aquire and level up characters and weapons, with no actual purpose. There's no endgame, and they confirmed not adding one, and that's a huge mistake. I wish they would tell me that before I wasted two years of my life farming for items in this game. After you clear the content they add with each version, you're stuck with dailies and resin (stamina) which limits what you can do to a minimum (you only play around 30 mins/day) and they won't increase the limit.

Amazing game, I have more than a 1000 hours and experienced basically everything. The story is fine, the combat is *really* good and the open world is very stunning and a lot of effort is put into it. However I started to get less interested in the game recently because of the new characters and their mechanics... I play the game today mostly because of the combat, grinding doesn't really pay off since it's basically never useful because of the lack of content. Please make more use of it hoyo 🥺

while I used to enjoy this game it is clear they no longer care about their players. There is not enough rewards to play the game anymore and they pour all their resources into miliastra wonderland which no one asked for.

Been playing the game since the first week of launch and this has to be the most F2P friendly I've played. The story is awesome and the music is just awesomeness. Gameplay is great on PC and mobile is fine but little difficult on some events. What I like the most is that I can play the game on my own pace and not spend an hour a day. You can just do dailies and for events, you can focus on them on the last few days to do it one shot.

The game itself is a great game and and looks amazing. However the resin system is so limiting that you can only grind for 30 minutes max. I would like to play the game but the game itself doesn't allow that. Playing for those 30 minutes feels great but I'm only allowed 30 minutes due to this system. The gacha system is not great either but i guess a free game needs to make money somehow.

I really love the quality of this game. If im going to spend money on a gatcha game it is this one. I think the rates are good compared to other games. ( keep up with the rate up pools) My only gripe is that, this is a crossplay game but in Co-op mode is almost useless because the guest in the wold cant get like 90% of the available rewards. I really want to play and be able to do quests and story WITH my friends. Also please CONTOLLER SUPPORT FOR IOS AND ANDRIOD PLEASE!

The game itself is fantastic which is why I'm only giving it 3 stars. It's unfortunate the game was tailored to have a generic mobile gacha monetization structure when it truly didn't need to sell itself short like that. It's a game that could have been so much more, honestly. Enjoy it while it lasts! This game is truly amazing especially with friends. Its by no means free to play though, at least not if you actually want to try out all the characters and builds and have fun in that respect.

People told me to write a review about this game concerning the anniversary and boy I never thought I'd actually write one, but... This game is freaking amazing. I look forward to every new character release and pull for them based off their unique kits. I'm so glad miHoYo does not deal in power creep in their game. Each character is built with a different set of goals to accomplish. And it is up to the player to make the most out of it. Diversity is freedom, freedom enables team diversity.

The game itself is fantastic but no matter how good a game is if it won't let you play smoothly then it'll the render the game useless. What I'm referring to is the high ping (Asia Server) which tends to have a "reconnection issues" from time to time. I can attest to that because I can play well with other online games without experiencing any lag/delay in game. Sad to note that I have to uninstall the game. It was fun playing. Sayonara my beloved chars Diluc, Jean, Qiqi, Mona, Klee. 🙂

Its a great game, so long as you have the graphics and space to handle the game. If not, i highly recommend playing it on a different platform. My only issue is the companies blatant colorism. While representation for the most part is good, it lacks skin tone diversity. Considering the company originates from East Asia and the culture towards dark skin there, i cant say its all that surprising, but its still disappointing.

I've been playing since Inazuma and it's been my favourite game so far. The best region for me would be Fontaine, I just love the exploration and characters. However I've run into a problem. See I was updating the new version and the download was smooth the problem was when the shades are compiling and reached 100%, the game exits itself. I've tried everything I can like restarting the phone, re-installing the game but nothing is working. I don't think it's storage problem, maybe a bug?

This game is deleting negative views. It knows what it's doing. They're ignoring our complaints about us getting less and less pulls, and trying to cover it up. Only reason it isn't one star is because it's easier for them to delete. Complaining works, we just need to be a little louder.

Burnt-out is a common thing, especially in the gacha category. For instance, Genshin is a great game. The colour scheme to the characteristic of it, everything is just splendid, and that's what we thought initially. Once you're higher level and so, your pretty much repeating the same routine all over again until and patch comes live. So for newer players, take ur time cuz there's no rush to it, players who are getting burnt-out, it's alright to take a break or so. Is not mandatory to keep plying

I've played this game for about 2 weeks now and let me tell you. Its one heck of a game indeed. The stories are fantastic, the challenges are balanced and not to mention the open world experience! This game is A+from me Although There is one flaw...I don't recommend playing on mobile unless the mobile was built for gaming. The game is too big and doesn't run well with most phones. Major problems with phones? Overheating, space and low fps rate. It's a good game but wouldn't recommend on mobile🙂

Unbelievable how bad developers keep treating players who support the game from the beggining. They can't create mechanics that would make playing easier that people are asking for years. You have to pay hundreds of dolars to have every character in the game, without even thinking about the weapons. Still the characters are useless, because there is nothing to do. There is no end game. After 3 years we still can't see end of the story. The events are repetitive. Thank you gifts are also a joke.

Fun game with a nice story and a beautiful and engaging world. With all of that aside I personally find team building one of the best aspects of the game, which is a shame due to the gacha system being the worst I have ever encountered. The rate are horrible and obtaining the currency takes tens of hours over the course of weeks and even then you are not guaranteed to get the charcter or weapon you want. But the fact that you can enjoy a game of this caliber on a mobile device amazes me.

Really fun open world, lots of quests and exploring, and beautiful scenery. Easy ways to earn the gems for the lotto to win new characters for free. Can play the game for free, or buy gems, doesn't affect gameplay. I would recommend playing on a playstation, since touchscreen is annoying when trying to fight; buttons are a lot easier. Also the game is huge, since it's open world, so downloads on phone are massive.

One of the best F2P RPG. Great story. Multiple simultaneous quest. Open World where you can wander around. The main mechanism is the gatcha system where you get random characters, weapons and items. So if you keep it F2P you will get random characters and items but most of them are decent and varied enough so you can play different style. I highly suggest looking up each of your character all their skill and how to best used them in combination with artifact. Because it's Gatcha you won't be able to get exacly what you want but closed enough is good enough for a Free game. If your not obsessed with I absolutely need this or that and learn to used what you have it a perfect free game. Lot of fun and you won't have to spend any money.

The game is beautiful, the gacha system is more fair than others, the story is really good, character design is amazing, and overall the game is fun to play. Main problem is the size of the gacha roster and the repetitive endgame content. You will have all the non-premium characters pretty fast but the premium ones are pretty obtainable because of genshins gacha system. The endgame is very boring though, so once you've hit the endgame it might be time for something else.

I love the story, the gameplay, and all the characters and the design and graphics too. - UPDATE: 27.03 I don't enjoy playing it anymore... I find the weapon wishing system so unfair. it doesn't carry the guarantee to the enxt banner. I've been losing my wishes on weapon banner for 6 consecutive banners. I'm losing interest I just play because I still want to know the story, but as time goes by... I feel sad that I feel this way. 🥺

I love the game, and I pop on from time to time, but I hopped on again after a long while. I play on my laptop as well, both my phone and computer use the same account, but when I tried to get on mobile, it's acting like I'm a new player and asking me to pick a twin. Please fix account restarts? I think you'd call it. Idk it's just weird that my account data is suddenly gone.

At first I wasn't interested in the game. Till my friends got into it so I decided to join. And honestly I don't regret it. This is one of the best MMORPG games out there. First off the Graphics is just amazing! It's so smooth even with my slow wifi. Next are the characters, I like the fantasy design of the characters it fits my style considering I love fantasy but if you don't like fantasy I'm sure eitherway you'd love their characters. The plot is something I love as well in short it's perfect

I honestly love this game so much! I haven't played one that beats genshin and I enjoy the graphics, story, soundtracks, characters, the lore and more! I love playing alone and on coop. This game is really well done and I cannot wait for more of the game to come The only thing I'd like to see improved is the possibility to allow multiple servers to play together if that makes sense? I'd love to play with some of my friends that are on different servers without having to create another account.

So much more than a BotW copy. Beautifully designed game with exquisite attention to detail, great story, and creative fighting mechanics. Even if it is a gacha game, I'd honestly be happy to spend a few bucks here and there, since this would easily be a $50+ console game. So far, how ever, I've been able to play for hours and hours without feeling stuck or like I NEED to spend money to enjoy or progress in the game.

For real i haven't play this game yet. And the fact that I always see people playing and sharing their experience playing this game through media like yt, tiktok and even facebook, I can say this is a great game. The thing is, the game is just to big to be played on mobile and some low-end gadgets. In short not compatible, it's so laggy. So I'm thinking, is there a way to minimize or help a gadget reach the certain requirements so it can be played a little smooth??

The one missing piece is worldwide cross region server play. You can't play with your friends from different servers around the world, which is a big turn off after reaching high rank, spending on gachas, and later discovering that I could not play with my friends from different servers with my same account and characters. Suddenly felt the game is meaningless unable to play with my friends. Please allow cross server play and its a definite 5*.

I love this game, but MHY rarely if ever listens to the community. We've been asking for a faster Regen on the stamina system, QoL updates for expeditions and UI elements, updates for starter characters to have them perform at similar levels as newer units, and repeatable end game content and the list goes on. I cannot recommend this game until MHY addresses these concerns in a public announcement. We've waited a year, but large elements of this game are still not implemented. Do better.

The game is wonderful, if you liked Breath of the Wild or skyrim, theres a good chance you'll enjoy this game. There are timed mechanics like most other mobile games, and it does have a hero collection system based on using in game gems to get 'rolls' for heros and weapons. This does not detract from the game, as the real emphasis is picking your desired playstyle, whether it be maining 1 hero or having a rounded team. My ONLY warning is take your time. Enjoy the game. Don't try rushing it.

It was good in the beginning and even better as it went on. Events were fun, characters were charming, and gameplay was addicting. However, I didn't enjoy it's poor gacha rates and the scarcity of primogems and how earning them seemed to be more of a chore than anything. It doesn't help how randoms are pretty toxic on there too. I like this game but I don't see myself sticking around long after.

Not for me. I enjoy HI3rd and thought I'd like this but it's way too grindy. And when I tried to grind artifacts in co-op dungeons players would kick me for being weak, not the developers' fault but ruins it for newbies like me. Otherwise combat is fun with the different elements and how they react. Difficulty level on bosses is good if you do manage to grind. Story is interesting. Character design is lazy though, same 4 models just different clothes, straight up stealing from hi3 (same company

Really fun and well implemented game. Solid mechanics and I've run into no issues at all. Graphics are stunning (on PC) and character design, animation, and everything are top notch. Gacha system is... rough. Extremely expensive rolls for the lowest 5 star rate in any gacha game I've ever played. DO NOT expect to randomly get a five star and spend money on this game unless you really have the pocket for it. from my experience from playing ~300 days, you only roll to gain the pity system and nothing more. Don't rush the game. There is so much to do and explore but once you reach the end of that content there is huge block and you will experience burn-out and have nothing to do; end game is quite boring. Hugely do recommend not just for gacha gamers, but fans of exploration, rpg titles such as Breath of the Wild.

It's what I've been waiting for! Really wanted to play an anime game that didn't have Arknights storytelling nor GFL exclusivity of cute girls and guns, so to have a game like this come out so timely is fantastic. Like, I wish Mabinogi could be like this but alas. Can't wait for any expansion on multiplayer and more characters! The only thing that sucks is that there's not a lot of control sizing, positioning or keyboard adapting for mobile, so I constantly attack or climb when I don't mean to.

It is a very fun game, but in a lot of space in loading, but adventures and puzzles in this game are very interesting. Just can't deny that this game has some points that cause many headaches, such as some jokes in Main story or hangout , characters skill, for example, Dehya , in my personal opinion, I feel that it still can't be taken to adventure in the world or take it into abyss, but I typed the comments. The above does not want this game to have fewer people playing. I love this game.

You know the game hits you as a truck at the start of the game. And man I played the game almost after the initial release! Yeah that thrilling joy and need to explore at start but after you realize you have so much stuff to do and it will took days nor hours you wouldn't want do much about it. At end-game it turns into repetitive gameplay: "Log in game, Daily tasks, Daily Resin,Log out". That's how it feels to play it. If you want to try it out sure but don't get your hopes high enough.

I played this game religiously since release for about 280 days (according to their 'Theater of your gameplay" and me noting when I stopped) when I finally got to the point where I just found no enjoyment from it. My biggest issue was their inability to address endgame content, or lack thereof. Artifact farming was it and it was atrocious. It was so hit or miss that once I got even a semi viable set on a character I didn't bother trying to upgrade it because it was always a sunk cost. Since their only "end game" was Abyss and if you didn't have the dream team and the right artifacts, you'd be lucky to 3 star the final floors. This has been the case since the game's release and never once was anything end game related added. If they addressed their wonky drop rates for artifacts (at the time of my playing) it might not have been so bad but it persisted for so long that even after they added the ability to convert 5 stars, it's too late for me to go back and enjoy the game. It was a fun ride and I loved the characters but they didn't put the work in to make it better.

Well I really liked it for the first 20-30 hrs, but then you hit a wall. Not a difficulty wall. A wall of a stamina system that barely allows 15 minutes of play in a game that's very much based on gameplay similar to Breath of the Wild. This is the worst stamina system in the history of gacha games. Combined with the worst drop rates in the history of gacha, I struggle to recommend this game. I want to because there's a great game buried under a bunch of garbage mechanics. Please change them.

For a gacha game, this feels like a Triple A game, the fact that we get into a wide open world like this for free is a fine bargain. My only grievance with this game is that there are certain areas that needs improvement like the Resin meter stuck at 160, could MAYBE increase that number by progression. Also the issue of Primo gem collection, its tedious to collect all the primogem u can in this game but once you cleared the content, its extremely difficult for a F2P to gather up primogem.

Outstanding revolutionary console-in-mobile game This is probably the only mobile game I don't regret waiting to download 5GB+ in size. It exceed my expectation in terms of quality and the open-world exploration. I'm a bit skeptical at first when people say that it's more or less BotW, but I was wrong. The game is non-competitive, so you can spare the worry of having "whaler" hindering the experience, and it's more of a single-player anyway rather than PvP!

Very good graphics and I'm honestly satisfied with the gacha rates and the pity system. The lore is beautiful and the music even more. But there are little amount of good end-game content, if there's one. The only end game content rn is Abyss, and it's just an increasingly difficult challenge to fight monsters. It would be better if more end-game content is added.

An absolutely amazing game. I haven't enjoyed a game this much for a long time. If you are thinking about playing this and enjoy open world single player experiences then do yourself a favor and play it. One of the best games to come out in a long time imo. Dont let the negative feedback about people saying that the gacha system ruins it. Because it's purely single player with some co-op elements. The gacha is purely for extra characters which you don't need to complete or enjoy the game.

Once the initial luster (which is quite amazing to be fair) runs out after a week or so you're forced to do nothing but run around and open chests. The resin system kneecaps you into the slowest progression imaginable with progress being impossible to achieve without spending money on refills if you actually like to play the game. But if you're one of the people who only have 10-15 minutes a day of free time and don't care for improvent then this game is for you.

There aren't many F2P games that you can see around with similar amount of attention to detail such as this game. With every update, the story and the world of the game is expanding more and more, even if just a little bit. It makes the game ever more wonderful to explore, especially for newer players. New players will have a massive world to explore. You can uncover every bit of the stories, lore, quests in the world, or you can just blindly explore and come across the hidden wonders and dangers of the world. Its a bit sad for me though, because I've gone and explored the world a bit too fast. At first I was a bit disappointed that I can complete the new contents almost immediately upon their release. However, after awhile I found that the gameplay is definitely more enjoyable when played for a more casual single player experience. That being said, while I find the game is definitely much more enjoyable when played casually. I can't say that such is the case for everyone. In the game community you'll find that there are many people who would advocate not spending a single cent on this game, claiming to be F2P. Meanwhile, the people who spend tons of money in this game are called whales. If you were to ask if you need to spend money to enjoy the game, I would say no. People are free to do what the want with their money and how they enjoy the game is up to them. However, when I do spend money on this game (which I do, from time to time), I believe it to be worth it after seeing the effort put into creating the game and its world. On another note, the game is being continuously updated with new content every 2 weeks-4weeks. The positive thing about this is that you know that you always have something new to do every 2 weeks or so. A negative aspect of this is (for newer players) that you may feel that you have missed out on a lot of good limited items when joining in a bit later than others. In that case, in really depends on the individual whether or not they mind not having ALL the limited items. Even I myself have missed out on some very good limited items, weapons, and also experience in limited story quests but I don't mind it too much. As I have mentioned before, I enjoy this game casually, and don't mind missing out on things while going on my own pace. Luckily and thankfully, the limited story quest events can be experienced through content creators such as those from YouTube. While there is still much to cover about this game, I think I will stop here for now. I can't wait to see what is in store for us in Genshin Impact in the future to come.

Okay, first of all the game is high quality and fun in general. I am currently adventurer rank 33 and the game even gives you a little over 50 dollars worth of gacha rolls for free if you play up to a certain point of the game(around 30 minutes in). Now why am I leaving a 2 star rating if I think it is so good? tl;dr insane gacha pricing and insane pull rates of characters. You can spend 1000s and not get the character you want. @#$%ing absurd. The energy system is horrible too.

This game is amazing! Even though it's a bit laggy sometimes on my phone but that's because of my internet.. But this game is really amazing and fun to play! The only problem is the fact it's difficult to get primo gems to wish for a certain character you want, Honkai star rail gives us free tickets to wish for a character every hour or so, This game doesn't do so, either way I love the combat, animation, puzzle solving and story quest! It's difficult to get wishes and primogems tho.

This game is good to play and really enjoyable, but please allow us to skip some really boring dialog... Those really suck. And about the gacha system, why not rerun more frequently most popular characters? At some point it becomes annoying to play without any beloved characters and we don't even know when their banners will be accessible. I'm about to leave the game for this...!!!

Hi, I love this game so much! Just maybe, if you'd be able to let us change our current emails and put all of our hard work and data into another email? It's just so irritating when I try to log in to my account on a different device, and it just won't let me in. Because the email I used for verification, my inbox is always empty. Please, Mihoyo, I love this game so much. I don't want to have to restart all over again in a different account .

It feels like playing a triple a game free of cost within a handheld console. With each update the game becomes even larger and better than before in the terms of story, music, environment, and even gameplay. If you are wondering if the game is pay to win or not it is not. You can try to get new charater and weapon using real money but every content in the game doesnt require strong characters to complete. Everything is doable with just a "free to play" team.

The best mobile game I ever played!!! I played every console out there. Every open world there is to play. This game has the best open world experience I ever played on a mobile platform. Similar to Zelda: Breath of the wild. It has very good fighting controls, interesting stories and cut scenes, and you can cook similar to Zelda. I'm so glad I found this game. On top of that, it's free to play. Of course, you can put money in, to advance your gameplay. I hope to see it in the Nintendo Switch!!

This is by far one of my most loved games. Great story, graphics, character designs, world exploration, combat, and co-op as well! I would recommend to get it on a PC since it can be difficult to play it on mobile. (Takes up a lot of storage) There are some minor complaints about this game from me, but I still a lot of fun playing it! The only thing I would say is that it is not that f2p friendly, but if your fine with that and just want to play for the gameplay, story, then definitely get it!

Neat gameplay, but rates are kinda stingy, which is only a problem in how limited the currency is. You'll most likely only have a handful of characters, and spend a lot of time waiting to get some new to round up your team. And progress is also halted by the "boss stamina" resin, which takes forever to recharge and using your scarce gems to refill is just a no-no. You'll still find some fun, even with luck as bad as mine.

I have a couple of major points I would like to discuss. First of all, early game, this is a brilliant game, there's tons to do with engaging storyline and unique characters. However, once you reach a certain point, you start to experience 'burnout'. There is a lack of repeatable but enjoyable endgame content apart from using your daily resin (which refreshes much too slowly) and doing your daily commissions. I would love to see a feature implemented that is exciting and repeatable for endgame players such as myself. My second point is the lack of communication from Mihoyo to their genshin player base. Hardly ever will they address the community and problems they have with the game currently

This game is SO GOOD. Only problems are that the creators (Hoyoverse) are kinda stingy. They take ideas that the players have been BEGGING for and put them into their other games. It also takes up a lot of space but that's just because there's a lot of content and always something to do. Each character is so unique, and the plot and lore is so deep. A lot of people haven't started playing because they're scared of the fandom but if you ignore them, the game itself is amazing.

Near Perfect. I'm in love with how everything synergizes together, from the lovely gameplay, beautiful atmosphere and so much more. I'd give it 5 stars if it's stamina system (Resin) recharged way faster. Waiting an hour for one basic quest is kinda brutal, especially in AR30 onwards. Perhaps you can shorten the Resin recharge to 2/4 minutes (2/4 minutes = 1 resin which equals 10/20 minutes to be able to do the cheapest resin quest) It would really give us more time to grind/play every day.

The fact that this game can run on mobile blows my mind. I play genshin impact on console, not on mobile, but still the mobile version is gorgeous. Its running well even on a lower end phone like my Huawei Y9 prime. The controls could be better, but if you're gonna play, just invest in a controller for your phone. Id recommend the "razer junglecat" it's well made but it's a bit pricy. Or u can just get a dualshock 4 it's about 25$, and if u have a ps4 ur good to go. It works perfectly.

Amazing quality, the lore is jaw dropping tho it sometimes get boring, I love the character designs and the quality of the environment, tho I hope they fix some bugs, I resonated with some animals? in natlan and when I move, glitches happen, like red boxes and non-stop blacking.. tho overall the game is fun to play with friends, has good quality, fun and entertaining!

more like a 3.5, but I cant put decimals. TLDR; it's a great game, but very power &/or money based. in more detail: it was better at early ages, now there's too much information it's stressing, and the moment you take a break and come back; you'll be fallen behind. not to mention it takes up lots of storage. is it fun? sure, when there are big events in the game. but is it worth tons of storage? not really. you can get many other games better then this for less storage. also VERY time consuming.

Just started the game a few days ago, it's an excellent game with rich, rich lore. The characters are amazing and well designed. Mihoyo, I know you heard this a million times but PLEASE make wishing a lot easier to do. I don't mean accessing the menu, I mean getting the stuff. Primogems are easy to gather and buy the wishing items but it's still very hard.

This game is definitely not perfect. There are many problems like the recent story chapters being rushed, the female characters having no dept, and how the playerbase is being treated is sad. The players themselves make it worse by flaming the fire. However, all in all I think this game is enjoyable. The characters are well designed, there's various playstyles you can try out, music and scenery is beautiful, battle system is fun, and meeting other nice players in co-op just makes my day.

With a Beautiful open world, interesting storylines, and a unique assortment of characters, Genshin Impact keeps me coming back constantly. While you can decide to spend some money you can enjoy almost everything the game has to offer for free aside from some premium outfits. Whether you like combat, strategy, puzzles, or even dating sims Genshin Impact has something for just about everyone. Definitely my favorite mobile game especially since it breaks the normal mobile game expectations!

I love everything in this game. From the storyline to the open world. Also the game is very F2P friendly, you don't really have to pay unless you wanted to. No annoying ads, just you, the incredible open world and incredible music. But with that being said, it may not be for everyone since the game requires certain device specs. All in all, I'm very much having fun playing this game at the same time get to do other things. Looking forward for more exciting events on this game. Thanks Hoyoverse!

Changing my review from launch. Mihoyo is an extremely stingy company. Genshin Impact is great in many ways. Gameplay is still fun, graphics are nice, and the soundtrack is absolutely fantastic. No, the game is ruined by a horrible business model. It's not just the character and weapon Gacha, it's the awful resin system. This is not a mobile idle game, so why does it have a stamina system like one? Is record profits and popularity not enough? You won't even let the player grind for artifacts.

Genshin is a fun open-world game with a ton of fun things you can do. You can battle, explore, play with your friends, etc. However, the amount of storage this hame takes up my phone is nearing 60gb due to the new regions and updates it requires its players to download. Dont get me wrong, the lore and story makes it worth it, but I think mihoyo should limit the amount of gigabytes needed for mobile players to download. I love the game, but many people quit bc of this exact reason

LOVE THIS GAME... HOWEVER... The game develops know what issues need to be fixed. The same issues that have been in the game before Inazuma was even a concept (on top of New issues regarding character models). The game is good at telling a story and there's nothing wrong with that however, I play this because it's a game. It hurts when those main elements of a game are lacking and it'll only get worse from here. I just really hope COGNOSPHERE fixes many (or all) of these issues in 3.0 (Sumeru).

Oh my God! I've been playing Genshin Impact for few months and I haven't even review it! Haha.. This is my favourite game, great visual arts, great voice acting, LOTS OF QUESTS and lots of hiding ones aswell. The only thing I'm wishing for is maybe some costumisation of the characters, like maybe we could use different colour clothes or hair or anything to make our character a little different from others. Amazing game and bright minds behind it.

Candidate for Game of the Year, honestly. It's not that any of the mechanics, gameplay, story, or art is new...but what Mihoyo has done is combine them all into a wonderful experience that is free to play. My advice, don't rush the game. There's plenty of content coming, but for those of us who got caught in launch hype, we're stuck grinding endlessly right now.

Can you change the Coop rules? Let everyone have access to domains, temples, chests and quests. everything is so boring when you play coop, like you have nothing to do. I play on ps4, another problem is the frame rate. i thought for consoles it can run smoothly? but it does not. please fix everything in the game, it has potential ill give you that, but its all gonna fade away soon if you dont listen to the community.

Really good so far. You need to work hard to find the chest and di quest to level up as a rank adventurer. You also need to think what to use and prioritize so the game is good for me so far. No need to pay money to grt characters too. Need more farming that's it! But it will also be good if we can have options to build our own character starting with their looks and powers. That will be awesome! Please look in my request devs.

This game is lovely, it has great features and amazing graphics! It's not an easy clicker game, and it's quite fun to play different characters and kill mobs! Please understand, this game is a GACHA game. They make most of their money from the wishing system, it's hard. Itll take time. Also for my fellow Mobile players, this game is not LONG TERM. Eventually we will not have enough storage for this game. It's already 16 GBS. Keep that in mind. <33

This is more like a single player game. You can still coop with other player by visiting their or inviting them to yours world only to help in some hard dungeon (?). The graphics is good even you set in low. It's a bit laggy if your ping is in mid. You can exploring the world and collecting naterials with huge backpack capacity. Not really sure about what ability to get when we pay to win since the game is pretty easy imo.. The thing i dislike about is not a open world game..

The game is absolutely beautiful! Controls are easy yet fun and the story is decent for a phone game. Piamon I'd adorable ❤ lots of fun characters to try and pull each with fun abilities,yet there doesn't seem to be a "Meta" which I love. Only issue is it takes FOREVER to earn enough to pull for characters. They really want you to spend money which I get it it's free to play but they really should make it easier to pull characters.

So far this is one of the best games I have played in a very long time. It feels more like a actual game versus a gatcha money sink. You have voice acted quests and story. Story videos. Fun side things to do. Supply gathering. Hidden enemies to fights. Unique combat system. Achievements to unlock. Cross platform accounts. Play on pc then play on the go with mobile. Game is over all a great experience. Additionally the different character option have been worth getting, not just for a catch them all gallery.

I've been addicted since original release, and consistantly spending an unhealthy amount of time playing this game. I am a f2p player, and have most of the playable characters, which I guess was my goal. It's way too hard to get them all by way of f2p, which is pretty sad for overcommitted players. I've always enjoyed the vast adventure and winding complexity, but I'm getting burnout on the punishing work-to-reward ratio. I'll be taking more breaks from Genshin. Game burnout bad.

Offering a unique flavor with the usual free-to-play gacha model, Genshin Impact has plenty of points to hit on when talking about what it does well. Exploration, combat, aesthetic, load times, and even cross-platform play all come together to form the core of Genshin Impact. These qualities are polished and while they are straightforward and simple, it is also easy to pick up and put down whenever. Definitely worth a try.

I've been playing since the Dragonspine update and while the game was fun at first, it's started to feel repetitive. The side quests have become too long and drawn out, and the lack of new male characters is disappointing. It feels like the focus is mostly on waifus now, which isn't for everyone. I hope future updates bring more balance and fresh, engaging content.

G.I. is a great experience so far. Keep in mind it is a Gacha game, but so far it doesn't seem heavily monetized. I've gotten various 4 and 5 star items/characters without spending a dime. The combat is fun and fluid, and the world to explore is much bigger than I anticipated. The only thing that is missing now is controller support. That would've made the game 5 star for me.

The game is absolutely amazing, I can't believe it's free. I guess the devs are compensating the price by making the 5 star characters' rates very low (at 0.6 percent, not even 1%) which is very understandable. I definitely recommend playing it on PC or PS4, there are not many phones that can play this game well and the controls are kind of bad on the phone. God tier game.

As of 2.5 this is one of the greatest games of all time. Its story and lore are phenomenal, its characters are some of the best, it has some of the best ost of all time, by far the best level design in any game ever, great gameplay with tons of fun stuff to do and events all the time, and the game is only getting better and better with each update. Just do yourself a favour and play on pc if you can, it's not for mobile.

The game is amazing and I love it! But irs practically impossible for mobile players to play it due to the crazy amount of storage it takes. It's such a lovely game and it makes me so sad to not be able to play it because of the storage.. Please, I really hope you guys can fix this issue as soon as possible! Many of us mobile players are devastated that we can't play genshin because of the storage

genshin impact is a great game. The characters the story and the gameplay. The two things i would like genshin to have is: 1. offline mode: being able to play the game offline. 2. more activities in co-op: it would be nice if there was more co-op events and more quests that you can play with your friends. That's what i would like for Genshin Impact. 🙂

Tbh, Genshin Impact were one of the best games I have played in a long time. To better describe it, Genshin would be like Zelda breath of the wild if you turned it into anime. The map may be big, but the game was designed in a way that makes it rewarding to actually explore. Basically, I love this game and would recommend you to give it a try. Also the best part about this game is that you can play it in different platforms, from computers to ps4. 10/10, very epic game!

This game has been fun and great so far. The Gacha mechanic doesn't seem too bad so far. My only complaints so far are the slow download at the start (the game just came out so I'm not holding that against it), and the lack of controller support for the mobile version. I'll probably spend more time playing the PC version since this supports crossplay and cross-save. Please add controller support!

Genshin Impact breaks the mold of other mobile games in the same genre, it's not pay-to-win, playing for you, low-effort stuff, Genshin Impact is a gorgeous game with an interesting story and fun combat and movement. I love it, it completely drew me in and I will definitely play it more. Update and edit: seems that the more I play of this, the more broken everything about it becomes. It's a shame, the game has some real potential too

Incredible! The quality and production value of this game exceeds every other mobile game I played. There's just so much to do with so many fun features and worlds to explore. Definitely worth the install, you get a full triple A game experience free to play. (Granted, there's a gacha system for unlocking new characters and summoning currency is a little stingy to come by after the intial tutorial, but even then, it's worth the install.)

5+ hrs in and so far so good. Playing this both on the PC and android phone. beautiful game on both screens, gameplay is enjoyable and exploration is highly encouraged. Don't be too put off by the gatcha elements of game, the default characters have so far been effective enough to still very thoroughly excel at the game. Try to avoid making this out to be a 'BoTW' clone, there are more fully realized characters, a story and multiple worlds to explore. Give it a chance to impress you.

Honest opinion, and not just jumping on this bandwagon that's happening right now. The game has a lot of problems in basically every aspect. Wayy too grindy. Lots of greedyness. But my problem is actually in the dialogue. It can become Incredibly and increasingly boring to stand around hearing about all the characters just trying to lick each other through words. No conflict whatsoever. We're doing this. Wow you are so great at doing this. Stop trying to sell characters and get to the point!

Meta dictates what you pull, if you wanna be able to do end game content comfortably without mass investing in low end characters. This makes it hard to pull exclusively only for what you actually like(ascetics). If you don't have a problem with picking between what you want and Meta. Then its a good game for you. Otherwise you will suffer watching your favorite character become garbage and being forced to get something better if you want to keep up. If you don't wanna keep up , good for you.

The graphics are absolutely amazing but I will have to give it a 4 because of the co op experience and limited time events. For newer players, missing out some of those limited time events will ruin some players' experience of the game because well, simply they weren't just there to experience firsthand. Now the co op experience, it's very limited to what we can do like only allow co op within your chosen server which is disappointing because not everyone in one server speak the same language

Miliastra Wonderland should be an optional download. Honestly, I have little interest in playing co-op unless it's to help others get resources, beat bosses, or just help other players overall. Please make parrying an actual mechanic and not just limited to some characters' skills. Update old characters, especially the old limited characters, skill sets to keep up with the meta PLEASE. Aside from that, I've really enjoyed the game, and will continue to enjoy it for the foreseeable future.

Amazing game, but the problem is that its space is very heavy, it is the size of a PC game, and this is difficult for devices, even though some they are advanced literally than before. I mean, I can handle it, but I want to play other games, not just this one, And for those with space like this that prevent me from playing other games, this makes me think about deleting it, You should enhance the Cloud version, and I recommend that you open servers in north africa, especially Algeria, Good luck!

Kinda stunned by the quality so far. Never expected this game to be this good. Still need to get used to different elements and how to combine them but thats what ups the skill ceiling. The game has a bit of P2W where you can use cash to open multiple packages and get stronger heroes and weapons quicker but the difference is seriously negligible so far. You are awarded with enough points to open a few packages yourself and there is nothing stopping you from enjoying as free 2 play

Best free mobile game of its kind. This game has no business being free. The quality of the story and combat are excellent. The graphics are cutting edge for a mobile platform. The sheer amount of things you can do and enjoy without being impeded by paywalls unlike other games is what keeps me hooked. I can't believe how polished the game is. The fact that it allows crossplay is an extra boon. It constantly rewards you with free stuff so you dont feel left behind for not paying.

I genuinely enjoy playing the game. The gacha system is pretty exhausting but that's how all gachas are, draining. Nevertheless, the story is questionable but still keeps me on my toes. The resin system is difficult to play with too, only getting 160 resin per day with the cost that domains are really lengthens the farming process. Which is good for the game, it being long term. There's also several opportunities to get more resin. Lastly, can I place more items in my teapot please? No limit!

Sunk hundreds of hours into this. Really fun at first but then it's all fetch quests and grinding. And sooooo much tedious dialogue. The gatcha system seems a lot less generous than before, and they keep adding pointless new characters. New 5* characters are only as good as old 4* characters and new 4* characters are trash. That said, it's still a pretty entertaining game. And there are no ads (KFC collab and gem purchase page notwithstanding), so it's pretty amazing what you get for free.

this game has helped me greatly in a positive light, the enchanting places. the nations struggles and solutions. and how cooperation and friendship, even trust has a drastic change to before the traveler came to there. even if it's tiring and possibly boring, there's no lying that I enjoy how the stories and the songs goes, I wish that it continues to be like this, and I hope you who reads this comment of mine hopeful and positive!

Why is this free? This game is worth at least 60$. I don't know what witchcraft you people did to somehow fit all of this into a mobile phone, but I would like to say that I support it. Gameplay is great; at first, with the movement and puzzles, you can see why people call this game a "Breath of the wild copy" But the gameplay similarities ends as soon as we reach combat. The main focus of combat is elements, and these elements are also very reactive to the environment.

I'm truly stunned at how long it took developers to put out a rpg like this all while there are so many on PC (MMORPGs, except this isn't a mmo). This game is amazing on mobile and it's addicting with its story and many quests. I can see myself playing this game for a long time. For those who complain the game keeps crashing on them, it's possible that your device does not meet the minimum requirements to run it. I am using a OnePlus 7t and have no issues :)

Love the game so much. Its open world, anime, and a gacha game. The world is absolutely gorgeous. It's on mobile and pc which means when I'm not at the house I can play on the go like when they release events and im not home and so far no bugs and the graphics amazing. I love the variety of characters with gears and weapons this is the anime rpg that I like. J also like how they got an English cast as well.

If u are unable to play any console/PC game, and really like exploring, this is definitely a game for u. For instance, I started around 5months ago and my exploration for the first region is only around 80%, that means there's still something I'm missing, and that's only the first region. Now, I'm no expert, but to me, the music is some really good stuff, especially a certain fat boss and the polish, chef's kiss. All in all, the premiere exploration game on mobile.

I love genshin impact. But the problem I'm having with the game is at the start when you first downloaded it. I played this before and it took a long time just to download. I was a bit frustrated by this and I had to do something productive while I wait. It also takes up a ton of storage and I had to delete like 4 or 5 games from my phone. What's pretty disappointing is the lack of dialogue the main character has (Whether its Lumine or Aether). To be honest, they kind of have a lack of character

Enjoy the game at your own pace, the graphics, music and gameplay are great. If you're a daily player and plays a lot of hours into the game you'll get to progress wall around 2-3 months in the game, by then it's better for you to have someone to play the game for you to do the dailies and farm. The grind will destroy any good will you have since the resin system and bad RNG can sour any good opinion you have on this game. At that point you can play every other update for story, events, etc....

One of the best game I've played in a long, long time. You can have a wonderful experience and a ton of different characters without spending a dime. Combat is smooth and interesting, and story is very good so far. The gacha is obviously the worst part of this, but to enjoy this game you really don't have to touch that thing ever. Though the game gives you a lot of premium currencies for everything you do in game, so you can have a relatively collection of gacha characters and weapons.

MiHoYo definitely knocked this out of the park! 💖 Amazing visuals, music, story, everything! I was waiting for this game to release since its announcement and dang, they didn't disappoint. There are a few bugs here and there but that's to be expected. As a gacha connoisseur, you will definitely want to collect all of the characters as their character designs are amazing! Tho the rates are kind of awful but I am already used to it :'> Looking forward for future updates from you guys! 😊

The gacha part is not so good. However, i like the gameplay very much. Ive seen 1 star reviews complaining about late game but for me so far theres still a lot of content for me to play around with since i have never gotten far into the game when i first played. But i have gone back into it, rn at AR 22 and it still looks like theres a lot of things to do here. But, do consider it is not so good as a gacha game. (Although you dont always need new characters or weapons all the time)

Gacha system favors some acc, RNG sucks. If I count "capturing radiance" as a loss, then that's a 5-lost streak while some accounts won their 50-50s, 8 times at early pity. Each version rewards not enough primogems for a guaranteed 5-star, you greedy company. Hope you guys got sued or something. This is a "multi-billion" company BTW.

I really love this game. The storyline is also pretty nice. But if u have a storage that is under 64gb i will recommend u to get some extra storage or something. Because the game is very heavy and that will also make's u experience lagging and glitching while playing them. It will also effect if u have a slow processor and small ram. Over all, nice game!!!

If you play this game for free and don't spend money, it's a pretty great free game. The gameplay, story and graphics are great but the gacha rates are horrible. 180 pulls (between $300-400 USD) to guarantee a 5-star banner character. Yes, $300-400 USD for 1 copy of a digital item that needs several copies to reach its max potential. Give the game a try but my advice is to resist spending since the rates for getting 5-stars is horrible. You can play with the lower tier characters just fine.

Truthfully I checked out this game because of the uproar about it being a LOZ BOTW ripoff, but after playing it for about an hour it became quite obvious that it wasn't. I can see where Botw had given inspiration for parts, but besides thoughs the game is very much its own. My only wish is that I could play it using my bluetooth controller. If it does come out on the switch, I can definitely say that I will downloaded as soon as I find out.

Okay, this game is AWESOME and AMAZING!!! I have nothing negative to Say about the game experience, graphics: check, story:check, quests:check, and pretty much any other aspect of the game GIANT CHECK! But there is one thing. It keeps crashing on me for about 15 mins on the average of use. It fits snug in my phone's storage and I have a good amount left, but I don't understand why it keeps doing it. PLEASE FIX IT FOR ANDROID USERS! I WANT TO PLAY THIS GAME SO BAD 🥺

Editing my review from 3 to 4 stars. I've been off and on this game since it dropped, and the improvements they've made since then are awesome! Yes, it is still a grind, but they have made it so much easier to understand what you need to grind specifically to level your characters more efficiently. It's also a million times easier to level your Adventurer Rank so you can continue the main story (Archon quests). And the msq is *really* good! (Up to Fontaine. Just started Natlan)
been playing this game since release and i love it dearly but as of late its become unbearable. the powercreep is atrocious and you are simply not able to play your favorite characters anymore.

It's story is good for me, though I wish more INTERESTING events are added, and focus on the games main issues instead of just adding more characters. I also wish that the gacha system isn't so cruel. Atleast make the pity a 70 or even 60. And please communicate with the players more. You do surverys but you don't even listen to them. You have alot of potential really, you just need to listen and work on the game, PROPERLY.

Love this game. It's truly free to play, and it doesn't force you to pay to continue after a certain point. Plenty to do everyday if you're just down to spending 30-60 min. Even their gacha system will guarantee you a top tier item every 90 turns...unlike some other games. You get to test out promo characters before deciding if you want to drop gems/money into the gacha. All I wanna say is, you drop money only when you feel like it, and if you don't, the game doesn't stop your progress. 👍

I started playing because my wife liked it and I have to say as a video game fanatic this game isn't half bad. Good story with realistic progression and room for grinding away and growth on the side like any decent RPG. Game mechanics are all simple, even if they take a little study, and the ones that aren't just take a little patience to pick up. Graphics good audio and frame rates good and the multiplatlyer function is really smooth. Overall I like the game and have it on Ps4 PC and mobile.

I really like genshin alot. So far I've had so much fun. Really a home run. Thank you so much for making such an amazing experience. However I can't seem to log into my mobile account on playstation because I'm automatically logged in and can't log out. Either the option isn't there or it needs to more user accessable/easy to find and do. I'm also not talking about linking an email. I mean loging into any uid on playstation like u can on PC. That's my only criticism. Otherwise awesome

This is one of the best game I have ever played. The graphics, UI, language, characters, and stories. The only things is, if you're a F2P (Free To Play) player, you don't get that much rewards (Primogems, Resins). The tasks only gives you 5 to 10 primogems (which is okay, but not that fair), the resin refill time (it's kind of a long time) and the ways to replenish your resins, I think there should be a shop in-game where players can buy fragile resins etc. Where players can pay with sigils etc.

No game is perfect and despite its flaws, genshin has been able to consistently do what a lot of products are unable to during intermissions, craft an enjoyable, light and casual experience that respects players' approach and time in the game. Coupled with a god tier soundtrack, engaging lore and the open world, I couldn't care less what haters had to say, it's five stars.

I love this game. Character stories, lore, and fighting types are all incredibly fun and enticing. However, since the 5.0 update, there has been increasingly abundant lag. A good friend of mine has to wait upwards of 3 minutes to get through the loading screen. I often face lag to the point that my game restarts itself. My Internet quality and provider have not changed, so I know for certain it isn't that. I'm hoping the Developers fix this in the coming updates.

For a free to play game this one is definitely top tier, my #1. You can go ahead and whale but you don't have to!! I have a job and only play casually, and still get everything I want out of my game experience every time. Consistent updates keep the game fresh and new. This is my new favourite game and will be for quite a while :) Note: been playing since free Fischl event and still love it. Spending money on a free game does not entitle you to anything, cause you can enjoy it for $0!!!!

The game is pretty fun, it's LoZ: BotW but w/ more story & variety to the combat. The only issues I have so far are: No controller support on mobile & PC controller layout can't be edited. Memory Leaks on both PC & Mobile causing both to run hot. If you idle for more than a minute the characters idle is annoying & loud. Too many currencies. There are 5-6 & a battle pass once you reach level 20. A tutorial on the 3 currencies revolving around real money & the gacha mechanic would be nice.

I loved the game, but at some point it took up way too much storage and got boring (I practically finished the game so take it with a grain of salt). Its a good game if you dont have many apps and tons of storage. I would be wary of the community / fandom, theres a lot of weird people. Though I only speak for the English part. In terms of story it goes deep, I could rant for an hour about the lore and theories. If you dont impulsively buy things you should definitely play it.

For a casual, free 2 play game... it's the best game handheld device could offer! But, for a gacha game... this is WAAAY worse than what you would expect. Everything's gated, yes, but that's not the worst part. Involvement of credit card is necessary to allow advancement in many, many things. Sure, do play this game... however don't go too deep, it will COST you! Way more than you can imagine...

Would appreciate it if my review wasn't deleted 4 times. The game is good if you plan on only spending ~30 minutes in the game and nothing more.Endgame is loggin in and completing commissions and grinding for artifacts. Nothing wrong with that, if that wasn't the only things to do. Anyone with eyes can see this is a good game, but you have to admit there's a bunch of flaws with content. The most exciting content we get is released in ONLY limited time events, why is that the case? Oh wait (･_･)

The game is really nice and fun to pass the time. But it started to be troublesome for people like me who have to play on the phone. First of all, although I don't have a very good phone, I was having fun in Genshin and I like to spend time on game. But unfortunately after new 2.2 update (as the game file is too huge) I couldn't update it and there's no way for me to play it anymore. Is there something they can do on game? Maybe resizing if that works, because I would want to keep playing tbh.

Game use to be great but the amount of time you have to waste to get a certain thing is a huge time consuming and is not worth your time. The time it takes to get a certain character or getting a good artifacts is extremely time consuming. Im surprised they haven't fix this problem of the game and it's been years since the game came out. Maybe because they are way focused on getting their money instead of improving some part of the game which people have been complaining about way before.......

Great game that is fun to play for hours. I do have 2 minor complaints though. I wish I could hook up a controller to my phone to play it on my TV (I have a USB-C to HDMI adaptor). Also I can't link my PS4 account to my Android account or vice versa. I've heard that this is because Sony has some limitations but I wish you could come to some agreement. I would happily start again if it meant I could like the two accounts somehow.

The game itself is okay but is has become unplayable on my older device as it makes my Wi-Fi connection and/or the whole phone crash. Additionally, the download system is horrible: It takes huge amounts of space, it is slow and doesn't calculate the necessary space beforehand so you can end up having to delete/uninstall things through the process. I'd still play it on PC but clearly not on any phone.

AR60, 100% exploration. I spent more than a thousand hours on the game, both on pc and mobile. All I can say in my few years of experience is that everyone will feel upset around after 50 hours of the game. Bad artifacts, too much time and effort to save primogems for character, etc. But after spending hundreds of hours, I can say that I already have so much characters that I want, I dont have to farm artifacts like crazy anymore, and I am enjoying the game like how an endgame player would.

I've played this game for over two years. I've loved this game from the start but now I feel like quitting it. I want the game to be enjoyable but I haven't been having fun playing it. The main problem is the wishing system and rewards. I grind for hours but not even get 10 wishes. There needs to be a way to get the 4 star you choose. That's all I wanted this banner. I wasted hours for nothing. They make characters we want unreachable so the whales spend. They do not listen to us. Why would they

I used to love this game, and still do. I watch most (if not all) the story from externals sources nowadays because of my lack of time. The lack of a skip dialogue button in 2025 is just unbearable. I don't have enough time in my hands to go on and read for 3 hours anymore. The day the devs include SKIP button option, then I'll join again and will enjoy the game again.

Im waiting for this game, and when it finally came out i was very hyped. The graphics is good also the gameplay but this game is made for high end phone. I did everything. Set the graphics into lowest and still the game freeze when i approach cities and some little villages. Also the phone heats up so much like u can cook eggs ln it. I really hope that you optimize this as soon as possible. Maybe you can make this coz there are so many people there want to play your game. Please please please

Fun game, but I recommend playing on a desktop, laptop, or any compatible Chromebook. Most phones can barely handle it and it takes up an absurd amount of storage space. As far as gameplay and graphics goes the game is amazing, considering it's a pc game ported to play on lower end devices it's supprisingly optimized for low end laptops. I don't care if you have 4gb of ram and an Intel Celeron, you can probably find some way to still run it, just don't expect the best experience.

The game is not only beautiful but comprehensive as well. With various characters, weapons, and elements, the battles in the game are very fun. I love how the elements of the characters can affect the environment and will create different results depending on said element. The open world is also vast and there is plenty of content to enjoy. This game definitely gets a 5/5.

Ever since release, I've been actively enjoying the game! (I got it on my phone and Ps4) my phone however cannot handle the game anymore and the Ps4 wont let me log into the game for some reason... so I sadly havent played this in over 3 months. I am sad I'm missing out on a lot of stuff. In addition to that you had to make many seprate acounts if you wanna play with someone not in your region (or if you play on different platforms) this game has a lot of potential, I can't wait to play again!

A fairly good game marred by a low drop rate gacha system. Note, this is not a game you should rush to play through, you will quickly run out of things to do and make you feel frustrated when the content is drip fed monthly. I finally uninstalled this game after seeing gameplay for Wuthering Waves. Genshin was fun for a time, but found something better to wait for. Plus the slow combat and world traversal got outdated in genshin, which wuthering waves improves on from what they showed.

Absolutely loving this game! Well-built characters with distinctive skills, beautiful story, very realistic graphics and amazing game play. It feels like you're part of the Genshin Impact world and all sub-characters react to your actions with lots of missions, puzzles and monsters to conquer! Only potential downside I can point out is how long it takes to gather enough primogens to summon characters/weapons. Overall, I would give this game 10 stars if I could!

I really love this game, it keeps me entertained and I'm always looking forward to the plot. However, one little problem I encounter is the resin system where it takes too long to fill them up and the gacha rates for getting nice artifacts are too low. It is hard to farm when your characters do not have proper builds to begin with. Also, it only takes like 30 min.- 1 hour in spending all of those.

a fun game! though after a while you eventually run out of content to play so the most you can do is do your daily commissions and grind to make your characters better, which can get a bit repetitive, but that is okay! I also love the music and the sound design, it's really cool! but regarding the character design: hoyoverse, don't be afraid to give the characters some melanin.. we have 2 tan characters and the rest is as white as snow, I'm sure you can do better... right?

The story is rlly good, Great characters, and pretty animations. The game itself is just perfect as it is a mobile game. Its crazy that this runs on phones tbh. The only problem I have is the "Wish" character roll packs. Even if I was to want to drop money in this game I wouldn't, the roll rates for those character packs are so ridiculously low that its aggravating wasting my time on something as pointless as those packs. And you can't get them unless you GRIND hard or pay money and im 'ftp'!!!!

The game has it's longterm issues but it is still very fun to play. The music cannot be beat (play with sound on), the scenery is top notch, it's actually very f2p friendly, the story is riveting, and the characters are all very enjoyable. There is a wide range of playstyles available with the characters to suit many different play styles. Even if you're not smashing through endgames, the rewards for lower levels are still worth it even as a mediocre player.

Don't get me wrong, I appreciate the game for what it is. I stopped playing a bit ago though because the massive emphasis on optimization when you reach each endcap requiring grinding and being on top of the gacha simply ruined the enjoyment for me ultimately. I had fun while it lasted, but that wasn't what i wanted out of this game. I'll admit, asking for something along the lines of Breath of the Wild on mobile was up there. But something along those lines would have been great.

I have very little to say when it comes to problems with this game. The artwork, soundtrack and gameplay is great. The gatcha system is questionable. When there is so much talk and stress about the gatcha rates/money people are throwing at this game, I think you need to look closer at the ethics. Some people are spending more than my monthly salary on this game and I don't think that is smart or impressive, I think that's a gambling addiction and morally wrong to even allow or promote this.

Resin is a horrible system. There are enough characters and weapons in game to last until next update. I feel like the mechanics of the game are insulted by resin as the game discourages you to experiment. Why have a fun combat system if you punish a player who wants to have fun by experimenting. Mora, weapon xp, character xp and artifacts shouldn't be gated. Warframe is a fun game for that exact reason.

The graphics and the character designs in this game are incredible, not to mention how precious this game is to the fandom. What I'm asking for is PLEASE compress the storage or else so many players are going to be unable to play due to the lack of storage capacity very soon. I absolutely love the worldbuilding and scenery in the game, and have spent just exploring Teyvat for hours if not days.

Although I was pretty skeptical whether or not this would be worth my time, I decided to try it out. I am now kinda in love with this rpg/BoTW clone. Also, its free from the in-app-purchase hell most other free2play experiences are trapped in, which is nearly unheard of (for some reason). My only complaints are; 1. Its kinda difficult to get stones for wishes. Kinda lame, but understandable. 2. This experience would be perfect on a console, and my phone isn't particularly large.

The fact that this game is as amazing as it is, and is free, is enough to give a 5-star review. But beyond that, the storylines are engaging and the visuals are stunning. Not to mention, the amount of content that is released on the regular outshines quite a few paid games (phone, console, and PC). I definitely recommend this to everyone.

Pros: - gorgeous looking game. - very fun combat - big open world woth lots to do Cons: -gotcha mechanics, very expensive gotcha mechanics(40$ CND to get one roll) -Low drop rates on playable characters. Most likely going to roll all weapons. Over all the game is fun and feels great to play. I just can't get past the aggeeious gotcha mechanics. As stated above you are more then likely to just roll all weapons because of how low the drop rates are with playable characters. Players beware.

the game itself is good. characters, music, design etc. what the game is lacking is how the players will enjoy the game for a long time. it lacks the content that will make the players stay even though there's not much update. for example, the resin is too low for the increasing numbers of bosses to upgrade characters and also the low drop rate of good artifacts. but overall the game is good, i just hope that you'll be more appreciative with the player's effort and make more non-event content.

I truly adore genshin. The characters are adorable, and the artwork is all French kisses. But, honestly, one of the issues I have with Genshin is that some of the characters needs more coverage.   Second, this game is quite time demanding. I resigned because of that, and I spent more time on this game than I should have. Third, the game is extremely rigid. It's impossible to have decent characteristics when primogens are so difficult to obtain. Also, it requires a skip button.

I really don't care about other people's opinion on this game. All I can say is that this game brought me happiness during the tough times (yes, the covid-19 pandemic). I was struggling but when I played this game, it gave me a reason to start my day. Opening my account as soon as I wake up. Grinding artifacts and materials for my desired characters. Exploring various areas by yourself. It may take a really long time to maximize a character but in the end, it IS a gacha game and you played it.

One of the best rpg games I've ever played honestly. If you're playing on a device like a gaming PC then i really do advise you to turn the graphics to the max because they're immaculate. The games storyline and lore is also really interesting to read through, so when you're just starting out i again advise you to not skip any of the stories they really are amusing. But, if your going to dowkload genshin then get a device that handles big files, because its only 4.0 but it already takes up 10+GB

This game is absolutely amazing and I have 0 complaints. It's not one of those "free" games that requires money for the game to be pleasurable. I have so far not spent a single penny on this game, but have gotten through just fine. Although I have since switched to playing on ps4, I was super shocked at how well it runs on mobile as well. All in all 10/10 would recommend. :)

I love this game. I just wish that the community would be heard more often. The newest character kits need fixing/buffing. There's no proper end game content, so logging in feels like a 30 minute chore doing dailies. I wish the resin system would be more generous to us so we had something to look up for in the end game, 'cause i really would like to play this game. It's just that there's barely anything to do.

honestly, for me it keeps crashing every 4 hours I've been playing, like I don't know if it's my device that does it or just the game itself. overall it's still a very cool game. I'm just upset about the game crashing part. If it is from the game then I hope it gets fixed soon because I tried everything to my phone and it kept on crashing soooo I don't know anymore

Best mobile game for me, so far. I love the characters and the lores. I like that players can still enjoy the game for free without ads although I did pay for some but, it's just for me to show my support and appreciation to the devs. There are also events to look forward to. Controls are very simple. I love that you can also co-op with other players and the best thing is that its an open world. Yay for Genshin 🎉🎉

Used to love the game, but the devs have introduced power creep and the exploration is hard to traverse without the latest characters. The game just feels like a cash cow now compared to its former passion project. Not only that, the story is long and tedious with no skip button and barely any cutscenes or even dynamic camera work. What used to be one of the best games has become one of the worst nightmares to play. Still, it was the first game that I played that I really liked.

This game used to be good in early patch, but now it's lack of quality. No improvement at all in terms of storytelling. If only they know how to deliver their lore in interesting ways instead of just yapping or hidden in the book which I'm too lazy to read all those things. The gameplay and exploration also getting tiring and it's no longer fun as it used to be. For someone who play from version 1.0, I don't even feel like to play this game anymore.

I can't bring myself to give this game a rating less than a 4/5, it's simply fenomenal. But the reason I've stopped playing it it's because of the rewards. It's absolutely soul-crushing spending all that time collecting primogen, just to have some useless lv3 swords and a horrible lv4 sword. And this happened to me 3 times, 3 TIMES. Also the prices are stupidly high. It's simply not worth paying that much money only to get some dumb swords that you are gonna throw away eventually.

One of my friends recommended this to me, and I have to say I'm not disappointed in the slightest! Paimon can get annoying, but the overall game is phenomenal! Temptation can be high for putting money on it for 5 star hero banners and for monthly battle passes, but the game can be played 100% free without dropping money on it (it's how I started out before shelling some money on it). I play on PC since my phone doesn't have a lot of storage space (runs way better on PC than mobile). 10/10 game

Solid Impact | 7.5/10 | Genshin Impact is a demanding game both from a hardware and time perspective. Yet its high quality values are not normally found in a free-to-play. It's nice atmosphere, plethora of content, and engaging combat will keep your attention. I would say its weak point would be the run of the mill storytelling. It's not terrible per-say but it isn't overly memorable. The variety of characters are solid, though. I would recommend this to role-playing enthusiasts.

Genshin is so amazing! Although I reccomend playing it on pc or console if your phone can handle it go for it! The graphics are just so beautiful it's so hard to believe it's free, The characters are so well done I've gotten attached to some of them! I should also add how much I appreciate he genshin wasnt shoved down your throat on places like youtube as much as other games are. Some games I never hear the end of, a lot of them genshin rip offs. But I love how amazingly advertised this was!

I legit thought this game was gonna be like the rest of the cash grab gacha games out there but I was surprised that it isn't. Yes it still a gacha game, but it gives me a breath of the wild feel with the exploration and cooking. Paring the action combat system with the many characters is definitely a plus and makes this game a must try. It's also cross-platform you know

Have been playing this for a while myself, and enjoy it extremely. I'm f2p, and find it incredibly easy to get the 5☆ characters I really want, and enjoy the gameplay the 4☆ characters possess. Enjoy the graphics, story, characters design, and much more. (The only problem for me has to do with the obvious tilt towards female characters, but I still find all of the male characters to be enjoyable enough to ignore this small issue)

Installed since it basically came out. It tells you about the different cultures as well as stories that can be found in voice lines of the characters. The gacha is quite fair, if you ask me and its definitely a game where it is not necessary to spend money. They put in a lot of effort in every aspect of the game, especially the music. The only thing I wish for at the current moment is a male playable character with long hair in a high ponytail. Mihoyo please. I'm begging you on this. 跪~

The gameplay has a few glaring flaws. Not only is the exploration level gated, making the open world uninviting to new players, but the gatcha is terribly designed. Why bother allowing characters in the basic gatcha that you will not have access to upgrade materials for until the end of the game? I ended up with nothing but terrible starters and a host of characters stuck at level 20. It just isn't worth the trouble.

I spent $350 on a pixel 4a just so I could finally play this game. I'm here to say it was worth it. By far the best Mobile experience I've had. It's blown my mind how amazing this game is. Full on console/PC experience on a mobile device. 5/5 best game in the app store. If I were to sum up my description of the game. I'd say it's a BOTW Gotcha based clone. Which 100% works given it's free and all.

Absolutely love this game. As a f2p gamer as well. Everything about it is amazing. There's many hidden Easter eggs. As well as beautiful landscapes that you can't seem to get to yet.
