Lol this game is a masterpiece. Voiced action. Beautiful cinematics. The only thing I'm not a fan of. Is that it's only available on my mobile. I could probably sit and play this for hours if my phone would last long enough. Thank you hoyoverse. Only wish it were available on Xbox.

I have played for 4 years now and I am still not tired or burned out. There is so much to do with all the quests, puzzles, story, etc... Genshin Impact is easily my favorite game all time and no one in the world can change my mind. Although the total storage it takes is kinda scary and the lore is usually dropped in large quantities and large amount of the game's lore is in books so there is that. Any ways I highly recommend playing this game if you like Anime gacha games and good story.

I have to say, the people that developed this game progressed really far and wide, and I respect that. Active updates, a more range of areas to yet discover, it's a great experience especially if it's your first time playing an RPG game! Though one of the downsides are that some devices aren't compatible to play Genshin Impact which is unfortunate. Nonetheless, a great game you should try!

The experience is really good for a mobile open world game. The story and characters are engaging and you won't feel the flow of time at all while playing. Update: still playing the game until now and my only banter is exploration is a pain if you don't have certain characters. It would be good if they would release a character that's easy to get or a gadget that helps with exploration.

This game is wonderful. I would give it 5 stars but there is one problem for me, the storage space. You either have this game or other games. It takes up so much storage space. That's why I personally play on Ps4, Ps5, or Pc/Laptop. But if you're looking for a fun adventure game with great writing, fun characters and great graphics this game's for you.

I've been playing this game for two weeks and I can't get enough of it. I definitely recommend this game to those who wanted to play alone and explore a place like Teyvat, collect random materials, and gather your own food. You can also play with other players if you want to, but the system (the game) won't force you to play with them. Do what you wanted to do. Complete the given tasks, defeat the enemies, and earn moras and primogems.

This isn't your typical gacha game, plastered with .jpegs and card attack animations. Nothing about this screams "GACHA" when you first see it, in fact, it looks like your standard triple A game. But it isn't. You're forced to summon for characters and weapons as you progress, and then grind for the required mats (most with horrendous drop rates) and no auto-skip function like other gacha games. If you enjoy open-world RPGs, then this game might be for you. Otherwise, you'd have to reconsider.

the story has been improved immensely over the past 5 years but the amount of effort needed to guarantee a 5 star character is ridiculous. the pull economy in this game is crazy bad especially with how power creep is affecting the game with the horrible nod krai "mechanics." I love the world but I'm finding myself playing and paying less and less with the games direction. More pulls, and better events are necessary for a lot of players enjoyment, especially my own.

I really enjoy this game! The characters are amazing, and the plot is even better. The only problem is the size of the game. 18GB. I had to delete it due to taking up all of my storage, and the grinding for characters is the same old thing. It's also like a pay to win game. You need specific characters to defeat certain bosses and so on. These are just some small things, and I have made many friends through this.

I downloaded it because of the hype, and I've played other mihoyo games before, but not for long because I can't get into the character rotation, it just isn't my type of battle system. So I already failed at the third temple lol when the wind riding and tile jumping stuff becomes the main hurdle to overcome in order to progress - without finishing this crucial quest you can't go on in the game. However: Graphics, animation, story, VAs, music + the many game modes, it's all absolutely FABULOUS!

I love this game. I have sunk 100s of hours into this game and I still haven't done everything I want to do. Such a brilliant storyline and the characters released just get better and better. It's easy enough to play without paying for more crystals. I always have around 60-70 wishes ready for each banner I want a character from so there's no issues for trying to get your favourite characters if you can sink your time into this game.

I do wish they would work on balancing the characters after release, and that they'd add more end-game/co-op content, but other than that, this is the best game I've played in I don't know how long. It's fun, has lovable characters, and has a very interesting story. After a year of logging in every day, it's difficult to imagine a time when I didn't play it. I hope Mihoyo continues to listen to player feedback, because with some tweaks, this will go far.

MAKE THE REWARDS MATCH THE EFFORT!! It's really annoying when you do a confusing quest for an 1 hr just to get just about one quarter of a wish. The game is really fun but it's also hard for mobile players with lag.. Also add some colour to the characters PLEASE. They are all white as paper even the "black" characters. They barely pass as tanned.

Great game. I was absolutely blown away and haven't even got to co-op yet. The lore and stories of each character/the world are extensive and well written. Lotsof exploration and things to find through out the open world. Yhe game is very free to play friendly, however I personally have spent 5 dollars on the monthly card and will continue to do so as long as the developers continue their dedication to hearing their player and creating mobile game truly worth playing!

I feel bad playing this game for free. The gameplay, the story the graphics, all perfect. Some people complain about the gacha system in this game. Dude, you dont have to pay. The game can be completed WITHOUT spending any money. I am free to play player, i dont have 5 star, and i still complete all the story line and challenges in the game. You have to play and pay RESPONSIBLY. Dont fall for the gacha trap and just enjoy the game.. all in all this is the best game i enjoyed in a long time.

Its a good game(although its time consuming🤣) but overall the graphic, storyline is extraordinary. Everything is good but it lacks few things, maybe u can add voice and speaker function so that people didnt need to chat during battle. Add new mode where we can fight and flex our character between friends. Fix the ping where its suppose to be green but yellow only in genshin and many more. Excited for each updates of the game.

There's so much more to this game than what people give it credit for, the story, the music, the combat, the open world, the grinding, and the gacha element, everything is about it is so perfect, though the drop rates for characters and weapons may be concerningly low but that still doesn't change the fact that this is the best free game out there, coming from an AR 55 player.

I play on PS4 but I decided to review here. I used to really love this game and I still do but after you reach AR50 there's nothing to do anymore. This game feels more like a chore than an actual game which really sucks because when I first got my PS4 the first game I've ever downloaded was Genshin Impact. The quests are draining, artifact drop rates are horrible so it takes more than a month to finish building a character, gacha rates suck, resin system is a huge issue, things need to change.

Update from my last review, as of now this game is just great, massive open world experience with some puzzles during exploration and reasonable rewards i guess, some downsides are the cost of resin when doing domains and bosses, would be better if u can adjust it or increase the max limit of the player's resin, and i hope the map expands and the main quest continues. The gacha, well its ok for now at least. So overall experience is just too good

A really good open world rpg, the gameplay is loads of fun and I really appreciate all the effort they've put into it's lore, even the side stories of inconsequential npcs are interesting. Graphics and art style is definitely top-tier and the OST is really great too. The only problem I have is the unexpectedly high ping I get from the game despite having a high-speed internet connection, I even tried switching servers and surprisingly they all have that same high ping value.

Beautiful game, I'm just glad that this is available on many platforms. I hope the game will get more good updates so it'll be a long lasting game, this actually felt like casual RPGs rather than MMORPG, but just for the story and gameplay it's worth it to explore, do the grinding for levels and stuffs. Hopefully later on there will be more chances to get characters we didn't have yet!

I have had more fun on this game than I have a lot of other titles I have played on mobile, console and PC. The devs often listen to feedback and update the game based off of it, the world and environments are gorgeous, fun to explore and just a joy in general. I genuinely cannot believe all of the content that has been added to the game SO FAR since its initial release, the events are incredibly fun, there is an entire housing system and co-op is a blast!!! I highly recommend Genshin Impact!!

Plays more like a console game than a typical mobile game. Really entertaining combat and exploration. Microtransactions seem a bit overpriced to me but can be ignored since the game gives you regular premium currency for exploring and doing events. Touch controls can be a little annoying, but gamepad support would fix that once it gets added.

Still playing for almost 4 years. This is a free to play game that doesn't even worth spending money on. You'll have to spend a lot of time for a tiny amount of in game benefits, not to mention there are limited options to get the premium currencies that are only used to try to get the characters you want in a exclusive limited time banner that only be around for few weeks and it'll be gone for half a year!. Even if you spend some money to gamble your wanted characters it'll never be worth it.

Probably the best open world gacha game I've ever played. I can't even believe I'm playing this game for free. The characters, story, graphics, puzzles, map exploration and combat mechanics are all very awesome. This is just a solid game that I can recommend to anyone and would eagerly convince people to atleast give it a try. edit: Game fell off. Devs' passion seem like it died. They refuse to listen to player's feedbacks and doesn't respect player's time. NO SKIP BUTTON IN THE BIG 2026.

Okay I love this game a lot! The storylime is really interesting and different from normal RPG main plot. It doesn't push you around when doing your quests, so you can take your own sweet time >:D Plus even though I'm a F2P, the game is not that challenging once u get the hang of the characters available! The gacha system has a small chance in getting a character you want, but I mean u get is good XD. Anyway thank you for reading this far! -honey

I've always loved the story and characters in this game since I began playing in 1.3. Mihoyo was always able to find a way to make me fall in love with a character and design again and again over these past 2 years. But as more and more time has passed? I've truly realized just how little they truly care about their playerbase. It seems that the greed got to them just as quickly as it did others. Dehya is the embodiment of their disregarding.. I hope they finally fix something sooner or later.

Great open world, fun characters to play, It's fun, it's refreshing, it's horrible in rewards, overall a great game but the amount of gacha you can pull is amount to shat. And the once you get to AR 50 you only have to spend 30 minutes a day, yes it's got great story and good graphics but it's a downside after you lose the beginner feelings, whales and F2P are struggling to find new content to keep them active.

I really like this beautiful game. However it overheats my phone every time. I have tried everything - playing on the lowest settings, closing all background apps, taking off my phone cover, and even desperately fanning it to no avail. I am on a Samsung G7, which I understand is a bit old but I have never had this problem with any other game. It is so regrettable that it is not suited for lower end devices.

This is by far an amazing game. When it says open world, it means open world! If you loved to play Zelda BOTW it is very similar, but this has its own unique way of gameplay through other characters you can unlock and level up. I have already sunk several hours thinking this game wouldn't be as big as it is and I have only scratched the surface of the game. The story is ok, it can be very cliche. The beginning drags a bit, but once you get past it, it is worth it!

Even though it takes a lot of space... The game is superb.. superb gameplay, superb graphics.. but need to add more characters.. always get weapons in 8/9 when drawing characters... How come get weapons, in characters draw?.. but that is just a very minor issues.. overall great game, can see myself playing this game for a quite long time

Love this game. Hope the ratings strike ends soon. I guess if I had a couple of complaints, it's that I wish getting characters was a bit easier. I feel like as a free to play player I have to save up for a really long time just to get ten draws, and you aren't even guaranteed a character. It also takes up SO MUCH space it's pretty much impossible to use on a phone. Other then that though, awesome game!

The gameplay too hood for me.. i miss my chance to finish my quest... but i've got another quest after that.. it like chain quest.. for control, because i just plag it on android, it's a little bit hard for control.. hope there'll be control customize like how i want to put my skill button etc. Overall.. this is the best RPG i've played.. Thanks for give the best game. PS: please make it more lower power consumption.. because my phone always overheating when i play it on 60fps.

When I first started there were several ways to have fun. Characters were refreshing and had a precise personality with most having good background stories. With Fontaine, I started to think these aspects were deteriorating. Character design looked rush and made purely to satisfy the public, no care or emotion, same with character lore, esp 4 star characters. Plot isn't bad, but not good. Building a character is terrific. RNG is tough and it discouragues players. Primogems are hard to obtain.

I use to love this game, it has an amazing storyline and beautiful landscapes and characters. On the other hand, I hate the new update. Size aside, Fontaine came out too soon. Before, new maps released slowly and gave players more time to explore and complete quests, but now, they're releasing maps every other update. This discourages players from playing and intimidates new players. One bit of advice I'd like to say to new players is to take your time and don't force yourself to catch up.

So smoove graphics may allow you to feel the deep of this game, so interesting mechanics, bosses, slimes), and ofcourse the way you play its just unbelievable. When I started to play, the game has intro playig backgrounds, the music is such of experience, when you listening the music its reminds me the anime "DanMachi"( "Is It Wrong, to Try Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?"). So I hope, that this game will have a future, for me this is a best. I wish good luck for creators, you've made a great thing!

Previously this was a 5 star review but as of right now genshin impact is the only downlodabe and deleteable app on my phone and it still says I have too little storage to update it... I play on PC but it's annoying since my sister's PC recently broke and we have to share. It takes so much storage it's not ok. I'm no game developer and I know this is a very high quality game (since I play it on pc) but the amount of storage it takes is absolutely unholy. I really hope it's worth it on mobile.

I really enjoyed playing this game but there are some problems that are affecting the players experience of enjoying the game, one of those is the resin system, the resin system is stopping the ability of a player to go to a roadblock everyday as a very grindy player, but don't get me wrong I love the game but just hoping the devs can improve the resin system substantially, not just by increasing the resin limit but also decreasing the time per resin.

I have no words to describe how beautiful this is. The graphics, gameplay, lore, music, voicelines, all the way down to the engaging mechanics too! Characters? Great! Game being up-to-date? Perfect! I absolutely love this, being a free to play player, but I don't see a problem with doing it casual too, it's so fun! They give consecutive promising rewards too through event, so if you actually look closely, it's not necessary to spend any money at all. Thank you HoyoVerse for this masterpiece!

I love the game to the point that I even bought a new phone to have a better experience hahaha. Tho, I have heard a lot of complaints about the first anniversary rewards is kind of cheap. This is my first anniv. with genshin so I hope it will be memorable. Furthermore, the lore, the gameplay, the characters and all are amazing!💙🥰

An amazing free to play open world real time combat rpg. A gatcha game at its core but without the need to pay into it (unlike other games that make it a necessity). The currency needed for rolls can be recived by many things such as opening treasure chests, doing events, story and dailies. Pretty consistent new content too. Would recommend trying it out if you're unsure and if you like it, its even better on PC (mobile and PC accounts can connect)!

I've played a lot of mobile RPG games but this one really stands above the rest. The story is very engaging, and most characters have depth in them. The gameplay is great and can be challenging on higher levels. The open world aspect is just so massive. The atmosphere, you can just loose yourself in this world. The gacha system is okay for me, you can finish the game using F2P characters, you just need to master different elemental combinations. Having a 5 Star is just a bonus and not a must.

only 3 stars, ive been playing it for a whole year now. but ever since 2.4 launched, the game had been so laggy. the drops cant be seen, the mobs wont die, and you cant change characters immediately even tho you have a green ping. its so hard to play now, pls fix this issue asap. other than that, the game is fun, i really like exploring the new map—enkanomiya—it seems interesting! that's all.

This game is by far the most awesome game I've ever played, it really just eats up a lot of the device's storage. The earlier version updates that were ranging between 2-3gb WAS okay. Sadly, now that it's gonna be Fontaine's time, which will be the current version is eating another 9-10gb of my device's storage. This update size caught me by surprise. Anyhow, the game is legit, fun and interesting to play. But since my phone storage has to say goodbye, I'm also gonna have to say goodbye. </3

Almost 4 years after, their development rotation while probably comfortable for them, makes the game and upcoming versions too predictable. There is nothing new to look forward to and exploration has taken it's toll on me at least. Found my self dropping the welkin moon pass and logging in less and less. If you never played this game you should absolutely give it a try though because it has a lot to offer for begginers. Rating 2*s because it doesn't offer me as an old player anything anymore.

Probably the best game I've ever played. Amazing character design and story, great graphics, and very fun gameplay! Great for streaming, calming down, or just a rainy night. You can play it with friends too! People will put bad reviews and say it's not good or that it's too time consuming. But really it's outstanding! If you're always busy just do the quests in small parts. However I do recommend getting it on a computer rather than a mobile device, it sometimes lags and if harder to play on. :]

Game is an amazing solo experience but it has coop and the coop is extremely limiting. I feel like you should be able to do everything with your friends besides maybe quest. Atm what you can do is mainly explore. Kill some bosses. The person that joins gets limited loot, 0 progress on your world. Still love the game but if you are going to have coop then do it right in my opinion.

I've enjoyed Genshin on mobile and also on PC but recently the game has recently declined in terms of quality. The quests and events have become repetitive, the storylines either meander and don't have impact until the very end or they simply don't engage the players. The recent characters are flawed and have a major drawback which does make for balanced gameplay but when one spends or grinds for in-game currency, one expects that the character they've looked forward to, to be good.

Simply astounding. The beauty of mobile games is that content is rolled out in patches, creating an experience that never ends (as long as the money keeps rolling in). Two weeks in and I have yet to complete whats already available and keep finding new nuggets of storytelling and side quests while entirely free to play. There has been zero pressure to "roll" the gachas. The English voice acting is surprisingly high quality and the accompanying manga is a good time. Looking forward to more!

It is a pretty fun game at the start. I gave the devs some money because I somewhat enjoy it. But the game plays terribly on mobile. I enjoy it mainly on the desktop. It takes too much memory and lags badly for some reason at times on the mobile. This being primarily a desktop game plus the energy mechanic in the game makes playing a bit of chore more and more every day. The events are pretty rewarding but enjoyment without paying continuously is somewhat limited.

it's really an incredibly detailed game! there is always so much to do that even after years I'm still loving it and whilst I'd definitely reccomend it to anyone that likes gacha based rpg... there are definitely a few things to consider for people who are kinda nooby at games like I am. the characters and your playstyle depend heavily on who you pull through gacha and how you level the characters, the weapons and their artifacts. with that in mind, it can be quite expensive to keep up with.

Breathtaking sceneries, high quality BGMs, and (majorly) well-written stories with hints scattered all over the world.　　 To shed some light for people who were confused about the low ratings: they were about this game 1st Anniversary. At first, I too was disappointed by the celebration; it's not even about the reward, I was just disappointed by the lack of anything memorable… then they dropped the online concert, and my dissatisfaction just went to oblivion. Now that's what I call «memorable»!!

It's insane that they managed to release this as a mobile game too... Stunning graphics, very Breath of the Wild like, there is a ton to do, you are not forced to pay for anything. I will give it 4 stars for now because of minor bugs and because we all don't know how this will go on. Up until now, it is too good to be true. We will see what the developers choose to do with it

I really like it. No necessary purchases to play nor auto-navigation and auto-fight, lots of storyline that makes senses and additional quests to help you level properly, and the graphics are amazing. I'm very surprised at how much I am enjoying this game. I highly recommend this game if you have a lot of free time or just want to try out a new RPG via mobile.

Really great game. Starts off feeling like a BoTW clone in the beginning, and honestly is in a lot of respects, but as you obtain characters and use elemental combinations the game becomes something much more. Won't hate on the microtransactions too mucn since this is F2P and gives a lot of value regardless, but I'm not a fan of certain parts of progression (like collecting multiples of the same character to Ascend). But it works and I keep coming back!

I used to give 5 stars but the push for maximum profit has been relentless. You are forced to have all of the latest characters to clear end game content. And I won't even talk about the whole miliastra mode which is basically a different game full of bugs bundled within Genshin. If you want to play, just play for the story. I still enjoy that.

Overall the game is fine, but the size of the app and its prerequisites seem too much to handle for my mid-range phone. I downloaded its PC counterpart recently and learned that I could not use my mobile acc on the pc version of the app and it is a bit frustrating. So why make an app that can connect with different platforms but couldn't register on its different platform.

Best game for mobile by a long shot. The world was huge at launch already, but now it feels like it never ends. The best thing is that you really don't need to pay money to enjoy the game, there are many strong 4 star characters thay will take you through the story without struggling at all!!! For me, the strongest point is how you always find new places wherever you go, which makes exploring the open world a very pleasant experience. Honestly, do yourself a favour and download this gem

The game is great. Storyline is amazing. Graphics is outstanding. Minor issues and bugs but that's okay for a new game. My issue is the bug I encountered on Stormbearer Point. I fell off the cliff and tried to open my adventure book to locate my next boss but the game glitched and I was stuck unable to do anything for awhile. Hope this bug gets fixed. Other than that this is an really great game.

The story and gameplay are amazing! Such a beautiful game. You can't tell the cutscene from actual gameplay!! I love it. Only issue I have is that: I feel you should make it so the characters read out a few lines of dialogue when you click instead of just one sentence, it would sound a lot better.

Completely on par./level to be categorized with games like Skyrim/Lost Odyssey/etc.. . Only negative downside's for me so far is the lack of customization for buttons/button layouts, and customizable graphic settings for different screen/display type's & phone brand/model type's. Don't get me wrong about the negative downsides I would still strongly recommend to my friend's and other's. To download/install and play.

Beautiful game, honestly. I'm not one to play RPGs at all really, and this game is just a joy to play. The only real issue I have is that cutscenes lag and freeze A LOT. Like, I have to close out the game frequently and reload everything to get it to work 95% of the time. Other than that, (even though I barely just started), the game mechanics are easy to understand and figure out, and the camera is only slightly wonky, but overall pretty dang good! Only thing that needs a fix is cutscenes.

First, let me say the core gameplay in Genshin Impact is amazing. The storyline, the combat system, the characters, the open-world exploration and the OST's make this one of the best free games to play. There are definitely issues which hinder the game to be perfect e.g. QoL features, not a lot of content for endgame players etc. but, this shouldn't stop new players from starting the game. The 1 star is because of the company's treatment to players with its stingy rewards.

I LOVE THIS GAME!!! The only issue I have is trying to get character or supplies to accend my characters levels or weapons! Plus it's kinda difficult to actually get characters from a wish! I hope sometime in the future intertwined faiths and stuff in the bargains will be a bit cheaper!! I LOVE THE STORYLINE THO!!! Amazing work on the new event! It was fun getting layla!

I really love the game so much! Lots of details and adventures in this game. But theres three things that actually need to get fix. Firstly, whenever i play or attacks, it lag alot. Secondly, when it shows u the story like a video, it kinda got froze in the spot(stuck) while telling the story also. Thirt, whenever I'm in the serenitea pot, it kinda have some bad glitch, it's everywhere on the screen. Hope u fix it

Its a great game, but the lag is insane after a long play session, the controls could use a little work, the motion blur is amazing, the graphics remind me a lot of Zelda breath of the wild, and the stamina bar runs put a little to quickly. But other then that awesome game with meme potential, like with Timmy on the bridge, saying daddy isn't going back, like, Jesus Game Devs you had to go there XD

This game is amazing, the graphics, the quality, the animation is so damn amazing. It has a good story plot I really like it, but I really disappointed in gacha where you have low probability to get 5 star heroes/characters...But still I rate it 5 star Cuz I really love the Game and there's something I want to request. Make a low graphic or quality of this game for those player who has a low spec devices and to play by everyone even they can't afford high spec devices..that includes me :]]

The game is good and the story is worth playing for. The only problem is that the graphics on the phone is not that smooth and it's a bit laggy. I am currently playing on PC which made the game more smooth and easier to play. Also, I tried playing on my PS4 because I want my account to be connected in all possible devicrs. However, I'm kind of disappointed to know that on PS4, the game is not on crossplay and will use the PSN account. Overall, game is good but please make PS4 crossplay, too.

Fun open exploration adventure game with gacha elements. Art and music is pretty good with an interesting story. However, the gacha rates are the absolute worst I have ever encountered in a game before. After some 12 10x pulls its always just the 1 "guaranteed" 4-star and everything else is 3-star weapons. Could be extremely unlucky but makes the game less enjoyable when the rewards after hours of grinding are trash. Great game though, hopefully they fix those rates soon

Mobile gaming at its best. Running great on my old Snapdragon 820. Hope the in app purchases won't ruin it later. Update: 4GB Ram (nothing else running) is not enough anymore. If I visit different locations it looks like ram is getting overloaded and the game becomes unplayable. Needs better optimization and f2p players are starting to struggle...

Still cannot believe such high-quality game is available on mobile devices. Good graphics, great characters and skills, good details on weapon, and most importantly GREAT STORYLINE. It's way too hard (and mostly expensive) to spend too much to get five-star characters/weapons. But then again, even with what's available, it is already very enjoyable. I don't usually say this, but haven't found any other game aside from this on which it's worth it to spend real money on. Well done, MIHOYO Team

I personally find this game to be rather fun. With great combat and flexibility when it comes to fighting, the game will almost always keep you engaged when in battle. However, the game does become more grindy as you play, although I am a casual player so I don't mind too much. Also, be warned that this game has gacha elements, meaning people highly susceptible to gambling should stay away from it. I personally have felt no need to spend money, but many probably have.

the game is so magneficent!!!I cant believe this is a free game!!(except for the wishing for characters) but overall its amazing!! totally recommend this one. The story is good! the cut scenes are epic and on point plus the character designs and the voices are amazing! controls are very good and not that hard. and each character has a very unique taste to it. I love this!!!

Great game, except for the fact that the gacha is one of the worst I've played in my life. Rates so low you're almost guaranteed to only get 5☆ characters on pity isn't even the worst part. The limited system is. Most gachas have only a handful of characters that are only available for a limited time. Genshin isn't like that. If you want a character, you have to wait for up to a FULL YEAR until they rerun, which is terrible. I can't recommend this game to anyone for this reason alone.

I absolutely love the game! No complaints besides (not even a complaint) that when I turn to a certain angle when the character is up against a rock or a wall, I can see eternal damnation and their demons (inside the character) and it scares me. It's nothing. I'm just really jumpy. But amazing game! Amazing content. Keep doing what you're doing and come out with this game on the switch soon!

it's not a pay to win kind of game unless you're going for a specific 5 star character in a gacha, but the graphics can be slow depending on your phone. the graphics are good for an open world since it would take alot of space to load it all. controls are good but it's even better on pc and controller. generally a very good and addicting game play.

Honestly, one of the best games I've played. The graphics are beautiful and there is alot of freedom to explore. I love how it's easy to keep u with ur friends lvls even if your a free player or low spender. Very good game. The only negative thing I have to say is that it lags sometimes but not that could be bc of my internet besides that I love it.

Honestly, I played the game so much. Even though it lags my phone since it is a large game I still get past it. Also the no ads and no need for paying...just I am so grateful! The only problem I have is how long it takes to upgrade your adventure levels since there are no specific things to do as a starter player to hurry it up. I think it's handled a bit better in Star rail

I really wish I could give this game a 5 star rating; the open world is phenomenal and fun to explore. As someone who is now in the late game I'm trying to entertain myself with photo taking of the beautiful scenery etc. However ever since the 2.0 update, things have really gone downhill. The English stream for the 2.1 update was delayed by 1 and a half hours, characters have been released despite having seemingly unfinished kits. And now the anniversary rewards. Mihoyo, listen to the fans!

I've admittedly only been playing for a few days, but it's tons of fun so far! Challenging at times, simple at others. Good UI. Doesn't have the full character customerisation that I prefer, but you can play as so many different characters (for free!) that it more than makes up for it. Storyline and characters are awesome. Battle and gameplay fun. Definitely worth trying out! You can tell the devs put a lot of effort and thought into this game.

I can't call this game perfect but honestly in the 2 1/2 years I've been playing it across several platforms I've had a consistently positive experience with the game and the story it tells, if I had one grievance it's that there seems to be no way to replay certain scenes which can make a slip of the thumb annoying but otherwise I'd say this game is a great adventure.

I love the graphics of the game, it looks amazing on my phone, pretty fun too! But at a price of my phone heating up very quickly and draining my battery. Another thing that isn't great is the archer mechanism, it's super hard to aim accurately and shoot quick with ur thumb, which is a big downside to me as my favs are mostly archers or claymores orz... Next is the wonky camera that glitches mostly during fights.. And also, I'm begging for genshin to be on MacOS platform pls!!!!! 😭😭

Best Free-to-Play game on mobile? Absolutely, no questions asked. It's amazing what all this game offers at no expense, and they are even adding more regions in future updates. Sure it's got issues with progression and the gacha system is not good (are there any that are good anyway?) So if you've had a problem with gacha/lootbox games before, it might not be for you. Regardless, graphics are beautiful, music is phenomenal, map is huge and there's tons to do, so I completely reccomend it.

I downloaded it first because my friend kept nagging me to do so. Best choice ever. The game has so many differents aspects that you'll find one you'll stay for. The story is as great as the design and the coop system is really cool if you have friends to play with. I totally recommend it ! (Beware you might get addicted and play 10h per day to keep up with your friends –it happened to me–)

The game is amazing, it's a lot like legends of Zelda's breath of the wild. I just wish it was easier to do summons, the pity system isn't the problem. It's the fact it's so hard to get a lot of primogems at once. I feel if you increase the number of achievement primogems and how many quests give people would enjoy the game a lot more.

Love this game, I really enjoy exploring 'some' areas. Honestly, genshin is most attractive for its lore, beside the characters. I just hope that this game will keep improving and satisfy both the developers and players. And of course, if there are some ways I would love to have more luck in wishing because I've lost count of how many 50/50s I lost.... I beg you.....

I play regularly for long periods of time(at most 12 hours), just doing anything I have access to in the game. It's a great time-consuming game, and the characters, storyline, wishing, etc. is great. I'd definitely say the Genshin Impact is my number one game that I've been playing as of late, and it's great for new players, especially with the co-op system, and the open rpg game playout.

It has been 5 days of utter fun. Exploring, fighting, quests, collecting. Just unlocked co op. No need to spend money... but, job developers have done is just wow and worth dropping a few to them. Music(most games turn off), story(haven't skipped any dialogue), switching between my phone, tablet and PC depending on mood or location.

I absolutely love this game, my mind revolves around it 24/7. I was overjoyed to find this on my Chromebook but I did have some issues, the whole log in process was extremely slow, and when I did get in the animation quality was quite poor, I even tried to adjust it. Also, after 3 ish days, I had trouble getting into the game, like, the screen is just black, and if I click close, it turns white and I have to go to the top right corner to exit again. Ah, also the sound sometimes just lags-

Amazing, Love the setting,characters the lore of course. Gameplay is smooth on the computer I use now. It had to be a 800$ 16 ram 1Tb space computer though or it wouldn't rly. Run smoothly on others. Or it wouldn't work at all. But other then that it's a rly great game. There is no voice distortion in the cutscenes either like their other game honkai star rail.

The game was great to explore the world and to collect characters. I've had the game since release. Main reason for most of my hiatus is due to the slow roll outs of content, lack of end game content, earning primos from dailies is tedious and time consuming, or a combination of all of the above. Genshin devs have shown no real intentions of improving quality of life even though the game has been out for more than 3 years. Rewards are slow to come by after completing exploration. Time dump.

I don't have enough good things to say about Genshin Impact. My initial draw was being able to play on cross-platform with the same account without needing a "data sync". I have completely fallen in love with the story, exploration, characters and the combat. This is one of the most enjoyable games I've seen in a very long time. The developer is very generous with providing tons of free currency for the gatcha system. My only complaint - the "standard" 5 star characters impossible to get :(

I love this game so much. The openworld, the fights, trying to understand how to build you character right is just so good and the community is making it all better with their meme's and theories. Also the pulling system and how you can play with your friends is also great. Farming is pretty hard,but the story let's you forget that you even have to farm.

The game is great with details and the story!. But in my opinion the game is too hard and needs too much storage space. As a mobile player I'm kinda sad that I won't be able to play it again but I wish you well PC/tablet/laptop/ps and more (if there is) the game is crazy but is mostly build by pay to win players. I'm hoping that my phone can handle the new update wish me luck and I'll wish you luck for future updates I hope that more players don't have this problem and more! (Ran out of space) ❤

I love this game but unfortunately the game crashed for me and I had to re-install back for it to work again but when I tried to log in using the email I used before, it said it hasn't been registered and all of my achievements had gone down the drain. Can someone help me with this? I've gone too far and I don't want to restart back.... I love the game and wished to get my genshin account back... It happened just after I updated it.

This game is pretty fun to play. I'm a newbie so I came late in the update 1.2 which has a problem for archers in mobile since I can't move the gyro aim so I just had to manually adjust the character to aim. They fixed it this 1.3 update and I can finally practice aiming. However, there are more bugs now. Defeated monsters and mobs don't dissipate, they just stay there as well as interactive animals. Also enemies with half their hp stop attacking so I can't finish the mission.

I've been playing this game for the past year and honestly it's probably one of my favourite games. The graphics, ost and just exploring in general really drew me in and I had a lot of fun exploring in the first few months. But 2.1 was really lackluster, archon quest was rushed and events were meh. The Anniversary also brought light to the lack of communication between mihoyo and it's players (especially the western community) sucks that such a great game is managed so poorly :(

Amazing game. Getting further into the game and really enjoying it. I think Paimon is a useless annoying "guide".. tbh I prefer Navi. The rates to get characters kind of suck. But still giving this game an overall 5 on game play, story, art work. Recommended for an update for a little assistance on the stats and what each character needs, hopefully some time it will be available.

I played this game for about ~3 months before I hit a wall and my characters were no longer strong enough to win missions. In the beginning it was extremely fun and I played everyday, but once I was unable to complete missions I deleted it. Genshin impact is a new game so it still has alot of quirks. I will probably re-download in the future to see if it's more user-friendly.

The game is a shell of it's former self. I used to play this game every single day but Mihoyo doesn't seem to care about it's player base. It no longer feels worth investing my time with so little in return. Another major gripe I have with this game is that the file is too big. I need separate device if I want to continue playing mobile. I uninstalled. I wish there was a smaller version of the app that allowed you to do a few things like manage inventory and expeditions at the very least.

I absolutely love the game! I've met some wonderful people because of it! Though I do have some problems with it that I'd like to address. 1, the rates aren't really good. A lot of people have brought this up so I won't explain it but really, the rates are incredibly low and 2, please please add selling! I'm constantly broke in game and I have so many weapons and artifacts that I can sell! Those are my only two nit picks but it's a really fun game and it deserves the hype! I can't wait for more!

Lovable characters, world 10/10, there are so many things to do you might forget to get off of the game, so many mechanics and stats, they're quite hard to learn but people are always ready to teach newcomers. Would I recommend the game, absolutely, does playing it feel like a chore after some time? Yes. Will you still play it cuz there's a character you want coming in the next pach? Also yes. Overall must play, maybe not if you have a big thing upcoming though.

overall a good game. It isn't pay to win. Exploring is my personal favourite, beautiful, unique scenery with lots of different riddles. Been playing it for almost a year now, just like with every game it just gets repetitive towards the end there are few unpleasant things but considering the game is for free i do not mind. I prefer to play on my pc since the connection keeps crashing on my phone

literally im so addicted this game is amazing, it's so smooth, the graphics are amazing, and the characters are all so well designed!! the story is immersive and the characters you meet along the way make the journey all the better! i would like a feature where you could change your traveler, but the game is doing just fine without it. there's always so much fun events, and the gacha system is so much better than other games. I 100% recommend it!!

Ima gonna be honest I don't wanna give this 5 stars. My reviews and words are meaningless without being read. But here it goes. It's straight up breath of the wild. But they left the "mobile game" aspect of buying characters and nothing really let's you make your character super different from anothers with unique choices. There's no real choices. Nice beauty open world and crafting that single handedly makes it better than any other mobile game by far.but how much you put into the world damn.

Excellent game. I play this on our ps4 though, It's so GOOD. The graphics are the freaking BEST- well- except if you lag in your devices, you'd have to lower the graphic in the settings :)- There's nothing that I find bad about this game, it's just that I think the rewards for AR60 is bad and that the chance of you getting a 5* is low. Overall nice game Mihoyo, you did a great job!

I play this game every single day, I can't put it down. There's so much to explore and things to discover, the map just keeps growing. Love the newest update, everything is so much more generous compared to before which makes me happy. The characters look great! I always want to roll for the newest character. Especially because of Natlans new gameplay mechanics! I have so many 5 stars and most of them I got without paying a cent. Addicting and beautiful characters to collect! Day 1 player here!

If you are in it for the Story, Characters, and adventure, I highly recommend this game. But, This is also a gacha game, Characters are locked behind wishes that cost alot per pull, do not waste your money in this game, the starting characters can get you with almost all the content of the game. There is still issues with the game stats and communication with Mihoyo is still not good but I do hope it will get better in time. I repeat! DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY! Buy a welkin or BP if you like it.

I love how you need to be creative w your team and how you don't need to spend money just to have good experiences. And also it's very fun with/without money cuz when you wish, you have to like ritual to get a good character. I also like how you have an interactive map, a beautiful map, Exploration, events, outfits (you have to buy), the characters and their skill, there's a good storyline, unique mechanics/puzzles, you can make food, realistic, camera, own story quest, dif weapons and many more

Gacha impact is a game where you collect scantily clad mostly under age women and some dudes and fight monsters. The game is great. Gameplay is responsive and flashy. The game falls apart pretty quick. Pay your time or pay with money to make stupid inconveniences go away once. Progression is really important in games and this game wants to monetize that to encourage you to spend as much money as possible. Games get so much better than this.

Totally a fresh new gaming experience with this game, I've been playing honkai impact since the beginning so I knew this game was not going to be a disappointment, the map is huge and fully open there's many side quest to complete and monster to fight you wouldn't get bored quickly. The characters have a very lovely design that I'm fond off with mihoyo, give this game a try it won't disappoint.

I've been playing the game since November 2020 and enjoyed every bit of the story. Sure, the resin system, rewards and gacha system could use some working on but I personally couldn't care less. The game lore is amazing and I find myself reading through the archive when I run out of stuff to do. Thank you so much for this fun journey developers, I can't wait for the next upcoming updates.

I'm saying this with a very heavy heart. Genshin Impact is such an amazing game. Unfortunately, the game's requirements have gone up, making it unplayable on my phone. It's always disappointing when you can no longer enjoy something you love due to technical limitations. Hopefully, in the future, they might optimize or update it which will make it playable. Until then, goodbye to the world of Teyvat.

This is a game with so much potential, however as you world level goes to 3-4 it gets so much harder to build characters to max level and best artifacts, everything related to character building is limited by resins, and the rate for the specific drops you wanted wasnt even that good, this game rather than letting you grind for the items you wanted ,they limit the things you can do in the game , I am supposed to be able to choose what i wanted to do . So called ''open world game'' :-\

To be honest I've played since just before Liyue came out so.. a long time and I love this game on PC. Great story, great characters, tons of cool exploration, etc etc. Problem is on mobile, it is nearly unplayable now unless you have the highest-end phone out there. I've got an S22 Ultra and it barely seems to run unless all settings are set so low that it looks like a pixellated, blurry mess and then its just hard to even see what I'm doing in general.

Absolutely LOVE Genshin! The storyline is great and the graphics are amazing. I rated it 4 out of 5 stars because the apps takes up a lot of storage which makes the game lag when loading in new areas. On a side note, after the 2.7 update my phone didn't have enough space to play the game anymore and I don't have a PC to play on either, however I do have a chromebook. The issue is that Genshin isn't supported on chromebook, so can the developers please make the game accessible to other devices :)

At first, I have never played a game like this, but man, it gave a good first impression and I love playing it right now. the ability to choose how the game looks through the graphics customizer is a very good touch, great gameplay, a little descriptive on how things work, but you start to understand quickly and simplify it in your own way. Only problem is that sometimes the cutscenes freeze and the audio kinda splices itself and I cant make out what it says, like a CD skipping. Great Game guys!

This is an awesome game, from the storyline to the environment, to the designs of all the characters is amazing. It keeps you hooked with new, usually fun events. Heaven though it's a gacha game and you don't always get what you want,... You are always given a second chance with daily primogems (pulls). My heart is going to break when my phone can't keep up anymore💔. The game still has a long way to go in terms of storyline. overall such an amazing game ❤️

A game that plays as if you paid for it but it's free! Incredible graphics, storytelling, voice acting, and gameplay. Getting new characters, items, and exploring the world is addictive and fun. 100% worth a try if you're a fan of games like Zelda: Breath of the Wild, anime, or just exploring and getting better at killing monsters.

Stunning JRPG comparable with Ni no Kuni on PS3. Huge map to explore. Varied characters. Interesting character progression with quests, battles and puzzles. Great voice acting (Paimon's voice grates a little, but typical of the genre). No advertising or pressure to pay for additional content, in fact it took me a while to find the store and I'm still not sure what the advantage would be of buying additional gems as they are different to the various in-game currencies and value items. Awesome.

Played since 1.6 till now and I had an amazing experience. To the music, characters, gameplay, design, story and etc, it is all so great and genius! But being an endgame F2p is a bit complicated because it is a bit hard to get primo though the events actually save us but I really appreciate all of the effort you guys are putting into this game, cant wait for more updates!

This game is great, in single player. When it comes to multi player there're a few issues I have with it. First thing is you're very limited on what you can do. My wife and I played together a few times to help one other. I wish the loot system would also go to the person that joined. Experience book are easy to get at first but will get harder to get as you get farther in the story. The WISH system is unbalanced. The cost to per wish needs to be lowered. All together I would still recommend!

This is honestly the best game I've come across. The graphics, background track, characters, storyline, everything. It's all amazing. Well yeah, the gacha system sucks but you don't necessarily have to get a 5 star to win. You don't even need other 4 stars. The starter characters are already enough for you to go through the entire game with ease. Also, the anniversary rewards are not that bad in my opinion so I don't know why everyone is complaining about it.

At first I was madly in love with the game, the beautifulness of it and character designs, I even spent some money to show my support for such an amazing work on that level. But honestly, the gacha system is awful and it kills all the beauty the game in itself has. +100$ for a 5* is completely greedy and pointless, let alone that you might want a certain 4* and not get a single one in 70 pulls, which is around 100$ as well. A customer is gone and not coming back until this changes.

I've been playing this off and on since its release in 2020. I love the open world, the puzzles, the combat, and the characters. It can get very repetitive and grindy in some aspects (a lot of farming for materials, some of which are luck-based), which is why I haven't played it consistently. It is possible to be free-to-play and still get good characters, but it takes a lot of time to obtain and build strong combat teams this way. All in all, a very enjoyable game I'll keep coming back to.

as much as i want to rate this 5*, its a 4 due to many reasons. first is no endgame content, besides spiral abyss (which resets every 15d) there's literally nothing. 2nd is resin, 1 resin every 8 mins is too long imo, maybe lower it to 6 or smth. 3rd is QoL improvements, there are many QoL that would make this game much more enjoyable. although i may seem negative, this game is worth playing if you have the storage or you're a casual player, the characters, soundtrack, story etc are soooooo good

One of the best video game experiences of all time, hands down. Especially when played on mobile, since it's much easier to appreciate the overall scale and effort to fit a game this high budget on a phone. The world, while not as interactive or dynamic as other AAA titles on consoles, is still huge and fun to explore. The combat is simple but fun, and the story is pretty good. My only problems would be the predatory gacha mechanics, but I still highly recommend playing this game.

Very fun and addicting game! I love the unique characters and story, but unfortunately, I have to play on my PS4 due to the unbearable lag on this device. The only other problem is that the weapon banner is really unfair, especially for players who can't afford to spend real money. Besides these two issues I highly recommend this game if you want to play an open world anime RPG. This is the best free to play game I have ever played.

For a gacha game, It's really fun to play. An open world with lot's of quests, grinding might take time but all of it is worth it and satisfying in the end. Took me a while to get 5 stars but the 4 star characters are very good too if you build them properly, I think all the characters are alike in this field. The story is worth it as well, very sentimental and relatable at times. The graphics and the fighting mechanism are all satisfactory. MiHoyo really did well on this one, give me Diluc pls.

This game is fantastic. The fact you can pick up where you left off on pc or console right on your phone is amazing. Hopefully they add controller support for Android soon. I can see myself sinking lots of hours into this game. (And money). Don't let the gacha aspect turn you off either. You get free characters just for doing the story quests and you'll have plenty of opportunities to earn the in game currency used to summon new characters and weapons.

after some time playing. i gave it 4 star. the gameplay and graphics i give 5 stars. the only problem im facing is the game controls. i am a 100% mobile player. i control the game, dashing and jumping alot. makes my thumb painfull now. hope the genshin can do a setting where i can adjust where i can put my button configuration. so i can adjust the buttons at the place that i can play at for hours. hope to put it into consideration. just a button config. later ill put 5 stars if u do it.

One of the best looking anime/cel shaded games out there with a beautiful world and well made characters, story telling, exploration and adventure. I'm liking the elemental combos/reactions on each other but I'm also finding the lack of a proper lock on mechanic a bit annoying/jarring, to account for this I'd recommend playing this with mouse and keyboard for best control. The resin system (similar to honkai stamina system) also holds back the amount of playability and rate of progression.

Sooo good!! Interesting characters, skills, and strategies. Just enough instruction if you want it, while giving the option to figure things out on your own (which I love to do). Adventure RPG. I haven't enjoyed a game this much in a while. (Plays great on mobile with 200+ GB space. Onscreen touch controls are done extremely well.) I would like to see a larger limit on commission quests and a closer gap between level-restricted quests and xp gain. Thank you for all your hard work devs!

I used to like this game so much. They have the great potential to become one of the best open-world games, until they ended up abusing the gacha system so hard. The story, as a mobile game, if not, one of the best ones out there. Some of their characters also have great design. Again, they have the potential to be a great cross-platform open-world game. However, it's such a shame honestly that they ended up being too greedy about it. Not only the character gacha system ended up unbalanced most of the times, but the weapon gacha system now is more advertised for people who spent a lot of money on this (I'm talking more than $100). New players, lower your expectations. Even if you really want to play this game, don't speedrun the entire map. My personal advice is not spend a lot of money on this, even $10 worth of money ended up useless now. Fix this mihoyo, starting by not getting too greedy for your gacha system and make your rewards better, especially for your 1st anniversary.

Genshin is really good, but recently on my laptop I cannot log into my Genshin account it worked before but it doesn't work anymore. When I try logging in, instead of the puzzle verify screen where you have to place a puzzle piece in to show you're a human, it just shows a blank page where the verify is supposed to be. I'm not sure how to fix this. Other than this problem Genshin is a very well designed game.

Great rpg. And I really love that you can connect your account on the phone to your pc or ps4 account and pick up where you left off. Also I love that you can have english voices for the characters. Just wish that if you use a controller on pc that the game would remember it so I don't have to set it to controller each time I boot it up, but that's not a huge issue. Great game overall best free rpg game I've played.

I was skeptical at first, but I fell in love with this game right away. But I'm a mobile player and the controls and camera are just not as friendly for us. I currently don't have any archer characters in my party ever because it is too easy to die while aiming due to having to adjust the camera constantly with no fine movement controls. Also, the audio is crackling and sounds really distorted following the latest Android/Samsung software update. Please fix this. I love it overall.

Really fun game with amazing characters that let you make amazing teams. But thats the issue, been playing since launch and ive honestly had enough of my bad luck. Watching everyone around you get characters you want while you grind really hard for them and not getting them in the end yourself sucks bad and it builds up over time. I reccomend this game for sure but only if you can cope with not being able to play who you want unless you pay crazy amounts of money.

Already play the game till rank 10. I like the game that's can give us a freedom too jump and climb anything. And i like the story and the voice actor, they're really good. But the downside of this game is, this game is really heavy for phone that's using SD 636 so i just can using the lowest graphics that's means the graphics is about like 360p or 480p. And more downside is, the gacha rate really bad .... Hope this game can be more friendly for mid-phone in the future.

It's a fun game a lot like breath of the wild. The problem with this game is that the combat which is a huge part of the game is centered around characters. However you will never see these characters. Don't get me wrong I payed 60 dollars for breath of the wild and enjoyed it. The value for content was high and I think it was worth every penny. This game, tho its fun, has some things I really like but is very greedy. If I put 60 dollars into this, mihoyo's "Value" is a few 3 star weapons. Sad.

Great game! I would like to see some improvements on the co-op mode though, the game would benefit a lot from having a proper multiplayer option/mode. And some features, like statue interaction, don't work when you're playing in co-op in another player's map. Other than that I think it's one of the best games of the year and a promising one.

I have played this game since the first day, I love the story, the graphic, the characters, the voices of the characters, the open world and the fighting. But everything gets ruined by how they are with everything else... Every single day it's the same: do the daily, farm some useless artifacts because they have no real system to guarantee something good and then close the game. Not a single real quality of life improvement was added in three whole years. A lot of potential wasted on bad choices

I consider this as a best game. The game's graphics, quests, locations, and characters are truly impressive. However, I have concerns regarding the cost of 1 fate, which amounts to 160 primogems. This price seems quite expensive, especially considering the fact that when using a fate to make a wish, the majority of the time, only a 4* character and weapons js obtained. Given that 5-star characters are rare. It can be disheartening to invest in fates and not receive the desired results. fix this.

So far I'm loving it! I've played dragon raja because of the graphic (unreal engine) and of course others like class, dungeon, gameplay mechanic etc. This one is my second, an open world game! Though it has gacha system but that doesn't stop me for playing. Also so far people complaining about connection server, power draining, unplayable. If you have high spec phone it won't be an issue. This game runs on ps4, switch and pc. But on mobile phone? That surprise me. So for now, 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟!

My only issue is the Gacha Drop Rates and what it takes to grind for and/or pay for. The cost is way too expensive (Money $) as other reviews have also put their own. Also the drop rates couldnt be any worse. It takes so many attempts just to aquire a new item/characters. Please consider lowering the $ Cost, maybe put affordable packages and at least have the draw increase its chances. This is my honest review of the game. Overall its amazing just thats really not putting that last star on it

I'm in love with this game I've been playing for year or two and it's really addicting because of the gameplay,quests,graphics,music and etc. But so many updates and the game storage growing is a problem for me. I had to delete genshin on my pc because I was out of storage and had to download it on phone. I just wish it didn't take that much of storage.

I made a purchase inside the app for something called "Gnostic Chorus" and it lost all the content and went back as I didn't purchase it after the most recent update. So, what's the fix? Or did I just lost that money? Update: So they are telling me that they can't do anything about it. Purchase was made on December the 18th and few days later got locked exactly after the update. Beware, don't make any in app purchases. They don't hold accountable the apps error. SCAMMERS

You prolly seen hundreds of reasons why to play but reasons you should probably drop: 1. Takes up majority of my storage and its only 3 continents in 2. This game is typically meant for those who want to explore/waste time 3. If patience isn't your good point, nor thinking how you spend your currency, drop 4. Playing mobile has so many limiters. As someone who cant play because of lacking storage, consider these before getting too attached.

PLAY ON CONSOLE OR PC. You'll have a much easier time playing than on mobile because genshin is HUGE. Other than that there is so much to do when you start it's literally insane. So many quests to do, lots of chests to open and before you know it you'll spend hours playing this game. I'm at adventure rank 54 and still playing. And not to mention the characters. They are so beautifully designed it's insane. But if you want more details go look at a review on YouTube. Overall very good game

It's a good game, but despite being labeled as ftp, it's very hard to do. There's little opportunity's to get in game currency, and you need a lot of it to get a charecter you aren't guaranteed to have. That, as well as the amount of storage it needs. It's impossible to be a mobile player, unless this is your only app, and you have no photos or other files.

Game is super fun, great voice acting, And interesting story and lore. This game has definitely taken lessons from breath of the wild. Don't be intimidated by the bad reviews, it's just that the players are upset that they aren't getting the amount of rewards that they want. But do beware that you do need to grind quite a bit in this game.

There is only 1 repeatable content, farming is the worst because its limited by resin. The longer you play, the more you realize that a player who doesnt top up will have their luck gradually decreases. Better save your life. I've played since release, at first im hapoy that my account is so lucky as a free to play, but overtime i understand... Feels as if the devs tells me to top up if i want to get lucky again. This is a casual game? Then let me build the characters i want without limitations.

This game is extraordinary! The game design, quality, characters, and lore is all great! Although it takes up most of my storage, it is totally worth it! Very addicting game. The pity system sucks though. I think we also need more resin, and a skip all dialog button. There are definitely alot of cons in this game, but there are also alot of pros. Keep up the good work!

Generally an excellent game but it comes with it's problems. The resources are really scarce and even when completing all events it's hard to level all characters you want. You always have to choose carefully what you'll invest into. Additionally, the late game is kinda boring. Apart from events you basically have spiral abyss only which is 30 minutes of gameplay every 2 weeks. I just wished there was more things to do and more rewards for getting strong and high adventure rank.

Genshin Impact Is Really fun! I enjoyed especially with the new characters, Gameplays,Story quest,The Quality Is pretty good if you ask me, Especially With Those Mechanicals that you would add to the game,I love the voice of each Different Characters,I actually love about this game that you could learn on how to go on an real adventure, I love that you could play with someone,Or help them with something,The character details is my most recent favorite ones

Super duper fun and intriguing to another level. The graphics are top quality and absolutely stunning. The soundtrack is so pretty and it fits the game very well. The actual game play and storyline is really unique and interesting. I also love that we have side quest options and its super easy to level up. I would totally reccomend this game to anyone who likes adventures, RPG, combat, and relaxing music. This game gets a 100/5 from me all the way.

It was great, until it wasn't. Took up a lot of memory on my phone, and then I had to uninstall it because of that. I continued to play it on pc/Playstation but the devs seem to not care about their player base. Clear and valid changes were submitted to them through their respective platforms and nothing was done. I'll be looking into other similar apps and games until they decide to respect their player base. Please listen to the players devs.

It's a beautiful game, but the lack of controller support is inexcusable. This type of open world game needs a controller to make it fully playable and enjoyable. Android fully supports both Bluetooth and USB game controllers, and there are even specialist controllers like the Razer Kishi specifically for mobile devices. Touchscreen controls (which are actually done reasonably well here) can't ever rise to the level of a proper controller.

A great game that makes me want to invest some time into it, however makes it near impossible to do so due to the energy system (resin). This makes especially less linear farming, such as artifacts, extremely lengthy with very little rewards if you get unlucky. Overall I'd still recommend it however would also make clear that this isn't a game you can easily pick up and get everything quickly (alone due to special 5 stars that appear like twice a year at best). you're okay with grind? go for it.

I mean, I enjoy the game and it's very well done for a mobile game, but it comes with a slew of flaws. A lack of real content, especially in the later levels Absolutely insane exchange rates for the currency to get characters Energy system that is spent within max 30mins per day Buggy awkwardness makes it feel like a mobile port on PC Lack of settings on PC that are standard on almost all games Can't recommend in its current state, even for potential whales.

At only level 8, I have unlocked so many characters through the story alone and unlike many games similar to this you genuinely can get any of the materials used in their gacha/loot box system by simply playing the side quests exploring the vast and expansive, beautifully animated map. There are hidden dungeons, unlockable areas, mini puzzles and much more! I really have been addicted to it, the tutorial even teaches you about different anemo available and lets you try some characters out free.

It was pretty good experience. The characters,the music and even the world its self in the game was good. So far no pay to win or paywall iv seen but the bugs are annoying. Like animal's suddenly levitating when killed or characters suddenly start flashing back and forth when changing characters. The changing characters might be my phone but it's annoying since your completely frozen for a good 4 to 5 second's why I'm complaining for such a small bug? Because I keep getting killed when that hapn

Game is good and fun, at least when you are starting out. There isn't any end game content other than abyss which is honestly hard and annoying to do. It is also the only way to acquire premium currency besides exploration, dailies and visa and it doesn't even gives a lot. What this game needs right now is at least one other end game content that allows us to earn at least 600 primogems every 2 weeks instead of the stingy 300 every 2 weeks that is abyss.

Hands down the best gacha, period. It adopts many features and traits from Breath of the Wild (namely the graphics), but the game manages to hold it's own and feels like it's own product rather than a carbon copy of BOTW. It has many unique characters, a fairly good story and most important of all, it's actually FUN to play. Not to mention that it is one of the truly F2P mobile games on the market. You can complete the campaign without ever needing to spend a cent. 8.5/10

I think Genshin is a great game, there's so much fun things to do! Yet one thing that I think would be better is a trading system between friends. This would be efficient because loads of players get the same characters well over the point of constellation completion. It would give players a chance to trade the characters they want and explore other characters. Same with weapons as well, each different player has their own preferences on weapons and characters.

I'm at Adventure Lvl 20 now, and so far, the game seems amazing - it's reminiscent of the RPGs I fell in love with growing up, and there seem to be little sorts of Easter Eggs hidden everywhere. The cash shop isn't bad, I 'm always on board with helping game developers, within reason. But with no controller support for Android, my rating will forever be 3 Stars. There is support for iOS, but why skip over half of the mobile community? Mario Kart Tour did the same thing to Android~

Gotta say. The game is very fun. The characters and world are fun to explore, but after you get to a certain rank, the grind hits REALLY hhard. Leveling slows down, and you can only progress the story when you are high enough rank. Really kills the momentum. My "last straw" as it were was the anniversary debacle. A whole year of playtime and the rewards might as well have been nothing. The gacha system is brutal, and the earning of summon gems is too slow. Genshin is a fun game for 1 month

I love the game so much. The graphics are beautiful, the music is amazing, the story is fun, and I like the characterization. My one complaint, is that in the English version of the game, there were a few times when my female character was referred to as the brother. For example in certain dialogue the characters would refer to her as he, mention her missing sister when it should have been her brother, etc. Just small stuff. Anyway, I love this game very much.

Honestly, it's a great game! The story behind the game is absolutely fascinating, The cutscenes are well animated, And the characters are all unique in their own way with their fighting styles. A whole free roam game, were you can explore, some in new characters, and discover new stories and secrets about it. Would highly recommend this game! And that's a lot coming from the 16-year-old ✨

Company is greedy. Pay for a daily reward system+do commissions and it's not enough for even 1 ten pull. That kind of greedy. Story has gotten lazy. Company doesn't appreciate player base whatsoever. Impossible to get good items and build characters. Resin takes too long to load in and it takes too much to collect items. Don't invest your time in this game, because the developers won't invest anything in you.

It's an amazing game! I love the characters and storyline. The graphics are stunning, and exploring each new region feels like entering a different world. I always look forward to updates, especially with new characters and quests! I do have one suggestion though, it would be great to have a translate feature in the chat panel. Communicating with players from other countries in co-op can be challenging, and a translator would make teaming up so much easier.

Currently, this game does not reward you properly for exploration. They limit you immensly with a stamina system (resin), that gates you from any meaningful progression on your characters, weapons, and gear. The gacha system is heavily skewed to make you want to spend large amounts of money to get a single unit, let alone a 5* unit. The chests in the world reward almost exclusively garbage making it very hard to outfit your units with proper gear without falling victim to the resin system. Although, gameplay is fast paced and enjoyable, they lock certain abilties and powerful character defining ability upgrades behind athier constelation systems. A system where you are required to pull multiple duplicate units from the gacha.

Can't say using a phone for this is optimal, but as someone who's about to hit AR40 on my psn account this game is an absolutely addictive blast, and the first time I've ever spent money on a "free to play" game. God that lack of crossplay hurts though. Also my one big piece of advice is to chill out about progression speed. You do NOT need to buy resin to pass the battle pass objectives thanks to event exp, and there's literally 1550 chests, so grinding adventure exp by domain is also stupid.

After playing since day 1 i am left disappointed. Game still feels like a beta at best. Co-op mode riddled with bugs and limitations. RNG is rigged on multiple levels including all weapons/artifacts(extremely higher chance for getting bad ones) and the wish system (0.06% for 5* and after that 50% chance check to pass). Endgame is non-existant and abyss is paywalled starting 11-2. After 5 months no expansion of the main story. Developers seem way too greedy. Play for story only then move on. 3/5

I've been playing this game for 1 year now. The storyline and graphic are wonderful but after playing the game for some time and reach a certain adventure rank, the games gets pretty boring. There's nothing else to do other than dailies and wait for new event/quest. When I first play it I was amazed by how beautiful the scenery are, this game is free to play friendly. Genshin impact is one of the best game I've found so far, it deserves more recognition. Keep up the good work!

I am a kind of person who wouldnt play a single game in their phones because I have better things to do. But after playing this game, this is the one game I truly enjoy to play. The gameplay and graphics is good and while the controls is can be improved, its still packed full of action and things to explore. Highly reccommend playing this game.

I pre-registered for this after seeing the trailers, and it looked very good. That being said, given other factors, I was honestly just expecting Just Another Gacha/JRPG. But on installing the game, I ended up surprised. Partly at the six gig download, which hurt a bit, but mostly at the quality of everything. I sat and just listened to the orchestra playing during the download and I was satisfied- the graphics and gameplay really stood up to the trailer. 4* for cutscenes crashing, otherwise 5*!
