I play moble, and it's one of the best games I have ever played! I love the open map and the ability to explore or follow the storyline, the many hidden puzzles and chest. There is so much to the game your always finding something new to do. They keep adding characters and new plots of land that you can explore. 10/10 would recommend. Definitely want to try PC and cancel in the future.

Beautiful! Smooth game play, Immersive, captivating with a good momentum. It can be challenging but not overpowering. You collect chatactures and weapons through a points system so always chance for change and varity. Cut scenes were a little shaky at first but that seems to be quickly fixed. Does take a beating on your phone, mines been getting pretty hotz, but honestly it's worth it. I'll update when I've gotten more familiar with it but for now, it seems like a keeper :)

I tend to back away from large games, but I tried this out of curiosity. I am not disappointed. What really hooked me into this game is how it runs under weak internet connection, it doesn't lag! The quests are engaging, the artstyle is just beautiful, though kinda confusing for someone with no RPG/Gatcha experience. I rarely stay engaged playing RPGs, but this is just perfect for me. I love the open world aspect, and how you can just travel around the map if you're bored.

Love this game, I like playing this on my PC because I don't have enough storage space on my phone or something, or I might just don't wanna play on phone because it's more fun on pc. But the characters designs are very detailed so its hard to memorize when drawing the characters, I like the Japanese voice! Even if I don't know what they are saying, they sound more cool and some noises are just a bit weird.. But I like the characters back stories their really interesting! That's all

Great Gameplay and nicely designed characters. But now you have nothing to do. Events are time locked, its just the same grind (daily --> expeditions ---> spend resin) everyday. At least in other games when there's no active event (Azur Lane) you can do OP siren, filler events, farming ships, grinding xp for research ships. Also why dont you increase resin (basically stamina system) like every other single gacha game every time your level increases?

Been playing for 2 years and I've tried genshin in multiple devices, really smooth and has no lag. barely encountered any bugs. the events and story quests are fun to do but can sometimes be a chore. storage reaches 35gb at most. EDIT: I had to restart an account, ever since natlan was released i didn't pay much attention anymore, it's like the mystical aesthetic was gone. i liked all the quests up until Fontaine. i hope by Snezhnaya, I'll be able to enjoy it again like before.

I love this game so much!! It's very pretty and the storyline & characters are amazing! But I also have some problems that I experience : -the lag -some time ago, I lost my progress and I had to play the game from the beginning -it's very hard to fight bosses & others bc of the lag. -it takes a lot of space so I expect it to work a little smoother. This game contains a lot of things, so I understand the lag..! Thanks for making such a cool game, it's one of my favorites! ♡♡♡

At first I played it for the lore but when I reached a higher rank it wasn't just about lore anymore and it was addictive and fun. I'm playing this game for almost a year now and it's still my fav game, but they are bringing a lot of new characters and bosses and the resin is just not enough, tho before they made the capacity a little higher from 120 to 160, I believe for improvement they should make the 8 min wait time for 1 resin, make it 6 min instead or sth so players can have easier time 💔

Love the game and it is soo amazing that you wouldn't believe that it is free!!!! No ads! No lies in their advertisements! You get what you see or even more! It is one of the games that I am willing to pay for some in game purchases to support the game! Totally recommend for those who love open world games and playing at you own pace without too much restrictions.

Overall a good game. But it has a lot of issues. Besides the devs are money-hungry, the Customer Service also didn't do much in helping players. The CS is so often give roundabout answers and didn't listen to what our problem truly is. I often contact them for in-game issues and so far only 1 issue has been answered consistent with the issue itself. I had fun until Rank40, which took me 3 months. After that, it's stagnant only playing domain and commission everyday. Better not to spend anything.

Best mobile game I've ever played. I can't believe it's free. It does have breath of the wild vibes, but it's definitely a game of its own. It has an in-depth story, gameplay and visuals. I've enjoyed playing it so much I downloaded it for my computer and I plan on getting the Nintendo switch version one released. The continuous support and update of the game is great as well. if you always wanted the console experience on your phone definitely download this game and give it a try.

Absolutely phenomenal game. AND ITS ON MOBILE TOO?! Too good.....that was my original review with full 5 stars back in 2020. 4 years later and the drop rates are just as bad as ever. gameplay, combat, quests and just content in general hasn't really changed much making it all feel very monotonous. the rewards have been and still are abysmaly pathetic that it really gets frustrating. overall the developers never listened to anything the player base put out and just let the game kinda flop.

Amazing game, but with bad microtransactions. You will pay almost a full price of a AAA game for rolls. The rolls needs to be much cheaper otherwise I will just buy COD black ops. 10$-20 is fair for a 10 roll. World is huge and everything works nicely. Story is meh, but they are giving so much value for free. The price should not be that close to a full price game, that's a no-brainer for people to save up for the game and skip on rolls

I play this one PC and on my Samsung galaxy note 9. It runs very smoothly. Even setting it to high graphic sexttings in the phone still runs at 60 fps with only minor overheating. The game is fantastic. I highly recommend. Play on either PC, phone or PS4 for free. You can play with your friends regardless of which platform you choose. Needless to say I tip my hat to the devs and am most Definitely a fan of this game and look forward to see where it goes from here.

Overall a very fun game! There are so many things to explore and so many characters to come and get! The web events are also really fun and cute! Wish there was a better method of gaining primogems as a F2P though! But overall the game has nice graphics (I play on the lowest graphics and the game still looks fine ^^") and unique character designs!! Hoping there will be a Xingyan hangout event, would love to see her more in the game!

This game is wonderful, it definitely takes time, but it's not something to be rush in hours or days. There is lots of beautiful scenery, thrilling quests for many characters and main quests, side quests are done very well. Combat is done generously well, with different combat styles and how many of the characters work.

Honestly, it is the best game that I played so far and I really love the gameplay and everything. But sadly after the albedo update (the icy mountain) I couldnt play anymore, it becomes too laggy and could not proceed to any quest. Tried to play in my old laptop and could only play a few hours or so, since it cant handle much in games. still well done!!

Great game. Only concerns I have is the locked camera mode. On both PS4 and mobile it becomes rather bothersome to adjust it constantly. Going in a building make sense,it adjust for every little thing,no. Also,no way to sell excess items for mora. Make it where it we can,like once we buy all the items out the specialty shop we get a offer to sell. Even it's it's 10-50 a sale,it's a sale. Very f2p friendly overall.

I was the hooked on this game when it came out but now well it gives less rewarding I could fight bosses minion get money and wishes to be of some use but recently the money is only good for food groceries and upgrading. Hours chasing something useless. Now I take 4 hours to finish some chore and get a small amount of wish and they introduce new heroes but when i do cast a wish,I get the same heroes I already have and it's frustrating. If there is a fall from grace story, this game would be it.

obsessed with this game! although i do have some problems, the pity is way to high, it takes up most storage, laggy, but you can set the graphics down which makes it less laggier. the characters are stunning! due to the pity being to high, and me not knowing how to get many primogems, i have no 5 stars in the game sadly. but this is a very fun game!

This is an investment game. Best played casually instead of wanting to immerse yourself. Calling this "action" RPG is a stretch at high levels since the devs dont plan on expanding endgame combat or action part of the game Played this for the combat and gameplay. It was fun and challenging. At first. But at high ARs everything dies fast. The devs have no intention to make more challenging combat-oriented endgame it seems so what's the point of building new chars?

Very good game! I like the storyline, the characters is cute the scenery is breathtaking and it is very good game to spend with friend! I hope that there was a special domain where it can be done by co-op or solo, I mean where player was force to play co-op to get along with other people, all the current domain most people clear them way too fast with co-op or solo.Please create a domain with double reward or any special(not so special but good than the normal domain) but very high difficult!<3

Love this game, fun events, and characters. however, since my computer often breaks down I can't play for days since the needed storage is a lot for phones. it would be great if a more compacted version for phones was available. spent $100's on this game already, really addictive but fun. love getting my favorite characters. can't wait for a Hu tao re-run

In depth lore. 26 gig of mobile gaming data. Fast paced combat. Large world . Enjoyment to grinding . So much free content not pay to play . Buying Ingame for things you want to buy not have to. Large community base. Only faults are in game messaging early on . But you have to play and level to unlock feature. Overall a fantastic game I've only scratched the surface and been playing 2 weeks . Can't wait to join rest of community Co op mode when leveled character. Update review soon

There's still no joystick connection year after release. It's incredibly hard to play with hands. Drop rates are abominable, especially in artifacts dungeons—it feels like the game is programmed for users to grind endlessly without results. It's basically impossible to drop a decent artifact. You have to grind for MONTH for that. And when you have something semi-decent? Everything will go into the wrong stat on leveling. It's torture.

Recommend Zelda Breath of the Wild over this 10/10. GI's a beautiful game, but considering that the base data needed to run is too large for a COMPUTER, it shouldn't be on a mobile app store. I have tried to install this on so many devices but it's too large for all of them. Tears of Themis is appropriately sized for the target audience (phones), this is not. Reduce file size or stick to console please. And most of the data should be downloaded from the Play Store, not the app itself.

Best looking phone game ever, hands down. Very clean & crisp cell shaded anime style. It's available on ps4 & pc, so for them to put out a full console level title with cross play on the phone is an impressive feat in & if itself. The gameplay is a little simple, but tries on the complexity of the element system. So combat at face value is a hack & slash with some specials, but really is brought together by the elemental system & forming your team around the elements that synergies well together. Has a breathtaking open world with a lot of small things to do littered around. Definitely sets the bar high for any anime rpg on Android after this. 5/5 android game 4/5 console game. Either way a great game.

I love genshin impact! Getting primogems is hard as a F2P, but everything else is great! I mostly love the quests and hangouts; I'm a big fan of books. I play on mobile, and I put everything on low graphics to make it work well though. It takes up a lot of storage space and burns through my battery pretty quickly. I wouldn't mind some free primogems though!

Well the game is fun by default as a F2P game. It seems like the devs put in a lot of effort in the story and the world itself. But i have to admit that progress is definitely slow and the characters you draw feel intentionally stagnated when playing as a free user. And of course I did the next best thing. I cashed. Almost instantly, 5 star characters. P2W!

Honestly, it's a very good game! The quality, the graphics, the storyline, they're all amazing!!! But the only issue is, it takes up so much GB and space. My cousin play this in her laptop and I tried downloading it but it just takes up so much space. I really wanna play the game.. I would give it a 5 star but, I have some personal reasons why I only gave it 4 star.

After playing this game recently, I've noticed that the main point of the game is just to spend your money on in-game currency. At this point, the game is just like an online shop. Plus, I do have seen a bunch of ads about it. The game is quite greedy nowadays. Since Genshin Impact randomly gained millions of players, Mihoyo started to make more ads and make them appear in most apps. Whenever I search for another game, it pops up as an 'ad'. I do not respect this kind of treatment to me.

Absolutely BREATHTAKING! While I prefer to play on PC, the Mobile version is extremely well done, and still very comfortable to play! Love being able to just .. pick up from where I was was at any time! So so good. I prefer playing with voices turned off, just because some of the characters are a bit... Too chatty.. But the voice acting is still very well done, and I enjoy the story so far!

The rate of this game is too high. Most are players who spend alot. The lag is unreal. Total download size, (which half of it is not needed) is ridiculous. Minimize, reorganize, optimize and be rid of cluttered, useless download. At this point though, nothing will be changed, because older players, who alrdy spent money, will be throw a tantrum. Gacha meets p2w aspect. Devs will state it is not, but not hard to see it is.

I've been playing from day 1 because an online friend invite me to play it with them. At first sight, it looks good and looks like a jrpg esp bc of the cooking system. But as time goes by, the true color of the game starts to come out. The RNG level is unbearable, not just the gacha rate to get a chara or weapon but also a good artifact. It requires too much $$$$ or primos just to get a 5* may it be weapon or chara. Too bad a very potential game is ruined by the company's greed. I play AE now

The game is great really, but I can't just give it 5 stars. Yes, everything is good. The story, the voices and also the characters. It's all good. But of course not everything is good. It's kinda common but I just hope that it's storage friendly for us who is having potato phones. When I look at the water, it glows so bright that it's blinding. I can't see the enemy's health bar. It's ok that I can't see my dame but the health bar? Really? Please help us potato users 😊😊

If you love to explore and get lost in a world this game is for you. The graphics are beautiful along with the soundtrack. One of the very few games that is so much more enjoyable with the sound up. This game is very open world. You can explore, solve puzzles, look for ore, cook, gather plants, farm monsters for materials and so much more. There are daily tasks to accomplish IF you want to. I cant say enough about this game. I absolutely love it.

Fantastic game, graphics, story, voice acting with a lot of tedious grinding involved. Paying for Genesis Crystals is not rewarding and there should be way more character outfits for a lower price. First F2P I ever spend major money on, but it didn't feel good after I spent all the Genesis Crystals, making me not ever want to spend again. Can't play regularly enough to benefit from the monthly subscription, punishes players for inactivity. Too much dialogue, needs to be more concise. Still fun!

Overwhelming with content for new players, lacking for older players. Everyday it's just commissions and grinding for artifacts that are rng on top of rng. The wishing... All the 5 star characters with the exception of five of them are only available at certain times (months apart), and those five have been the same since launch. On total I've spent over 300€ on this game and I still feel like I'm f2p. Still playing cuz I love the world and characters but I'm not spending more. Not worth it.

I've been playing Genshin Impact for over a year now. Early game, it is very charming and fun. A lot of content, quests, events, and hangouts to do. But when you get to AR 50-ish, things tend to get boring. Things you could do end-game are just new events, dailies, farming domains, and/or coop. Overall, I would rate this game is a 9/10.

I give three stars because the graphics is crashing Everytime when I just about to move. My internet is on high speed but the frame rate keeps dropping dramatically. And before I just about to finished the first task, I got fall off the cliff several time and died from the bird eyes view. The setting is good and fluent but the gameplay disappointed me. My space ram is already 13gb and still couldn't run it smooth after I make setting on the lowest. Anyway, this game still new and keep growing.

The game is good but decided to stop playing and quit with less than 2 weeks of playing due to where it is really hard to farm experience, items and many more when the game gets more difficult and the criterias are somewhat hard to achieve. Some mechanics are kinda dumb and not that relevant. Getting rewards are hard to achieve to level up but the game's mechanic increases than the character's level. Also I've noticed that the game is P2W than F2P which is why people quit too.

This game is AMAZING!!!! I only found it yesterday, and it took HOURS to download, but it is SOOOOO worth it! The graphics are incredible for an RPG like this on a phone, but it sucks up phone battery like no body's business. The controls are very user friendly and not overwhelming, though it does take some coordination. To me it seems like a kind of LoZ BotW/Skyrim/Sao hybrid in the best ways.

The game is great, good story telling and high quality graphics. But i notice one of the side quest where you need to gather 3 "Nameless treasure" (which on Qingxu pool, Lingju pass, and Dunyu Ruins). I already done with those 3 puzzles, but i only got 2 Namesless treasure which on Qingxu pool and Lingju pass. Ps. I knew the other one is on Dunyu Ruins because i googled where to get the other one, cause i don't have any idea where to get it since im already done with the puzzles.

Once you get addicted to gacha, your only reason to play the game becomes collecting as many primogems as possible to get characters you want. Once you get them, you just grind best artifacts with very bad RNG everyday until they announce a character you'd like to get in the next patch(es) and your reason to play the game once again becomes collecting primogems. The contents (story, event, exploration, etc) are good, but it takes months for them to update new content which isn't a filler.

Game is perfect for casual and people who don't have much time to play. Maybe you will be grinding for the first part of the game but when you reach the end game you will be playing .5- 2 hours per day.IMO, Designed for people to have a good time with small and fun challenges for awhile before resting after a days work. just beware of the character gacha system,Just play with what you have and use your gems ( or topup small amounts) to get the character you want. Enjoy!

Nice game to play for a couple of months... on PC! Until exploration and world quests/puzzles are over. And ofcourse until you realise, If you don't already know, what gacha really is... You can certainly not adequately play on a mobile phone. Perhaps you can walk and jump around but that's it. The developers, in their attempt to maintain a common interface, as well as functions, among different platforms... they have achieved negative user experience in all platforms...

Fantastic Game. Setting, Plot, and just the overall aesthetic was topnotch. The only thing that keeps bumming me out is the fact that it crashes on my device midgame. Also the Dragon Issue where i fight the dragon during the starting stages and the graphics becomes so bad i could barely see the entire screen. Other than all the graphical fiasco that i had to deal with even in the lowest point of the graphics. The game is fine. Just need to fix the FPS problem and the Graphical Fiascos.

I can't log in anymore. it freezes and won't pass the loading screen. I've tried different ways (re-installing the app, restarting the phone, clearing the cache, waiting forever! ) and none of them works. I'm giving it a 1 star because I saw others have this problem as well and it seems like the developers couldn't care less. I was at W.L.6 and it really drives me nuts when I think about all that time I put on this game.

At the moment, it becomes unfun when the paywall hits gets in the way of progress especially on the late stage when its all about farming for primogems, artifacts, etc. Would be nice to add something that allows low budget or free to play players to have an opportunity to have more content to play that allows them to progress through even if its slow, not having to just rely on gacha and domains. Like how Honkai let's you do Bounty Marks for Stigma, its slow but its clear progress.

Fun and great game to play. Have been playing since the beginning and it's an amazing open world adventure. Wish the characters were more customizable but I still love the characters in the story...but having major bugs with the game now. I sent an email to customer service. No reply... Edit: new update fixes the bugs so I can play again but I missed out on so many quests and rewards 😭. Raised my rating to 4stars.

I want to give it a higher rating but as of right now the gacha rates for new characters is absolutly horrible. The monetization scheme is not only expensive but predatory. Even the energy/resin is a huge problem in this game. I sincerely hope the devs listen to the community feedback as in the future once the giveaway events are over, character summoning and game progression will be put to a halt. This game has a tremendous amount of potential and I do not want to see it go to waste.

Guardian tales is 100% better in all aspects except graphics. Gameplay? It's better. The entire concept of summoning? It's better. Characters? Better. Story? Probably the best I've seen. Unlike genshin where you have to spend your entire life savings on 2 characters, or keep playing for a year to get any good characters, in guardian tales you can be completely free to play and still be able to get the best characters / any character of your choice. It's even better in terms of community.

I really love this game and have been playing since day one. I really love all the characters and the designs. The co-op system could be improved a lot because its not that good. Theres very little rewards which is very unfortunate. It also takes forever to ascend and level characters, I wish there was an auto battle (HSR) or auto clear. It's kinda bad on mobile, I wish it was better, so I mainly play it on pc. It's graphics are stunning on both devices though, and I can't wait for more💖

not f2p friendly once you hit high AR, no source of primogems once all the quests and explorations are completed. Little end game content with minimal rewards. There are events occasionally but rewards are not enough to get the character/s you want. You're force to spend if you really want to get the character/s you want on the limited banner. Good graphics and sound design though.

I used to play Genshin all the time when it came out. I reinstalled it after an 8 month absence to see if the Dendro update made it a more fulfilling experience to play. I didn't expect it to be so disappointing. A good game to play for a month or two with no substantial effort or skill needed to enjoy it but don't expect a challenge after that amount of time. Good for couch co-op multiplayer and its the reason I stuck around so long.

This game is by far......AESOME!!!.... But there's problem. Whenever I played this game, my device is on FIRE!!!... everytime. Is there a way to fix this? I tried to set all graphic quality to “lowest” but still don't change to fact that my device was “overheat”. If possible, please consider make this game for PC (“Steam” for example), or maybe a console (downloadable from playstore). As for the game, I have nothing complain at all. Beside...... I LOVE IT!!! Keep it up!

As much as I love this game. My phone really can't take the storage space:,) My phone is only 64GB and I really really wanna play Genshin Impact. But unfortunately as more versions come, my phone can't really take it anymore. And for that I had to uninstall the game. I've been thinking on buying a new phone but it may take awhile. I love Genshin, I really hope you guys could add a feature where we high AR players can only download quests we've never done and discard quests we've already done.

It's great. The storylines are great, the graphics well done and the characters are well designed. The problem I currently have with this is just the fact that I had my graphics set to the lowest setting, it still lags. In frustration, I set it to highest and it still lags but at the same rate, maybe even less. Hopefully you'll be able to make this game more compatible with mobile! One last thing, please give more rewards after a really hard quest. Really annoying once you get to higher ranks.

Best game ever. It is so relaxing to play. And good lord, they are not trying to add more end game content. We don't need more end game content. It just needs to be relaxing to play and not stress about getting stronger to play end game. Well, overall, beautiful OST, art is superb, same goes to gameplay. Really looking forward to the Anime adaptation

Honest Review, played for about a year in a half. I feel like I got to do every content. Once I got to lvl 51 (max 60), the game was just not fun anymore. With non skipping quest, the lack of voice actors for a billion+ dollar game. The equipment farming when you have some good characters, to the old-ish characters being outdated to were you need the new characters that come out that year, and this game has the worst fomo (fear of missing out). The game is fun a for bit then drops off at lvl 25.

Controls are a bit wonky on mobile. I have to reach my left thumb quite a bit to shift to a faster walk. I would love a control scheme change option in the setting to place buttons where you are most comfortable, or scale things to size. Also, I think sometimes my Bluetooth earbuds do something to the game to make the audio a bit staticy, but it could just be me. Amazing graphics and a lovely story. Give it a try! It may be your new favorite adventure game!

It's a complete cash grab! The dev don't put any effort into fairly distributing rewards and making the game any more enjoyable, they can do this well with their other games but when it comes to Genshin it seems to be a "problem" your better off playing games which make you spend way less to get all the characters you want! Don't bother to sit through hours long dialogue with no skip that don't even reward you with 1 pull. This game feels like a chore more than entertainment.

Very fun, calming and pretty. I love everything about it! Unfortunately I can no longer get into the game because I can't get enough storage to download the new fontaine update :') I wish they'd add a way to access the game's settings from the starting screen so I could delete my old quest data to make room without having to need to download the new data. I'm doing what I can though! Hopefully I'll be able to get back in soon.

I played this game on PC first and for a month and a half stright I've just been having fun just exploring the world and fighting monsters(F2P). From what I can see rn the game only currently has 2 of the 7 regions available to explore. This game is slowly getting bigger and better as time goes on as more patches get released. For those who don't mind the grind I'd say the sooner you start the better.

Great game and stuff. The only drawback is limited game resources. You can't afford to choose a wrong character and gear to build, if you build a char and he/she doesnt work out for you. Bam. The exp book is gone. The mora is gone, the resource is gone; now you gonna live with the mediocre unit that cant clear the content or you have to go full Ultra Instinct to tryhard clear.

I love this game so much!!! The only thing I really think needs fixed is the multiplayer loot reward system. I really hate how I can't loot any chests or do anything to help because I'm simply in a world that isn't mine. It makes it really hard to do things, especially healing too. But otherwise, the game is super fun!!! 💖💖

I'm AR 53 as of this review, and I still haven't gotten bored. At a certain point, the world just kind of sucks you in. This is by far the best gacha game I have played, because it goes beyond just getting new characters. This can just be played as an rpg if you want, though getting characters is definitely nice especially since they are all (except for Kokomi and to a lesser extent yoimiya) very well thought out and all very fun and different, especially in their playstyle and personalities.

Excellent game! I really enjoy this game like crazy. Gatcha rates are super bad though, so just be aware going in. PC or PS plays really nice but the app's controls are my favorite and I usually have to be within 2 meters of something before it properly renders on mobile. Multi player is also only unlocked after level 16 and is a max of 4 players. There is also no in game voice chat, just text. I do super enjoy the game its characters though!

Instant 5 star I do say this game is one of a kind and super unique this is the first game I played that doesn't go boring after how long you play it has a large map to adventure on a great storyline and above all great voice-overs. tho I'd really love to suggest that you add a sneak method so that you can just get across enemies without them noticing.

Easily the most fun game I've downloaded. You can obtain 4-star characters just by playing the first chapter of story quests, one of whom (Kaeya) is still meta-relevant in late game content, apparently. The graphics are top-notch, and the voice actors did a great job making the characters come to life (wait till you meet Lisa in-game). Cooking, gliding and the pity system ensures you'll have a fun time even if you're just a casual player. Combat is worth checking out on YT to see the diversity.

I used to rate the game with 5 stars and I would continue to do so, but with all the latest updates there's still no controller support for Android devices. It's a wonderfully made game, with great characters, storyline and side quests; the mobile version has graphics that do not lack quality compared to the console version. Nevertheless, Android version still does not support a controller. I will change back to 5 stars once this is updated.

Been playing since a few days after its launch and its amazing to see what the game has become now. The developers have been very quick with releasing more content. In fact, the recent releases of the 4-star characters are going too fast that we don't get to immerse or attach ourselves to their personalities and stories. Although hangouts are made for such purpose, it doesn't feel natural still. Thoma's introduction to the game is a good example, Collei as well.

Genshin Impact is a very fun game. I like the variety of characters and weapons you can use, and I also enjoy the storyline! The best thing about this game is that you can essentially play without needing to use money, but if you do use money, of course, it helps. The worst thing is that the game is time-consuming. You've gotta stay on task and keep yourself updated every day. There are also a lot of features like card games, fishing, fighting challenges, etc.

The game is easy to get into, fun adventuring, doesn't put much importance on grinding and is calming. The story isn't interesting but the way it's illustrated makes it easy to bear. The fighting system is interesting and can be very easy sometimes but the main point of the game for me isn't the fights but the adventure. Good game :)

The world building, characters, art design and game play are fantastic and among the best in the genre. The gacha mechanics are a bit egregious unfortunately; I understand the developers deserve to be appropriately compensated for making a game of this caliber but rolling for characters is kind of a nightmare due to insanely low drop rates that do interfere with my enjoyment of the game. Otherwise this is a 5 star experience!

This is definitely one of the BEST GAMES EVER MADE. first of all i wanna thank the developers for making this master piece. This game is perfect, the graphics, the story, the details, etc. The game is so well made that i can't believe IT'S FREE. PLAY IT IN CO-OP MODE (unlock this game mode by getting to adventure rank 16): I play with my brothers, one uses ps4, the other uses pc, and i use my phone, we have a lot of fun adventuring through the beautiful and huge map of Genshin Impact.

I'm not usually the person to review anything but with everything going on, I felt I should say something. I've been playing for about 3 years now. This game and its story, music, combat and lore have been one of the few that have genuinely surprised me. but there are a lot of problems. I was playing every day, now I only play on weekends, logging in when there is something interesting. with the way the game has been treating the players, I don't think people should try it until it gets better.
